3RD MOM HOT POT||261 SPADINA AVE M5T 2E3.matchedAddress: 261 Spadina Ave., Toronto, ON M5T 2E3, Canada
reviews:
If you are craving authentic Sichuan flavors in Toronto, Chengdu Zhaosanniang Maocai Malatang is the place to go! 🌶️

The broth is rich, flavorful, and customizable to your spice level. The ingredients are always fresh, from meats to vegetables, and the portion sizes are generous. What I love most is that the flavor tastes just like home-style Sichuan food — numbing, spicy, and deeply satisfying.

The service is friendly and efficient, and the restaurant is clean and cozy. It’s perfect for both a quick meal and a casual gathering with friends.

Highly recommended for anyone who loves real Chen

we randomly found this place, this is our second time coming here because we could not stop thinking or talking about the hot pot here. genuinely have tried many hot pots in the city and 3rd mom hot pot is where it's at! it seems to be an unknown niche whole in the wall because both times we've gone it's been relatively empty and there's only 124 reviews. but i had to add my two cents because this spot is really so so good !! it def helps that the girl i come here with is even hotter than the hot pot
the broth is really rich and flavourful, the ingredients are always fresh, their ingredients f

It was an overall pleasant experience. There are a lot of ingredients to choose from and all of which are so fresh! They offer different soup or broth base which is really good. Decent space for dine in but it gets busy and you may wait in line depending on what time of the day you’re going. They also have dessert and ice cream which is a nice touch. Staff are friendly and helpful. I can recommend this place looking for an authentic Chinese hot pot experience.

Very affordable if you pick the right items.

If you like spice, I suggest you get the classic spicy hot pot for beginners. Get it mild since the medium may be too spicy. They provide complimentary sauces and toppings but the soup base will mostly carry the flavor. They give you complimentary icecream too

I would recommend getting tofu, beef, and mushrooms.

Do not get the fish balls. Texture was not that great. In addition, they did not have any lamb rolls which is essential in hot pot.

I tried this hot pot place, and I was pleasantly surprised by the taste of food. I got the classic spicy broth and I actually enjoyed it even though I don’t have a high tolerance for spice. The selection of ingredients is way fewer than other hot pot places so for example no bok choy or only one kind of beef roll, but the price and the taste make it worth. My food came down to 11$ after tax and I really recommend this place for any mid-day hot pot cravings in winter.

reviews:
We ordered a mix of dishes to share, and everything came out flavorful and well-balanced. The boat noodles with braided beef and wonton noodles were rich and comforting without being too heavy, and the Supreme Yentafo was a fun contrast — slightly sweet, savoury, and packed with shrimp, squid, and wontons. The beef rice with egg was simple but really well done, especially with the clear soup on the side.

For appetizers, the dumplings and meatballs with spicy sauce were great starters, and dessert was a must. The mango sticky rice was classic and satisfying, and the toddy palm cake was light a

Very tasty noodle bowls! It’s an unassuming place for delicious food. Tom yum soup was very tasty, and it has a strong coconut milk base with a generous amount of seafood. Their boat noodle soup was also very well made, with a bit of a spicy kick. Great service as well, a very cozy spot for a good meal.

First time at 555. Ordered their signature dish- boat noodles, with a recommendation of rice noodles and braised beef. The braised beef was a bit dry and not very tender. The rice noodles were a bit clumped and sticking together. Could use a bit more broth in my opinion (I’m a broth lover). The noodle soup was very tasty and flavorful. Nice bowls and good portion too! (I ordered small).

The environment is very cozy and casual. Low level stool chairs that fit the Thailand vibe. The server was very nice- giving food recommendations, and how to season the noodle soup as well. Good price overall!

location is humble, live in the area so ordered takeout. Pricing is good value.

Got Beef Rice Bowl.. loved the sauce, spicy and tangy, got a medium should've got small, too much rice.

Boat Noodles with Chicken... broth was dark so kind of intimedating but flavours were balance and yummy. Got a Medium and lots of noodles too. They definitely don't skimp on carbs!

Will be back to try more dishes.

This was our first time trying 555boatnoodles. The staff was kind and attentive. It’s a small cozy location with a limited menu compared to the other locations per the staff. The flavors are delicious and very unique! I would highly recommend the spot to anyone looking for a good bowl of noodle soup in Toronto. My only suggestion would be to get better soup spoons. :)

reviews:
A relatively new place in North York with their main location downtown. The food overall tasted good and rich in flavors. However, the size of the meals are quite small especially for the price that you pay.
We got their meals for 2 and their staff even suggested that it could easily fill 3 people. But they were quite small and we were left hungry still after finishing the entire pot. So if you typically eat a regular portion size you're going to have to order a bit more than usual.

We live in the area, and notice this new restaurant today.  We tried the beef boat noodle and the pork boat noodle.  The beef one is spicy and flavourful!  The pork one is light and very comforting.  We were very satisfied overall.  So happy that there's finally a good Thai restaurant in our area!

We come by this restaurant during early lunch time.  We order the famous boat noodle, spring roll and the Pad Thai.  The soup of the boat noodle is strong flavour and pairing very well with the rice noodle and beef.  The beef is good quality.  The spring roll is very crispy and refreshing with the sauce.  The Pad Thai is a little bit disappointed as it is too dry.  Overall, the Thai dishes are authentic

Food 4/5
Service 4/5
Vibe 4/5

reviews: The food was amazing! The ideas behind the fusion are so unique. Between the 3 dishes iI tried the momos were the most surprising. Never had a Caribbean style of it. I was impressed. The sides patty was beyond stuffed! The plantains, Mac and cheese and Jerk chicken were a superb combo. It balanced out so well. Since we ordered ahead it was quick. Looked like if I ordered on the spot it would of been quite the wait. Large waiting area  so perfect during colder days if you don't get a chance to order ahead, but highly recommended.

I ordered the Jerk Chicken lunch deal for $9.99. Their lunch deals/specials weren’t on the menu so you have to ask what the options are. The jerk chicken is spicy, and together with the rice and beans has a sweeter taste to it. This is also my first time having jerk chicken, so I may not be the best reference, but it was decent overall.
Not much seating area as it seems to be more of a grab and go place.

I was initially skeptical about trying this place due to the mixed reviews, but I’m glad I gave it a shot. As a Jamaican, I’m not sure why some people say the staff isn’t friendly, what exactly are they expecting, a red carpet? The young woman at the front was actually very pleasant and considerate.
It's true that the menu is somewhat limited, but it does change, so it’s worth checking what's available. I originally wanted the oxtail momos, but they were out, so the staff recommended the curry goat momos instead, and they were delicious. The loaded oxtail patty was also packed with flavor.
The

Came in for the first time at around 12:30pm on a Friday afternoon, hoping to try the lunch specials (which are advertised for $8.99 from 11-3 Mon-Fri) and the oxtail jahmomos. Unfortunately, neither item was available. The curry goat jahmomos (which would’ve been my next choice) were also unavailable. I found the rest of the menu confusing to navigate (it’s a series of posters splashed up on the wall, but many are for limited specials and I wasn’t sure which items were actually available), and the other combos were between $26-$30 which I thought was too much to spend on a quick lunch- so I p

I gave them a second chance after a disappointing first visit, where they wouldn’t even pour oxtail gravy over their dry rice and peas. While the stuffed patties were decent, they’re definitely overhyped. I also bought a sorrel drink, only to later see that most of the ingredients were artificial including some I can’t consume due to allergies. When I asked for a refund on the drink, they refused and offered water instead. Overall, the service showed little regard for customer satisfaction or retention. I won’t be returning there are far better Jamaican restaurants that do both food and servic

reviews:
Visited Aadab Restaurant and had a wonderful experience. We tried the Haleem, Rumali Roti, and Dum Ka Chicken all are must-try dishes and truly lived up to the expectations. The taste was excellent, and everything was perfectly cooked and well-prepared.

The Peshawari Chicken Mandi was especially delicious with a generous portion size, perfect for sharing. The service was very good, and the staff were attentive and genuinely caring towards customers.

Overall, it was a great dining experience. Highly recommended! 😊

The private booth seating area is nice. Seats are comfortable and warm. The only drawback was the table. The plate to table ratio was a little off. We were not able to fit in the food and cutlery together and had to keep some on the ground. I understand that it had to be that way for the comfort and easy access, but if this can be looked into, it might be beneficial.
Regarding food, I loved the Nawabi chicken 65 and Juicy chicken mandi…. It’s a must try!
The staff was friendly and respectful and kept on checking for any needs.

reviews:
I had unforgettable evening at aangan!!
Every bite in this restaurant reflected quality and creativity. each and every dish was packed with amazing flavors and presented so beautifully.... Unbelievable!!

the ambiance made the whole experience even better.what a gorgeous interior, modern classy and perfect for both intimate dinners and social gatherings....!!

@aangan.toronto menu is a curated journey across India’s kitchens ! I have never tried Indian food so good and delicious!!
Do visit Aangan … it’s worth it!!

What stands out most is how traditional Indian flavors are presented with a modern, polished touch. It’s not just a meal it’s an experience.
Service is attentive, professional, and knowledgeable, adding to the overall sense of refinement.If you’re looking for Indian food in Toronto that goes beyond the usual and steps confidently into fine dining territory, Aangan is absolutely worth a visit.
My favourite item on the Menu was the lamb with the beet chutney, it’s an unique combination that absolutely hits the spot.

Me and my partner just ate here just a few days ago. First impressions: the place is gorgeous! Everything is brand new and thoughtfully designed. From the motifs on the wall/doors, to light fixtures and bar design, you can definitely tell a lot of effort went into the concept of the restaurant. The service and vibe of the place was also great. We were warmly welcomed in from the moment of arrival, given a thorough overview of the menu and recommended items based on preferences which did not disappoint. Now on to my favourite part, the food: everything we tried was delicious and full of flavour

Greeted in a storied entrance by gracious hosts had me knowing I was in for a treat.  Walking into the restaurant I was embraced by a well designed, functional and eye pleasing setting.   The peacock behind the bar is an eye catching experience of light and history.

The food - well the pictures speak for themselves!  Highly recommended by me is the cod! Stunning!  I only wish I could have sampled more!!!!   Tatoba and Abhishek have a gem waiting to shine on College Street.   Make a reservation and go soon before reservations are hard to get!

Thank you for memorable night gentlemen!

Jeff

This is it!!!! If you are looking for an authentic Indian fare dishes with some serious Michelin star touches, you are in for a treat!  Both host Tatoba and Abhishek are gracious; making you feel right at home.  Stunning ambience - their plated dishes are Impressive with a well balanced flavour!  The COD fish stole the show of the evening, and the range of dessert - wow!!!  A must and this place is on my list to come back!  Will be back again !! Cheers, Henri Phrabawa

Agak Agak is a fantastic spot for comforting Singaporean food in Toronto. The laksa was especially amazin; rich, warming, and exactly what you want on a cold night.

The real standout for me was the curry puffs, especially the sardine ones. Easily my favorite item of the night , I honestly could have eaten 20 of them. The Hainanese chicken and popiah were also decent.

We ended the meal with pandan kueh lapis, which was the perfect sweet finish to a night of great food and attentive service. Definitely a place I’d return to when craving something cozy and flavorful.

A lovely surprise: it turns out this place has the same owner as Kiss My Pans, so  owner David actually recognized us, which made the experience feel extra warm and personal. We weren’t very hungry that day, so we each ordered one main: Hainanese chicken rice and laksa.

The rice was beautifully infused with savory chicken broth, and the chicken itself was impressively tender. The laksa was exactly the kind of rich, fragrant, memory-triggering bowl you crave, one spoonful in, and it instantly transported us back to the tropical areas!

We were already full by then, so we had to skip the pandan

Agak Agak is an interesting dining spot. We tried the chicken rice, laksa, and ice kacang. The laksa stood out—it was rich, creamy, and full of flavour, leaning more towards a curry laksa profile. Those who enjoy a robust, coconut-forward broth would likely appreciate it.

The chicken rice was also flavourful; however, the rice could benefit from additional seasoning, as it lacked depth. Additionally, the portion of chicken was somewhat underwhelming. Pricing is on the higher side, especially considering the location is not near major intersections and is slightly removed from the main street.

The Laksa is a must try here. IMO it’s the best item on the menu. I was rooting for the white chicken rice but the Laksa was so delicious. Maybe one of the best I’ve had in Toronto. The white chicken was good but not memorable or something I’d come back crawling for. We also had the Bak Chor Mee - Dry which was decent. Overall, the noodles here are excellent. If you are noodle lover you will have no complaints. Enjoy!

reviews:
I was looking forward to a quick Greek meal, but this visit was disappointing. Our order took 20 minutes, which felt long for a fast-food spot that was almost empty
We ordered two beef gyros, but the meat was like dry pieces of beef far from the juicy gyro we expected. The chicken souvlaki was okay, Fries and onion rings were good  The Greek salad, priced at $9.99, was mostly lettuce with a few very thin slivers of tomato and cucumber. For the price, I expected something better  and more substantial.
Overall, the meal didn’t quite match the value or the wait time.

WOW amazing, really great portions I can literally feed three the freshest the best rice I have with my souvlaki dinner
Highly recommend this place and will be back many times over 💯🔥🔥🔥🔥

BEST GYROS ON DANFORTH!!!

Best priced and so well made, I thoroughly enjoyed the chicken gyro and I highly recommend the chicken souvlaki as well. Best prices ever.
Can’t wait to eat here again the 2 people at the counter were absolutely amazing as well, great customer service.

Haven't been to Alexandros in a while and I was really missing out. I got the chicken gyro dinner and it was absolutely delicious!  I got a healthy portion of salad, rice and chicken and it was so good. I should also add the people working there were friendly and helpful. I'll definitely be back soon. reviews:
This Cafe and pizzeria was opened in July 2025 and is maintaining a consistent high quality since.
It has a (seasonal) roofed patio with 10 tables for 2-3, 2 tables at ground level and an upstairs dining room with 9 tables for 4.
They have an extensive display of pastries , individual size cakes and squares, hearty sandwiches, and pizzas (by the slice or whole).  Prices are reasonable and tge customer service outstanding.
Many Italian pastries and desserts (my favorites are the custard filled ones and the Mille feulles.
The washrooms are upstairs near the dining room.  It is sparkling clean bu

Great service and wide extensive selection of baked goods that taste just right. There is limited seating inside and more outside (when weather is warmer). It is a patisserie, hot food and shop next door is pizza. The table food selection is good and delicious, just found it on the pricier end - pumpkin lasagna with a side of veggies was about $20. Wish there was a pricing sheet or indicator beforehand to know the price upfront. The pastries are a lot more worthwhile and reasonable with pricing.

We tried their cortado and a few pastries, and everything was excellent. The coffee was smooth and well made, and the pastries were fresh and flavorful. They also have seating upstairs, which is great if you want to sit and relax for a while.

I am happy there is finally a proper cafe in the neighbourhood. The coffee is perfection! The cappuccino is delicious. I've tried a couple of the desserts and they are also good. The staff are very friendly and it's nice to hear Italian being spoken. You are almost transported back to Italy. There is a second level seating area and it's easy to get a table.  The stairs are steep.  There is a main level sitting area with high top tables as well.  I highly recommend it.

I got the pesto caprese sandwich and it was soooo filling, and absolutely delicious. The mozzarella filling was also really generous.

I also had the tiramisu — delicious, and pistachio eclair to go. The eclair was divine: heaps of pistachio cream, and not too sweet at all. Delicious when paired with an americano of course.

The staff were really friendly and helpful. They also have a nice seating area on the second floor / patio to enjoy your meal. Will definitely be back to try their other hot food offerings!

reviews: We stopped in to Ammucca Sicilian Street Food and were blown away by the food, and warmth of the owners of this new spot. The decor brings you to another place and the food - we had the Siciliana, arancinos, the bolognese and cartocciata followed by some cannoli and cookies - was outstanding. Sicilian food is hard to find but not anymore in our neighbourhood.
My arancini was perfect.

Food is good, but the pricing might be a deterrent for folks in the neighbourhood from making this a regular stop. $14 after tax for an arancini isnt exactly street food prices, especially with established competitors nearby for much more affordable prices for the same cuisine.

Absolutely & infinitely horrendous from the very start to finish in all possible aspects. Where to start? There was a very, small group of people ahead of me-not more than 3 or 4 people maximum & besides myself there was nobody else-it was not busy. I waited patiently for 10 minutes minutes with no acknowledgement of any sort from anyone. The owner was in the back along with 2 or 3 other people-all of them including the owner looking incredibly frustrated, stressed, overwhelmed. All of those in the back kept looking at me & never came to say or acknowledge anything at all nor the owner who was
Giacomo is best chef in town don't miss this place.

reviews: The Crackle bánh mì with crispy pork was absolutely delicious. The pork had the perfect crunch while still staying juicy and flavorful inside. Combined with the fresh vegetables and crispy bread, every bite tasted balanced and authentic. You can tell the ingredients are prepared carefully and fresh daily. Staff members were also polite and patient when helping customers order. Great atmosphere, quick service, and amazing Vietnamese flavors overall. I’ll definitely be coming back for this again soon.

I came with my friend and ordered the crispy pork banh mi, it was not cooked well, the banh mi and meat were cold like premade. Even that time not too busy. The staffs super cute and friendly. I hope you will improve the quality of the food. The price was the way too high for a Banh Mi !!!

Came in at 10:05AM because the store says it opens at 10, only to be told there’s no food ready yet. If you’re not actually ready to serve customers at opening time, then don’t advertise that as your opening hour. Wasted my time. Very disappointing experience.

Quality: yes, yes, yes. You can tell right away they use good quality ingredients. I especially loved the baguette — crispy but not dry. Honestly, it’s one of the closest to a proper Vietnamese bánh mì baguette I’ve found in Toronto. The bread-to-filling ratio was just right, which made it even better.

I was in tonight, and wow! Beautiful new shop, very clean and organized with a great sized menu. We tried the betel leaf and crispy BBQ pork and both were fantastic. So happy to have them in the neighbourhood!

Stopped by this new sandwich shop today and it was a great experience! The sandwiches were fresh, flavorful, and made with high-quality ingredients. You can really taste the difference in the bread and fillings.

Definitely a great spot for a quick lunch or casual bite. I’ll definitely be coming back to try more from the menu. Highly recommend checking them out!

What an absolutely delightful addition to the neighbourhood. The buns were pillowy soft, chewy and perfect for the toppings. Tried the pork belly and egg with pate. Excellent flavour super well balanced. The owners were kind and inviting. Def stop in!

Love this store! The banh mi buns are delicious and smell so good, really fresh. I got the pork belly banh mi and it was nice and thick, perfect for a snack. Definitely try the matcha latte too, it’s really good! Also, all the workers are super friendly and nice. Would come back again!

My favourite is the crispy pork, BBQ pork, and pork floss. They're very generous with the toppings. Out of all the banh mi places that opened up in the area, theirs is the best. The bread is crispy on the outside and soft on the inside. Excellent value too. Will definitely be coming back soon.

Stopped by and had an amazing experience. The bread was honestly one of the freshest baguettes I’ve had in a banh mi. Perfect crunch on the outside and soft inside. The pate and toppings were well balanced and full of flavor.

I had the tofu and my girlfriend had the pork. Both were solid. She loved hers and finished the whole thing without saying a word, which says a lot.

You can tell they care about quality and keeping it authentic. Definitely coming back.

reviews: The Vietnamese sandwich is value for your money. 5 dollars at McDonald's get you only a small sandwich and this is almost a foot long. I got 5 regular and 5 spicy one. One is enough for me. Other Vietnamese sandwich I have to have 2 to get full. Will sure recommend my friends and family to this place.

Ordered assorted and grilled pork banh mi from here last Sunday night.
The banh mi’s are quite large, good value especially for the assorted at $5.
I took them home and toasted them.
Once toasted the buns are very good and flakey.
The assorted was quite good, it’s 5 stars, the grilled pork was not bad, a couple of tough pieces to chew it’s 4 stars. But overall it’s a solid 4.5 out of five for the taste and value.
If I’m in the area, I’ll go back and order again.

This was my first time here and I loved their $5 assorted meats sandwich! It was a nice big size and it was delicious! Only thing is there was more a mayonnaise taste rather than butter which I prefer. But I’d still get this again!

Service was fast and I loved that it was made fresh while I waited instead of premade ones in downtown Toronto Chinatown. And I liked the ambiance of this small but clean location. I’ll be back!

Small little store, everything looks fresh. They even have a dish you can place your money on so they don't have to touch the money and make your food if they don't have to
Sandwiches tasted good, bun was a little hard and chewy; good amount of stuffing for the prices

Plenty of parking outside but can get tricky if the plaza gets busy

reviews:
Bao house was recommended to me by multiple people for being affordable, so I had to come check it out. I was ecstatic when I saw that they had a version of the viral chocolate soup dumplings! We asked for it to come out at the end, but I guess they misheard and sent it to the table with the first round of food.

We ordered the mini pan-fried buns, soup dumplings, and beef noodles as the main dishes. I did not expect to enjoy the noodles as much as I did -- the texture was so chewy and the soup was delightful and savoury. The mini pan fried buns were basically the soup dumplings but mini and c

Came here for dinner, loved the atmosphere, loved the food even more and the service way more. Our server Alex was super attentive, refilling our cups of tea as it emptied, offering tidbits of info about the meal we ordered and the restaurant. He also gave us bags of tea to go!

The food was fantastic, I especially liked the pickled cucumbers & the ‘House noodles with fried mince’. Also got dumplings (Pan Fried Mini Soup Dumplings and the steamed pork with spicy pork) which were delicious and filling!

Overall loved the experience, and hope to come back!

My wife and I just had an incredible dinner at Bao House, and we are still blown away by the experience. It is rare to find a spot in the city where you can order a full spread of multiple dishes, leave completely full, and have the bill come to just $45!

The Food: Every dish we tried was fresh and packed with authentic flavour. The Steamed Pork Soup Dumplings (Xiao Long Bao) were juicy and served piping hot, and the House Noodles had a delicious, savory kick. The portions are generous, making it easy to sample a variety of the menu without overspending.

The Service: The staff were wonderful

Excellent food served in this authentic dumplings place!!! I highly recommend the deep fried tofu and fried dumplings! Food served hot and service is good! The only male staff there is very hard working and always checks if we need anything and offers hot tea for us~ I’ll definitely come back again for my next stay in yyz!

they accept debit or cash only~

A great place to stop if you love soup dumplings! I'd never tried them fried before and they were delicious. Service was prompt, friendly and very attentive and the prices are very reasonable. The interior of the restaurant is bright, clean and cheerful, making it a welcome stop on a cold day.

reviews: Great new restaurant! The half off steak on Mondays and Tuesdays is what incentived me to try this place out. To start, front of house staff was great. Service could be a bit slow at times but still very nice. The fig Burrata salad was of my highlights, very tasty. The steak itself was cooked to my liking, though texturally there were some parts that were a bit more chewy than I’d like; I really liked the accompanying roasted garlic and sauce. Truffle fries were crispy and good, no complaints. Overall, glad I tried this place out and interested in coming back to try more of the menu!

Everything we ordered was really good. The fries were super crispy and the dip paired perfectly. The pasta was rich and flavorful, and the fish slices were light, clean, and refreshing. Even the lemony cheese was creamy but not heavy, with a nice fresh citrus finish. The sandwich was hearty but not greasy at all, especially with the side salad—fresh, balanced, and satisfying.

How do you not know how to make a decent taco!?! It's the easiest thing to make in the world, but they always mess it up! That's why I stopped ordering from this restaurant.

Never again!

Amazing service by Mudra and Hiral
They were super friendly, fast, and made my order exactly the way I wanted. The food was fresh, the place was clean, and they made the whole experience really enjoyable. Definitely the best service I’ve had in a long time. Highly recommend visiting if they’re working!!

The staff were super friendly and quick, even during the lunch rush. The restaurant was clean, organized, and had a nice casual vibe. Prices were fair for the portion sizes, and everything tasted like it was made with care.

If you’re craving something filling, tasty, an

Delicious vegan options and the portions are great, staff was friendly and the restaurant was well kept.

We'll be back!

BarBurrito was amazing! The food was fresh, flavourful, and made really fast. The burritos were packed perfectly and had a good balance of rice, meat, and toppings. reviews:
Recently opened pho spot in Scarborough. Went here on a chilly winter night and the pho felt so comforting!

We tried the beef pho (came loaded with meat) and the portion size was huge. Could easily be shared by two people. We went a little crazy and had also ordered the pad thai which was slightly different from how usual pad thai tastes like and IMO a little tomato-ey if that makes sense.

The beef skewers with their house special sauce were delicious. Those were my favourite. The salt and peper chicken were good too but lacked a bit of seasoning. Went well with the sauce that came with it.

This beef Pho hot pot spread was fun to eat and perfect for a cold winter day. The soup base is made with humongous beef bones, special ordered from the supplier (words from the chef). You also get free refills on the noodles! 👍🙌
We also tried a brand new item on the menu- Crispy chicken cartilage was crunchy and savory. 🤤
I was quite surprised to see a bowl of pho for under $20! $13 for a small bowl is unheard of in these times!
If you're on a budget and craving for pho. This is the place to be.

Just checked out Basil Pho House and it’s going to become my go-to place in markham

The Avocado Milkshake and Milk Thai Tea was really smooth, creamy, and super refreshing.

For mains, we went to try the:
House Special Phuc Kien Noodle Soup (chicken broth = one of the best in the city)
Spicy Beef Soup in Hue Style, it was so bold, rich, and packed with flavour

Appetizers were just as good:
Fresh Shrimp Rolls
Mango Salad for that perfect sweet-tangy balance

Conveniently located at Scarborough!

Give it a try!

Just visited this spot and have to say it is different from other pho spots. Great prices too!!! Although they do serve the traditional pho. They also offer some Thai dishes as well and both beef broth and chicken broth.  Found a new favorite noodle dish. I got the ox tail with Jujube and goji berries soup and it was sooo good and hearty. I will definitely come back to try more items.

Location/Service
This place is in the middlefield/steeles plaza with the shippers drug mart and supermarket. Plenty of parking spots available.

Interior is pretty standard, but it doesn’t have the crazy flower and tree decorations like the typical viet places. More homey feel.

Staff were very nice, helped explained the menu and orders came on time.

Food
Got invited to try their menu and what’s unique about this spot is that they use viet dishes and twist it a bit with some Chinese ingredients and cooking methods.

reviews:
This is a fantastic Filipino grocery store in Parkdale that also offers delicious prepared Filipino foods. The dishes are authentic, flavourful, and incredibly affordable — perfect for a quick meal or takeout.

The staff are warm and welcoming, making every visit feel like you’re part of the community. They recently moved from down the street, and their new space is such a wonderful addition to Parkdale’s growing food scene.

A must-visit for anyone craving authentic Filipino cuisine in Toronto! 🇵🇭✨

I ordered take out from Batibot. This is my first time at this restaurant.  The taste of the beef stew was tender, and carrots were firm.  All of the beef had quite a bit of fat attached. It's probably the way it's served. The chorizo sausage had a nice slightly spicy taste. The rice was plentiful and nice. It's a bit cheaper to eat here than dining in. The pandasal is fresh but i couldn't buy more to eat, i was full. The serving was a fair size, and overall I would like to visit again soon.
Whenever my wife and I craving Philippino food we go see Ate. Always great. Salamat 🙏

Amazing food, and even more amazing people. We went to Batibot to haul some delicious pancit noodles for the Community Fridges Toronto and turns out they've already been donating their freshly daily made foods to the Parkdale fridge! Also bought some lumpia for myself because it was delicious.

$5 for an entire (three person feed) of pancit noodles. $2 for 5 lumpia. Also lots of snacks and Filipino pantry items.

A wonderful family that hopefully survives this terrible pandemic.
Delicious food and the nicest woman working at the front :) Will definitely be back for more! Also very clean, don’t know what the other reviews are on about!

I’ve been to Shizuku several times before, but I’ve never checked out the store next to it, Bavu Villas. Bavu Villas is a takeout restaurant that specializes Sri Lankan and South Indian street food cuisine (rolls, kothu roti, noodles, etc.). It must be popular; I see customers constantly coming in and out, even customers from New York!

I came here for the kothu roti. It’s a popular Sri Lankan street food made from chopped roti, vegetables, egg, sauces and a choice of protein. It’s known for the rhythmic chopping sound made by chefs as they prepare the meal; the best chefs create their own mus

I recently tried the Chili Chicken Kothu Roti from Babu Villa, and it was a spicy, satisfying experience! The portion was generous, and the dish was packed with flavor — a perfect mix of chopped roti, tender chicken, onions,and peppers all stir-fried in rich Sri Lankan spices.

The chicken was well-cooked and infused with heat, and the texture was spot on — not too soggy and not too dry. I especially liked how the roti pieces were nicely coated in the sauce, absorbing all the flavors. The spicy kick hits just right for those who love a good chili punch.

Visually, it may look a bit heavy, but

Sometimes you need to take a shot at new things, cause you never know it might turn out to be a hidden gem like this place.

The food, the flavour, the portions, the price, and the service was all spot on. Tried their Chili Chicken Kothu Roti, and Cholo Chicken Biryani and both were 10/10. Went back the next day to get it again, and tried their mutton rolls while we were at it. Highly recommended all the items mentioned. It is a takeout place, so keep that in mind when going in.

The owners are very nice people and will talk with you while the food gets ready. Was a great experience and will g

My first time going here. Absolutely amzing service. Had a chance to eat chili chicken briyani and chili chicken kothu. In my opinion the best i have ever tried. 2 sons are absolutely amazing they known how to treat the customers. Amazong service. Well done BAVU VILLAS !!

reviews:
Visited the location inside the Rogers Centre on June 18th. The chef and his team were very professional, and ensure that the area remains clean and kosher. I do not eat strictly kosher myself. I enjoyed my chicken fingers and curly fries very much. I received 4 large chicken fingers that were well cooked and crunchy. There was a good portion of curly fries.

I noticed other chicken finger meals from another concession stand and definitely felt mine were superior in portion size and quality.

Kosher food by Section 104 in Scotiabank Arena.

I've posted their menu below, there are no dairy options, and their prices reflect the venue.  Regardless, it's great to have this option.

Their location is not noted on their website, so it took a while to find them.   They are on the main floor in front of Section 104 (right by EDO, which is mentioned on the Scotiabank Arena website).

$12 for a hot dog! $18 for a foot long!

Completely overpriced. Prices like these id think I was at an overpriced entertainment arena for mediocre sports teams…oh wait. Never mind makes sense.
I was so disappointed after looking forward to a good kosher hog dog.  Dog was just ok nothing special and the bun it was on was cold thick and dense.
Best place to get a kosher foot long hotdog and don’t forget their amazing curly fries!!  GO LEAFS GO!!

Everything I tried was top quality, clean, and clearly made with care. I tried it, lov

I love shopping and supporting local. This quality product shop has definitely impressed me.  The dried orange slices add an elegant touch to teas and tabletop decor when hosting.  I also enjoyed the rose, lemon and apple flavored Turkish delights. I am now eager to try their olive oil.

Really impressed with BRY Foods. I tried a few of their products and everything was fresh, flavourful, and great quality. The dried fruits, nuts, and Turkish delights were all excellent, and their spices have a really authentic taste.

Packaging was neat, delivery was quick, and you can tell they put care into what they sell.
I tried it, loved it, and definitely recommend giving them a shot. I’ll be ordering again for sure.

I recently tried several products from BRY Bergamosa / BRY Foods, and I’m genuinely impressed with the quality. Everything tastes fresh, natural, and well-packaged. The double-roasted chickpeas are perfectly crunchy, the sun-dried Turkish apricots are rich and flavorful, and the natural black olives taste exactly like authentic Mediterranean olives—salty, soft, and delicious.

The pomegranate molasses has a deep, balanced flavor, and the Turkish delight with pistachio and pomegranate is beautifully soft and not overly sweet. I also loved the linden tea; it smells amazing and brews very clean.

Fresh, authentic, and full of love! The owners are so kind and passionate about what they do. Every product — Turkish delight, olive oil, spices, and nuts — is top quality. You can truly taste the difference!

reviews:
I drove all the way from the Niagara region to try their famous chicken chap burger. It was so flavorful and filling! Also their chicken biryani was very tasty and full of deshi flavor! The quantity covered 2 meals for me. Amazing value for money!

They also gave me a complimentary vegetable pakora to try, which was really good. Hot and fresh!

If you're in the area, definitely give them a try. Really good fusion food!

Amazing food. If you want a taste of the actual way indian/Pakistani food is made go here.

Their burger and masala fries were amazing

And their butter chicken was fantastic

We just officially moved here to our new residence last January, 2026. Today, happy Sunday, I decided to try this Bangladesh Eatery at Petron Gas Station so close to our place and ordered food for takeout. I had the pleasure of meeting the siblings tandem, Tusha and Celine (?) who run the place. They did not disappoint me as I enjoyed the food together with my husband and 2 grown up sons:  the chicken chaap and beef burgers, Biryani and butter chicken all at reasonable prices. Delicious! Many thanks to them! I want to try their other dishes in their menu later.
I would definitely recommend BHA

I tried Bhaat n Bytes recently and was really impressed. The chaap burger was the highlight for me very juicy, flavorful, and a really creative fusion take on this street style burger. The fried chicken leg was another surprise with just the right amount of spices and a crispy texture. The masala fries were well done and nicely seasoned. It’s a new spot with a promising menu, and being right next to Petro Canada makes it super convenient for late night cravings. I’ll definitely be going back and would recommend others to give them a try.

Clean restaurant. Friendly welcoming staff. Easy to read menu. I had the chicken biryani and a couple large samosas. The rice was so flavourful, caramelized onions and seasoning was on point! Good amount of rice and chicken for the price. It was very mild so people could choose to add hot sauce or chili’s to add some heat. The Samosas with tamarind sauce was a good snack after.

reviews:
So there are plenty photos of food so no point in repeating.
Overall
Atmosphere. Blaze and confusing. Two stations as if two different restaurants. One is beverage and desserts and the other a Mexican taco joint.
The first seems nothing special and when you order the beverages they really are not anything to write home about.  But for a tourist wanting something quenching - sure why not?

For the Mexican Birria tacos, well this is a niche. There aren’t too many places I’m aware of that are making these types of tacos.
Food taste good, seems fresh, portions are good but a little shy on the beef

I had a massive feast, including:

1️⃣ Combo 1:
🌮 3 Tacos - Tender BIRRIA (beef stew) on a double slightly crispy tortilla, topped with onions 🧅
🌮 2 Quesadillas - BIRRIA (beef stew) with melted cheese 🫕 inside a folded corn 🌽 tortilla and topped with onions 🧅
🥣 Small Consommé - Broth of their signature BIRRIA (beef stew) topped with onions 🧅
1️⃣ Birria Ramen - Ramen noodles 🍜 in a BIRRIA (beef) consommé topped with tender signature meat, and chopped onions 🧅
2️⃣ Drinks - I chose two glass bottles of Mango 🥭 and Strawberry 🍓 Jarritos (all natural, fruit-flavoured sodas from Mexico 🇲🇽)

All th

I was craving birria tacos one day at work and decided to pull out Uber Eats and see if there were any places nearby that didn't charge a delivery fee.

To my surprise, this place popped up and not only did it have high ratings on Yelp and Google, it was also SUPER close to me. I found out that it's actually right across the street from Ryerson at the World Food Market.

I placed an order for combo 2 which came with five tacos, a small consommé and one soda.

Picked up my box and hurriedly walked back to my building, opened the box and was pleasantly surprised that the tacos were big ones. Pri

I ordered one taco & a ginger ale = $10 WOW. so fresh. Inside taco soft & outer taco 🌮 crispy. Perfect! Flavours were complex & delicious. And the consume. Wow. Next time I’m bringing friends & ordering more of everything !
Everything Birria?! Sign me up! Hard to miss since it’s a busy area but worth it. The owner was super nice, and the food is amazing! I’ll make sure to stop by again.

reviews: We ordered over the phone during which the service was very good. They were attentive and took our order. However, everything after that was downhill. They asked us to pick it up in half an hour. Once we got there, we waited another 20 minutes. The veg pasta said it has mushrooms, peppers and paneer (as seen on the receipt as well and pictures on Google), however it only had carrots and broccoli. When I called, they said their chef was off sick, so they made it and didn’t have the ingredients. They asked me to come back the next day and they would give me 50% off for another pasta. Why would I
Great food and great people. Ordered the mutton kothu roti and it was delicious! The chef and owners were kind and welcoming. Will be back soon!

If you are craving well-prepared chicken dishes, you should visit this restaurant. Every item we tried was fresh, satisfying, and well cooked with care. The chicken fried rice was excellent, perfectly cooked rice with tender chicken and balanced seasoning. Each bite felt amazing. The chicken pasta was another standout. The sauce was rich and well-balanced and the chicken was juicy and well-seasoned. We also ordered Chicken 65 fried. Easily one of the best versions of this dish I have had.

Overall, Blue Elephant Cuisine delivers quality food and excellent service.

We recently catered food from Blue Elephant Cuisine and the experience was outstanding from start to finish. The food arrived on time, was beautifully presented, and tasted absolutely amazing. Every dish was fresh, flavorful, and authentic, and our guests couldn’t stop complimenting the quality. The portions were generous, and everything was carefully packed to maintain temperature and presentation. The team was professional, responsive, and easy to work with, which made the entire process stress-free. We would absolutely choose Blue Elephant Cuisine again for catering and highly recommend the

I ordered the mutton biriyani and the chicken curry, and both were seriously impressive; rich, aromatic, and clearly made with care. The biriyani had that perfect balance of spice, and the mutton was tender and flavorful. The chicken curry was equally great, with a deep gravy that tasted like it had been simmered the right way.

On top of the food, the environment really stood out: clean, warm, and relaxing, the kind of place you actually want to sit and enjoy your meal instead of rushing out.

Definitely coming back, highly recommend if you’re craving a great biriyani and curry in a nice sett

reviews: I recently tried this pizza place in Toronto called Bocconcini Toronto and was really impressed! The crust was perfectly baked—crispy on the outside but soft inside. The toppings were fresh, generous, and flavorful, especially the cheese which melted just right. The staff was super friendly and quick with service, and the atmosphere felt welcoming whether you’re dining in or grabbing takeout.

I recently tried Bocconcini Pizza in Toronto, and it was amazing. The pizza was fresh, flavorful, and perfectly baked — you can really taste the quality ingredients. reviews:
So excited that I got to check out Brasserie Côte on their third day of soft opening. They’re the sister restaurant to Côte de Boeuf, with a similar concept of French bistro-type dishes. The whole experience had me wagging my tail.

It’s walk-in only - we arrived at 5:30 pm but were told it would be a ~3 hour wait. Ruff news, right? Fur-tunately, we got a call around 6:30 pm for seats at the bar, which was puptastic!

Food, drinks, and service were all on par with Côte de Boeuf (aka everything was pawsitively doglicious). Portions were decent and pricing was very reasonable.  We got:

Soppress

First fine dining spot on Bloor since ... ever? Harbord and Dupont have Rasa, Parquette, Fat Pasha et al, but nobody's really thrown down on this patch of the subway line (W of Yorkville, E of Ossington) with an effort like this in some time. Sign of a good restaurant? When you bump into the chef smoking a cigarette outside the place at 10 in the morning and they don't open till dinner. The amount of work and effort that must have went into changing a 30 year landmark like BTW Café into this gem? I can't even imagine. Even the windows are the perfect skinniness, the brass rail holding the curt

We had the cote a l’os bone-in ribeye which was definitely big enough to share, along with a warm salad with chèvre, bresaola which also used ribeye but cured and thinly sliced with comte cheese and a light dressing, cured duck also thinly sliced, and escargot traditionally prepared with garlic butter. Everything was very delicious, particularly the large thick-cut ribeye with excellent marbling and topped with a lovely rich dark gravy tasting of caramelized shallots and bone marrow which also served as a dip for the nicely chewy frites. The food was phenomenal and all the servers were incredibly friendly

Amazing food and worth the wait! The vibe is very Parisien; cosy, romantic, yet fun and vibrant. Amazing service from start to finish.

Excited to come back

reviews: Really enjoyed this restaurant and their approach to fast casual Vietnamese food!  I got a bowl with Vermicelli noodles with their veggie blend and lemongrass chicken and it tasted very good.  Perfectly seasoned and such a fresh and satisfying bowl.  Workers here are great and the prices were very good.  Will be back for sure!

This place is legit better than most sit down Viet spots I've been to. Super bowl with all the toppings is amazing. The lemon grass grilled chicken is juicy, flavorful and has just the right about of char. The spring roles are crispy and delicious. Sure, the menu doesn't have a ton of items available yet but it doesn't need to, since what they have is so good. I've gone here for lunch pretty much every day that I've been in the office since I saw they had opened. Eat here!

The food was great I love the flavours I got the Super Bowl (chicken option comes with rice) and went with the chilli pepper topping might be spicy for a few but I love the heat it adds. Spring rolls are great and very refreshing with the veggies it comes with. Would go again after tax was about $15 which is about what I expected for the area.

I am no expert in Vietnamese food, but I will say that I have been know to eat here multiple times a week (because I needed joy).

I usually get the lemongrass chicken bowl and then I daydream about it for a 24-48 hours until I’m next able to visit this food court.

The price is also very reasonable for a very generous portion.

Fantastic Vietnamese Cuisine!
I had an amazing experience at this restaurant. The flavors were authentic and perfectly balanced, been there 3 times already. The pho was rich and aromatic, the bánh mì had the perfect crunch and the atmosphere felt warm and welcoming. Also tried the super bowl with lemongrass chicken and pork tasted fresh and made with care. Highly recommend this spot for anyone craving real Vietnamese food.

Staff keep things professional and polite, moving with the kind of efficiency you want when you’re on the clock but still craving something satisfying.
The menu is broad enough to keep regulars from getting bored, with options that lean generous rather than skimpy. The large steak burrito proved the point—stuffed to capacity, fresh guacamole layered in, and a dollop of extra sour cream to tie it together. The real surprise, though, was the burrito
Great service. Food is consistent after all these years. Really liking the new menu with junior burritos and junior quesadillas. Really appreciate affordable options.

Wow, what happened to this place?
I ordered shrimp and steak but the order was keyed in wrong and I ended up with chicken and steak. And boy, I do not recommend it. The meats very, very dry. You'll need to drink water to keep yourself from choking. Its also pretty flavorless and hard.

I used to love getting shrimp/steak here but somethings gone south here in recent months.

On the upside, there was lots of burnt meat i guess? They didnt skimp, but i wish they would have. Not enough flavor to match the rock-meat

I had the naked burrito with steak and shrimp for takeout and it was great. Nice flavors and sauces were pretty good. The ingedients tasted fresh and it was a big portion that i couldn't finish in one sitting. The place itself is in a busy intersection and seemed warm inside. The lady behind the counter seemed friendly. I would come back!

reviews:
I came to Burrito Boyz for a food delivery pickup, not as a customer, and the experience was very disappointing. One of the female staff members was extremely rude and disrespectful. Her tone was unprofessional, and she spoke in a way that made me feel unwelcome for simply doing my job.

Delivery drivers are also part of the service process, and we deserve basic respect. A little professionalism and courtesy would make a big difference. I hope management addresses this issue.
I ordered a chicken burrito and got no chicken at all. Just a some veggies. Waited in the cold for 20 minutes, only to get so disappointed. Will not be coming again.
Overall good prices for good food. I would definitely revisit.  The only downside is that there is a small group of homeless people nearby, so you may encounter them.

Reliable! I absolutely love ordering from
this location - a regular on uber eats :)! And I get exactly what I ordered every time! I appreciate this Burrito Boyz as much as they appreciate their customers! Thank you always :)!

Ordered a delivery out and have been there a few times. I enjoyed the food. Also with the delivery, they followed all instructions and even gave a free dessert on the house with a nice message. Thanks!

Dont use money here save it.

reviews:
Smashing IT! 🇵🇹😋🇵🇹

Such a cute and cozy gem of a Bakery!

This place has it all! From sweet pastries to excellent home-made dishes.

The staff that work here are so friendly and engaging, it's almost like you're visiting your favorite Aunts House as opposed to a bakery.

The charm and the friendliness is next to none.

The pastries and the lattes are absolutely delicious.

The energy and the vibe is elastic.

This is a great place to grab something to eat any time of the day.

Nested along the heart of Oakwood Avenue in between trendy St. Clair Avenue West and hipster Eglinton Avenue West.

B

Been coming here since they opened last year and just like their location on College st. the pastries and food options are delicious and authentic to Portugal.
Recently placed a catering order for their Bolas de Berlim pastries to offer as our event favours and it was a complete hit with our guests. The pastries were fresh, generously filled and the perfect size. Got so many compliments and would highly recommend. The team here is also so friendly and attentive.  Will go back time and time again!

I tried Natas Coffee and I loved it. I also bought some of the baked good.

On the same cafe, they have another counter specialized in portuguese meal and kitchen called Alma Lusa.
Alma Lusa sells portuguese lunch and dinner menu. Their selection is also great.

Cafe Belem + Alma Lusa are 2 shops in 1 cafe.

reviews:
The cafe is on Eglintom West between Avenue and Bathurst.
The background music is mostly period French songs and the location is decorated in good taste.
The coffee taste great but tge baked good selection is rather disappointing for a location calling itself Patisserie.
Service is very friendly and accommodated.

Nice clean beautiful place.  A ton of tables and chairs.  Came in twice for ice cream on 2 separate occasions.  Both times, they didn’t have some of the selections on menu at counter. I would recommend stocking up or removing that.  I can only speak on ice cream. First time, it was a good scoop for my son. Friendly service.  2nd time, not really friendly and I felt the scoop was small for the price.  Perhaps one day I’ll try a coffee and pastry.  Hopefully they will have more ice cream selections for kids.

This place saved me during one of the most difficult days of my life. Just after putting down my beloved cat, I stopped here with my wife, and I could breathe and enjoy some amazing coffee and food. They didn't know, but I'll always be grateful for this peaceful moment of relief ❤️. Oh, and it is a highly recommended place, anytime, for sure 😊.

This little shop has opened up on Eglington between Chapman cres and avenue road. Plenty of seating and the pastries are absolutely delicious. Everything is freshly done and in true French patisserie. The quick to the croissants and the coffee the list goes on and on. If you’re in the area or just visiting for a break I highly recommend coming here. Thank me later and ❤️ enjoy!!!!
I usually go there for coffee and croissants. Beautiful place, always clean and looks stylish. Delicious coffee and food. Highly recommend it!!!

reviews: Amazing spot in the upper beaches community. Kerem (owner) is a great host and they have incredible food, much of which has been inspired by his home country of Turkey. In addition to the fresh pasta and baked goods, we just tried the breakfast and it was incredible. Light, healthy and tasty. Highly recommend for their coffee, baked treats (simit!) and the pasta of course.

Kerem and his staff are warm and welcoming to all. The vibe is very friendly and relaxing for a cup of Turkish coffee or tea and baklava or a pasta delight with Turkish touch.
I had a lovely chat with Kerem about his connection with the local community.
He even attended a beloved Nona Maria's funeral to the surprise of her family.
I had Turkish tea with carrot baklava. Bought Turkish delight for a gift and lentil soup for dinner. Yum!

Wow! This is now a favourite place of mine to eat.

The pastas are delicious, I need to come back to try more! Better pastas than I’ve had at expensive Italian restaurants.
The pasta is made fresh every day.

On top of delicious food, a super friendly owner Kerem delivers top service.

Decor is super cute. Highly recommend, you must try out this place!!!

Went today with my father for lunch. The pasta is very special, super fresh and tasty. I'm vegetarian and there were plenty of options, I had the mediterranean pasta and really liked it. My dad had a dish with meat dumplings, also enjoyed it. We felt super welcomed, absolutely outstanding service. Looking forward to go again!

The pasta is somehow light and the flavours are rich. I believe the owner said the ingredients are imported from Turkia and Italy. I loved that there's no feeling of bloating or heaviness after eating.

Caldense Bakery continues the tradition of the Portuguese Custard Tart (Pastel de Nata).  This recipe started in the “Jeronimos” Convent in Lisbon, Portugal circa 1830.  Caldense Bakery follows the same century old methods in the preparation of their Portuguese Custards here at 1451-1453 Royal York Rd, Etobicoke, Ontario, Canada.

Bom Apetite!

Absolutely fantastic experience everytime I come back to Caldense Bakery! The staff are always pleasant (shout out to Marsia, Marya, Madison)! Excellent baked goods that are always fresh. They also have fresh bread and cold cuts. Wish there were more locations all around the GTA. Truly a gem!

There desserts and are fresh and wonderful pastries and traditional porgustese desserts such as Nadas, portuguese custard tarts. 🍮 The young girls who work there are very friendly and very nice courteous too and very professional too. They have a place where you can sit down and drink and it is very cute and small too and they sale hot food and sandwiches too and they also have a nice Breakfast menu with eggs 🥚 and bacon 🥓 too with toast and they have expression coffee ☕️ and they also have too cappuccinos and lattes and have candian coffees ☕️.

The problem with this place is they take too long to serve you when you order your food and the tables take long to get cleaned. You’re sitting there with somebody else’s mess until they finally serve you..
I ordered the Tiramisu...It didn't taste bad but you guys know that it isn't a Tiramisu.

Good to know there's more options for noodles 24/7

reviews:
Had a craving for an Apple Fritter.
Found the perfect place at the St. Lawrence Market.
These are a good size, we couldn’t finish them.
So yummy!!
The inly thing missing was a nice warm cup of coffee…
The Carousel Bakery is a must try.
Always a good go to for peameal bacon sandwich. Not too salty. Not dry at all. Just a great grab and go sandwich for $8.50. quick turnaround for food as they're all prepped and ready to go.

I stopped in around lunchtime and ordered the turkey club with fries. First thing I noticed was the bread — lightly toasted, warm, but still soft inside. The turkey tasted freshly sliced, not like packaged deli meat. Bacon was crispy and layered properly so you got some in every bite. They didn’t overload it with mayo, which I appreciated. The fries were hot and clearly made fresh. I’ve had a lot of average sandwiches — this wasn’t one of them. You can tell they care about basics.
I have stopped to try the famous Peamel bacon. Despite there is no sauce on the sandwich, it was really nice. Service is a bit rude. Place doesn't provide any table or small chair.

A great place to go if you're nostalgic otherwise I'm not sure what the big deal is.  The counter staff were grumpy, bordering on rude, after I ordered they just threw the pre made sandwich on the counter.  Really?  Flavor is just meh at best and I can tell it was sitting around for awhile before i bought it.  Much better options in the market.

reviews: Highly recommend this place! The food is absolutely delicious and full of flavor. The servers are super friendly and attentive, which makes the experience even better. I ordered a cochinita taco, carnitas taco, and a salbute — everything was amazing 🤤 Definitely coming back!

Price was $28 for a 1/2 lbs of smoked Brisket, along with some light sides.

Brisket was decent. I got the lean part, not sure if you can pick between the lean and fatty part of the brisket.

You can ask for different sauces, if you aren't just happy with one.

Weirdly enough, the pastries here are really interesting, and worth trying. They were also worth trying.

My mom and I went to this place because we had a craving for some BBQ. We ordered a brisket, coleslaw, and mac and cheese. Sad to say we were extremely disappointed with the results. The first notice is that there's no BBQ on the meat but we get a tiny dipping cup as if we ordered from a fast food chain. Along with a tiny cup of coleslaw. The mac and cheese looked promising but the taste was non-existent. Overall if you want to pay for overpriced BBQ for low quality flavor this is the place for you.

I recently visited Chainsmokers Urban Barbeque and unfortunately had a disappointing experience. We ordered the smoked brisket, grilled chicken, and Chainsmoker burger.

Starting with the smoked brisket, it was overcooked and lacked the smoky flavor that I was expecting. The brisket didn’t seem fresh and failed to deliver the kind of barbecue experience you hope for at a place like this.

The grilled chicken was another letdown. It had very little flavor, and the only thing that stood out was the honey glaze on the top, which added a sweet taste. However, the chicken itself was bland and far f

Incredible location! The Milton one I used to love but man it’s like you need to pre order food a year in advance to ensure they have it

I called this location last minute , they held a table for us, served us food in a quick and timely manner - had all the brisket on hand ( their brisket is INSANE)

Our favourite item ( and bear in mind we loved it all) was their brisket fries - holy!

The staff were courteous , and I would drive 40 minutes for this location anytime!

Very good BBQ place, we went on a weekday, quite late so it was empty and all to ourselves. Very friendly service, we had the brisket with dun’it fries and coleslaw, which were amazing. Some of the brisket pieces were on the harder side, while others were super soft but we still enjoyed the package. We also had a pound of wings which were good too, we had expected the wings to be made in the chosen sauce but it was provided separately. Overall very good experience. Lots of parking in the plaza with lots of different cuisines within the plaza and the other side of the road too.

reviews: We have gone twice! Tried the fresh juices, parilladas both peruvian and Argentina. Had the ceviche and each time have been 5/5. Great Service, One of the owners at the desk always with great communication skills and customer service. Food delicious! Only place in Toronto that honestly has amazing Parilladas and we have tried them all in the latin restaurants lol. Patiently waiting for UberEats because its hard for me to go by car so Uber would be a great option to buy.
Great food, beautiful space. It is just an amazing experience and I highly recommend. 💛

Tried a newly opened Peruvian-Argentinian restaurant at the corner of Bathurst and Eglinton.

We ordered the Anticuchos and Lomo Saltado. While waiting for our order, they gave us free cancha, which was really good. The Anticuchos were perfectly cooked, and the spicy sauce was nice. The Lomo Saltado was great too, but I think it would be even better with a different cut of beef so it would be juicier. Overall, I really liked it.

Good food, good portions, and good prices.

Will definitely be coming back to try other dishes!

It exceeded our expectations! As peruvians we know how difficult it is to not only find the ingredients, but also nail the taste and keep prices reasonable. This place checks all boxes. Their ají con huacatay is exactly like in the pollerías. Although it took them a while to get the order we understand they're a new business. The food was excellent so we'll be back every month to support them, and hope it stays as a family-oriented restaurant.
Great place to have a meal, we came from Aurora just to try out this restaurant! So good, will be coming back. The food impeccable

reviews:
Came in the morning to try some of their pastries and desserts, the pastries were good overall, very well done. The desserts though, is really outstanding here. We only tried 2 so far, but the flavors were really good and well balanced. You can really taste all the different flavors that is in the description. We tried the William Noir (the chocolate was so deliciously rich) and the exotic coconut mango passionfruit (well balanced and light). Definitely coming back to try more!
We didn't stay in the shop to eat, but it's modern, and comfortable. Nice place to sit and have a chat for sure.

I’ve purchased many pastries from here before and generally enjoyed them. The food tastes good overall.

However, during my recent visit, I found a thin metal wire inside the mocha pillow pastry. Thankfully I noticed it before anything happened, but it was quite shocking and definitely affected my experience.

While the pastries are tasty, this incident made me concerned about food safety and hygiene standards. I hope the team takes this seriously and reviews their preparation process to prevent something like this from happening again.

Really good desserts and pastries, the interior is also so pretty and well decorated. We got the pistachio latte and hojicha latte, with a yoyo and croffin. The drinks were really good but the main star were the dessert and pastry. The croffin was really inventive with a delicious sweet potato custard like filling and The yoyo was a perfect balance of sweet and sour and creamy. Highly recommend this cafe!

I’ve tried most of their pastries, several desserts, and their cappuccino — all of which were excellent in quality and taste. The café itself is very clean, nicely designed, and has a calm, cool atmosphere that makes it a pleasant place to relax. It’s never too crowded, which adds to the comfort. Prices are a little on the higher side for what you get, but overall, it’s a lovely spot with great food and consistent quality.

The desserts are simply delicious — fresh, beautifully presented, and perfectly balanced in sweetness. You can really tell a lot of care goes into everything they serve.

A perfect spot for great coffee, amazing treats, and an overall lovely experience. I’ll definitely be coming back and highly recommend it!

reviews: Every dish we ordered was amazing: the mapu tofu, ginger beef, dumplings and Chinese Broccoli. The family who own the spot is also adorable. I will definitely keep coming back.

Yesterday, I was having a really great noodle soup from this restaurant. Simple but really delicious. The soup itself is firing, Taiwanese mixed with Cantonese style, where authenticity and creativity meet together. As a person who travelled across Canada to Asia, this is definitely the best soup noodle I have ever have. And the owners are really nice and warming, absolutely the ceiling of a family style restaurant. If you are looking for incredible Asian cuisine, this would be a must-go place.

Small shop family is all involved.  All very friendly and polite.
The food was brilliant.  I had the baby bok choy with BBQ pork, steamed rice and cucumber salad. The cucumber salad was beyond delicious. Fresh crispy cucumber in a spicy vinegar dressing that I could eat everyday.  The bok chop was flavourful, cooked to perfection and succulent. The rice was well rice tasty, cooked just right and needed nothing. The pork was, to me, the star of the show. Cooked perfectly with a lovely BBQ sauce that was neither overly sweet or spicy.
I will be back. And I will bring others .

Went here with a friend and had a nice overall experience. The owner was really kind, and it was honestly sweet seeing two little girls there (I think they were his daughters). The older one was feeding the younger one and chatting with her, and the little one was sitting on her sister — super wholesome.

Went on a rainy cold day a few weeks back. Portions were generous, food was very well priced, and service was great.

You can tell the food is made with love and care. And it comes piping hot. Come here for great food.

reviews: Stopped in here yesterday just to try it out and I was happy with the experience and very much so my churro. Small little hidden gem in the market. I liked personally seeing the process of making a churro and knowing how fresh it is. I believe the person making mine was the owner and I could tell how much care he put into making the churro that for me is a big deal and I will for sure stop back in here for my churro fix

I visited Churrería Calderón this weekend for a tasty churros treat, and I was really impressed by the passion and presentation behind it. The churrero, Alex, dispensed fresh dough straight into the fryer, making the whole experience feel very artisanal and authentic.

I chose the sugar topping over cinnamon, and it was the perfect blend of sweet and crunchy. I also tried the churros with the milk chocolate glaze, which was sweet, rich, and smooth without being overpowering. The churros were served in sturdy triangular bags, the shop was very clean, and Alex was super friendly and personable.

This small churro place is a hidden gem in Kensington Market. The BEST and  authentic Spanish churros in Toronto. Forget those thick, filled churros with caramel or chocolate, these churros are thin, fried to perfection, and have a heavenly crunch, finished with a sprinkle of your choice of sugar or cinnamon.

I’m so happy to have finally found authentic Spanish churros in Toronto. The place itself is small, so there’s no seating, it’s strictly for ordering your churros to go.

I recommend trying their hot chocolate as well. It’s truly one of a kind and unlike any hot chocolate you’ve ever tas

It is an absolute delight to have fresh, hot churros made with so much care outside of Spain and Latin America. I'm especially impressed given they've only been open for two weeks! Churreria Calderon offers a great selection of varieties, from filled churros to traditional, and they are all incredibly delicious.

Run, don't walk! Support this wonderful new local business. 12/10, I would recommend this place for churros over any other in Kensington and the city.

reviews:
Ordered several dishes from here for a birthday takeaway meal for 7 people. Crab curry with roast pan was delicious. Devil shrimp was delicious. It tastes as good as my mother in law's (don't tell her I said that). To me that means it's cooked with care and ingredients are fresh.  I loved the fish rolls. We like spicy food and found the spice level to be good with a healthy zing. Quality of the crab is good, and tastes like how it does when we make it at home.

Will definitely order from here again.

Highly rated. They have some of the freshest Kothu roti and fried rice I’ve ever tried anywhere. The owner is so nice and you can see how passionate he is about his craft and his culture. Their lunch special prices cannot be beat. I’ll continue going here. I recommended to anyone!

I absolutely loved the crab kothu roti here. It’s honestly one of the best I’ve ever had. The portion size is very generous, and they do not skimp on the crab or any other meat. There’s so much meat in every bite, and it’s packed with bold, flavorful spice without being overwhelming.

You can tell it’s made fresh and with care.  I would highly recommend it and will definitely be coming back.

Tried Crab Ceylon for the first time and it was amazing! I got the crab curry with roast paan and the spicy garlic mussels — everything was full of flavour and super satisfying. The crab curry was rich and spicy, and the roast paan was perfect for dipping. The mussels were spicy and yummy with a unique burst of flavours.
Love supporting small local businesses like this — definitely coming back ☺️
Tried the special kothu with crab 🦀, chicken and shrimp. Was soo good. It did cost 30$ but this was real crab meat and you can taste the quality. The portion was also enough for 2 to 3 people.

reviews:
We often come here after work as it’s right at the harbour. Amazing street-food spot! The Dada Chicken Boti Kathi Roll is a knockout, the King Kohli Kachori is super crispy and flavourful, and the Vada Pav tastes like home. Loved the Paneer Tikka Rice Bowl and the Falooda Shake is the perfect sweet ending.
Great flavours and great value — must-try!

Finally — an authentic Indian chaat spot right here near Queens Quay! This place is truly one of its kind in the area, and honestly something we’ve been missing for so long. From pani puri and dahi puri to vada pav, classic shakes, and even frozen yogurt, everything tastes fresh, flavourful, and exactly like the street-style chaat we crave.
The quality, portions, and pricing all feel so fair for downtown Toronto, and the menu has so many options that it’s hard to choose just one. You can tell they’ve put real heart into bringing proper Indian flavours to the waterfront.
A much-needed addition

If you're craving Authentic Indian Street Food on a budget in downtown Toronto? Your search ends here!🍛✨

CSK (Chaat, Shake, Kathi Roll) just opened its doors at Harbourfront in downtown Toronto and it's serving up delicious desi chaat, kathi rolls, rice bowls, salad bowls, frozen yogurt, shakes and so much more!! 🤯🤩

Cricket and IPL fans assemble coz their ambience and names of the dishes are all based on IPL!!

reviews: Hidden gem in the neighbourhood. Fast, affordable fresh food when you want something a little healthier that's not "fast food". If you are touring around, or visiting the market and need a bite, this place is well worth the few steps (a block away) to save yourself some money, eat something that won't weigh you down and will keep you going for the rest of the day. Vegetarian options available. No facilities available, take-out/carry aways food but well worth it! Give it a try!

Fast, fresh, and tasty. I ordered a chicken bowl and the fresh shrimp rolls. Came out pretty fast. Portions are generous, the fresh rolls alone are enough for a light meal. The peanut sauce went well with the rolls since it’s nice and thick. The fish sauce is better for the bowl so that you can mix it up. Packaging was good - the rolls were carefully wrapped so they didn’t stick together or dry out, and they put a piece of cardboard at the bottom of the bag so everything stayed upright. Everyone was friendly. I’ll be back!

Edit: tried the chicken fresh rolls, preferred them to the shrimp - go

Love this neighborhood gem! They serve up tasty and fresh Vietnamese bowls, banh mi and rolls with excellent service, I waited less than 10 minutes both times I visited. The value for money at this take out joint cannot be beat, they load up on everything and I can’t believe everything is less than $15. My favourite is the lemongrass chicken bowl and their classic cold cut banh mi - so full of flavour and refreshing for the summer!

Best experience at Cuon Cuon! Authentic Vietnamese cuisine. Vietnamese coffee is amazing. Their spring rolls, fresh rolls, and fresh bowl with bbq pork and lemongrass chicken is delicious! Hidden gems by st.Lawrence market! Would highly recommend you to try.

reviews:
This is one gem in Scarborough takes the cup when it comes to biriyani in Canada! It's best biriyani you could ever get! You get the option to choose single or double masala for biriyani and nothing screams authentic more than that question.

The food is straight from Hyderabad, there's nothing in Canada that could get close to Hyderabadi than Deccan! The Haleem is a must try, and you can tell by the consistency and the way it smells!

Best rates I've even seen in Canada and authentic as it could get. Deccan House team you've done such a fabulous work that you've created something really speci

The food was so, so, so good it  reminded us of back home. Every bite was full of authentic flavors. The biryani was absolutely delicious and tasted just like home.
What made the experience even better was the service. The owner personally came and spoke with us, which made us feel very welcomed and valued. The staff were extremely friendly, attentive. Hands down, one of the best service experiences we’ve had. Highly recommended for anyone craving authentic taste and heartfelt hospitality.

Finally an authentic Hyderabadi restaurant. Food which tastes like the original with no excuses. Great ambience with all the murals looking fine from the walls from Tipu Sultan to the Charminar. Looking at good service and good food. The Mughlai Goat curry was rich and well cooked and the Hyderabadi biryani just right. Go enjoy good cuisine.

A really great experience. The food and service was top tier. Loved everything we tried. The Curries, Dum Biryanis, Special Mutton Haleem, and the Tea was 10/10. The only thing better was their service. Especially one of the employees, Utpreksha, was very nice and extremely knowledgeable about their menu and suggested the best items for everyone. Would definitely like to go again.

I’ve been here twice and everything is delicious! Had the paneer and mutton fun biryani, goat soup and Gobi 65. Male server made excellent recommendations. I just wish there was more gravy or meat in the biryani. Is mostly rice which is biryani but for an entree I expect more protein. Otherwise yummy ❣️😀🕊️
