reviews:
The environment is okay, but the food is basically at a typical food-court level and not very impressive.

The fish noodle dish, in particular, was too smelly for my taste—the fish odor was very strong. The other dishes were just so-so and not really my style.

The place is clean and the service is okay, but I would recommend not sitting at the tables close to the kitchen, as the staff tend to lean on nearby tables and chat. Feel awkward.

I was pleasantly surprised by this restaurant! We ordered the fish broth noodle soup with pork liver and fish balls. It came with a HK milk tea (we got hot and cold) and you can choose a side. We shared a popcorn chicken.

The fish balls were delicious and bouncy. There was a generous amount of pork liver and it was cooked perfectly. I don't think I've ever had fish broth noodle soup but the soup was so flavorful yet subtle. I really enjoyed the soup. The noodles had a good chew as well. This place has several locations actually. I would come back again and try different broths next time!

Easy dinning, quality food and creative use of options to provide different tasty dishes. The 5 of us shared our orders so we can try a lot more. I'm very impressed with the soup base and the side dishes of beef tounge, pork chop and chicken. The best one l had for my whole road trip from Vancouver to Toronto.

Used to be decent value for food but now is way overpriced ($18.5 pretax for signature noodle combo), selected shrimp as one of the toppings and received a grand total of TWO shrimps. Literally a complete rip off now for the price. Avoid from now on.
Fast service, great portions of noodle soup, taste good. For the custom noodle soup you get to choose what noodles you want, soup base, and what goes in it. It also comes with a drink.

reviews:
If you’re craving authentic Delhi street food in Toronto, Delhish is the place. I tried their tandoori chaap roll and it was absolutely amazing — packed with bold, well-balanced flavors and clearly made with affection, consistency, and real care. You can taste the effort in every bite.

I also had the tandoori momos and fire fries, and honestly, everything was on point. Nothing felt rushed or generic — just solid, high-quality food done right.

What really stood out was the team. These guys are experienced, hardworking, and genuinely passionate. I noticed them constantly moving around, checkin

I tried the Kurkure Momos and Tandoori Creamy Chicken, and both were absolutely amazing!

The Kurkure Momos were super crispy on the outside and juicy on the inside. The crunch was perfect, and the filling was flavorful and fresh. The spicy chutney served with them made the taste even better. Every bite had the right balance of crunch and spice.

Had a great experience at Delhish! Tried the Tandoori Paneer Momos, Noodles, Spring rolls, and the Blueberry Mint Mojito. The momos were perfectly cooked, full of flavor, and had a nice smoky tandoori taste. The spring rolls were good as well. The noodles, however, were a bit on the sweeter side and not very spicy, with less seasoning, so they were just average for me.

The mojito was super refreshing with a perfect balance of mint and blueberry. The staff were friendly, helpful, and attentive, which made the experience even better. Will definitely come back to try more from the menu.

I had the Afghani Paneer Momo here, and honestly, it was the best ever! At first, I was a bit surprised to learn it was a vegetarian place, as I initially thought they served chicken momos. But after tasting it, that surprise turned into delight — the flavor was so rich and satisfying, it actually tasted better than any chicken momo I’ve ever had. Highly recommend trying it!

Absolutely loved the food and service here!🥰 The grilled sandwich, kurkure momo's and kurkure spring rolls were bursting with flavor, fresh, perfectly cooked, and beautifully presented. On top of that, the prices are very reasonable compared to other places serving similar food. The staff were warm, attentive, and made sure everything was just right. It’s rare to find such great taste with equally amazing hospitality. Highly recommend Delhish for a truly satisfying finger food experience! 👏✨
Great work!! Keep it up🙌🤩

reviews:
Dharmyug Fast Food in Etobicoke has honestly become one of my favourite spots! 😍

The food reminded us of home, the spices were perfect, and the service was warm and welcoming. A must-visit place for anyone craving real Kathiyawadi taste! 👌😋🇮🇳

We tried undhoyu, roti, vada pav, and buttermilk. Loved them all! We drove all the way from Mississauga as we wanted to have authentic gujarati food and it didn’t disappoint us! We will be back for sure!

The worst part was when we asked about it, the lady working there said they don’t put anything else in the sandwich apart from raw paneer, raw vegetables, and the cheese slice (which they even charged extra for). This is honestly not how a sandwich is usually made. If we just wanted two slices of bread with raw fillings like this, we obvious

I use to really like this place before but IDK what went wrong now and I really regretted my last visit.
Portions were good, food was fresh, and everything was well-seasoned without being too heavy. Nice spot for a satisfying Indian dinner.😋

Amazing food and it was fresh, tasty, and well presented. The service was very friendly and welcoming. Highly recommended!

DIRTY BIRRIAS||1610 QUEEN ST E M4L 1G2.matchedAddress: 1610 Queen St E, Toronto, ON M4L 1G2, Canada
reviews:
My wife and I stopped by for lunch and ordered the beef, fish, and jackfruit birrias. All three were excellent — packed with bold, rich flavor. We were enjoying them so much that we almost forgot to take a photo before digging in.

The consommé was a perfect complement and so delicious that I drank the remainder like a soup.

On top of the great food, the owner, Tim, was warm, friendly, and very accommodating. You can tell he takes pride in his food and looks after his customers.

We will definitely be visiting again!

Was at Dirty Birrias for the first time, the place was clean and staff were very welcoming. I picked up the Beef Birria Box, which came with a side of dirty rice and consommé. Also ordered a side of nachos, and they packaged everything with care. Everything was great! Definitely will be back when I’m next in the city!

Best authentic birria in toronto and probably GTA. I was missing on a LOT. My new favorite dining spot. The staff are the kindest, the lady is so cute and adorable.

Tried the lamb birria and beef ones, both are delicious, but beef is SO good.

Never had fish/jackfruit birrias before, but they are the best! Especially fish, it’s not the regular fried piece of fish, but much smaller pieces of fish. Not the fanciest looking, but OMG it’s one of the best food I’ve had in my life. Makes me hungry thinking about it.

The birria tacos paired with consommé were the star—comfort food elevated to something truly special.

The restaurant had a welcoming vibe, with vibrant decor and friendly service that made the meal even more enjoyable.

If you’re craving birrias, this spot is worth visiting. It’s the kind of dish that lingers in your memory long after the last bite.

reviews: I ordered takeout from this place and was really impressed! Everything was well presented and super fresh. The salmon sashimi and sushi were buttery and perfectly cut, and the rolls had great variety, from classic California to crispy, saucy specialty rolls. The sauces were flavorful without overpowering the fish, and the portion size was generous for the price.

The salmon sashimi is of low quality. Portions on the sashimi are very small and light in colour. The wasabi tasted stale and old. Rolls are at most a 2/5. My daughter likes to eat the radish and kale sides but were old and stale as well. Easy to order on the phone but never again.

I recently ordered a party tray from this authentic sushi restaurant, and it was incredible! The salmon sushi was incredibly fresh, and the orange and green dragon rolls were bursting with flavor. The tuna sashimi was melt-in-your-mouth perfect, and the spicy salmon with crispy topping added a great kick. I’ve never had sushi this fresh and delicious! The quality is top-notch, and the price is very reasonable for the amazing taste you get. I strongly recommend trying this place—you won’t be disappointed!

New place, all the hype. Great and delicious food, great service, and free parking up front. Good for takeout, although has few seats inside in the case you want to eat it there.  Some selection of Japanese and Korean snacks and drinks as well.

As a non sushi eater, who has friends who love sushi, I appreciate this location for the chicken options they have.

Got a chicken Karaage bowl and Spicy chicken Karaage appetizer. Both were good. Bowl I filling. Definitely add a sauce to it to improve overall flavour but would get it again.

Satisfied my cravings 7.5/10.

reviews: If you are looking for a taste of genuine Italian cooking, you have to come here! The food is real, authentic, and absolutely delicious. Everyone at the restaurant is incredibly nice and friendly, making the whole experience even better. It is rare to find such high-quality, genuine dishes at such reasonable prices. Highly recommend for anyone wanting a true Italian meal in a welcoming atmosphere!

We had 1 pizza, 1 pasta and 1 risotto.
The pasta is amazing!! Definitely coming back for the pasta. The pizza was OK - I'm willing to try other flavors. However the risotto was just way too salty. I would not go for the risotto again. The server was extremely nice.

I came here with my girlfriend and we really enjoyed it. The atmosphere was very nice and everyone was friendly. I had the lasagna and it was one of the best I’ve had. My girlfriend had the gnocchi bolognese and both dishes had amazing tomato sauce that tasted fresh and homemade. Everything felt authentic and we would definitely come back.

This is a hidden gem which frankly lacks footfall, it’s one of the nicest Italians I have tried in Toronto, everything was super fresh and delicious, the staff were super accommodating and friendly. Honestly such an amazing lunch.

Me and my husband had carbonara, caico e peppe and the capricciosa pizza and of course a dessert - a very authentic Italian tiramisu.

The only downfall is that not enough of us are trying this wonderful restaurant.

If you actually enjoy high quality food, GO.

Just had an incredible experience tonight at Donna Fernanda Toronto. The food was absolutely amazing and every dish felt authentic and full of flavor. The service was just as impressive… attentive, friendly, and truly top notch.
From the moment we walked in we felt welcomed, and the whole atmosphere made it feel like we were sitting in a little restaurant somewhere in Italy. Everything about the evening was done right.
If you’re looking for a place with fantastic food and incredible service, this spot is definitely worth visiting. We will absolutely be back.

Alessandro 👌

reviews:
⭐️⭐️⭐️ 3/5

Good Variety, Clean Space — But Service & Consistency Need Improvement

Dosa Boyz is a pure vegetarian South Indian kitchen offering an extensive dosa menu with creative combinations. We ordered the Garlic Cheese Masala Dosa, Medu Vada, Nilgiri Green Dosa, Schezwan Spring Dosa, Mysore Masala Dosa, and Paneer Bhurji Dosa, giving us a solid variety to sample.

Food Quality:
The dosas were decent, but portion sizes and stuffing were noticeably lacking, especially considering the pricing. The sambar was okay, while the chutneys were unfortunately watered down and bland, which took away

Absolutely loved the food here! I had paper dosa, Medu Vada with three chutneys and sambar, along with a masala tea — everything was delicious and fresh. So happy to find a place that’s 100% pure veg.

The front desk staff were very kind and welcoming, which made the experience even better.

Tip: Don’t forget to add ghee to the paper dosa — I missed it this time, but definitely trying that next visit! 😊

First welcomed with very nice incense smell reminding of home opening up all senses. Nandita was awesome server. I cherished and appreciate her hospitality.
The food the presentation, the authenticity of taste of food was surprising. I would never go anywhere else for filter coffee dosa and idli . Home away from home .

I tried Masala Chai, Idli Sambhar combo and Mysore Masala Dosa. All of them were so delicious and tasty. All three Chutney's were so fresh and good. Service by Brijal was great. She is so polite , helpful, suggestive and friendly. I wouldn recommend to try everything. They are also offering unlimited free refill of Chutney and Sambhar. Best in town !
Thank you for your Service, will visit again soon 😊.

(Tried the butter ghee dosa and the Hakka style veg noodles). Great food. Fair prices. Great ambience. Dosas had great packing too and doesn’t lose its crispness even after an hour. Exceptional service. Highly recommended (particularly for the dosas).

reviews: We got to try a newly open Chinese restaurant at Scarborough, Dragonview Chinese Cuisine tonight for dinner.  Order a 6 people combo which includes Peking duck, 3 lbs stir fry lobster,  sweet and sour pork, stir fry beef, vegetables,  groupa,  and soup.   I must say the quality is really good,  portion is decent.  The environment is bright and clean.   The lobster is a surprise because the lobster meat is huge for 3 lbs.  Definitely recommended and will come back for another dinner or dim sum!

The restaurant is located in what was previously Asian Legend on Brimley and Sheppard. We went shortly after opening at 9am, so we were seated quickly, but when we left about an hour or so later, it was packed, and many people were waiting out front.

The food was decent, though personally I found some of the buns and turnip cakes a bit too doughy. However, most of the meal was good. Everything came out quickly, and the service was fine, attentive and polite enough.

The space itself isn't the biggest, but it's modernly decorated and bright and airy, and there are a few private rooms. Parking

All dim sum are freshly prepared on site by the chief.  You can taste the freshness and quality of the food. I highly recommend the Deep fried  dumpling with Chinese ham and radish. (蘿蔔絲酥）and steamed pork andveggie dumpling(潮州蒸粉果).
Price is reasonable with great comfortable environment and services. Definitely will come back.

Born and raised caucasian Agincourt guy so when I saw that the classic Swiss Chalet was yet again being renovated (after Asian Legend first) I was looking forward to seeing the inside.

Dim sum is a common Saturday morning meet up for my friends and I so we gave this place a try.

Prices were good, interior design was super bright and airy inside with comfy sturdy seating.

The tables are WAY too close to each other though. The 2nd glass door to enter the establishment is comically awkward the way it swings and you have to go around it.

Parking lot was plowed too long after the last evenings/

Finally another a Dim Sum seafood place in north Scarborough . This place at Brimley and Sheppard has wonderful Dim Sum. Everything was fresh and cooked perfectly . I was truly impressed with the flavor and the quality of ingredients. All the dumplings were fantastic. The sticky rice was perfectly cooked . The star was the Baked Bun , it was perfectly cooked and has the best texture and taste . The food was so good and the decor which was clean and nice and service which was very good will make you want to come back. I will definitely go back for dinner service . Can't wait . Connie our server

reviews: Love the food here! The esquites I had here reminded me of how my dad used to make it, but much better! I also got my mom some Quesabirra and the guy gave me a free little snack while waiting! Everyone I met there is always so lovely! Definitely coming here again! Sorry for lack of pics, I always end of eating things immediately lol :P
Second time coming here. The Oreo cake/ dessert is next level! A must try if you like Oreo!

Not recommended.
I purchased a dessert (the last one available – peaches with cream) and tried to eat it the following day. Despite being refrigerated for less than 24 hours, it had already spoiled. The jar was swollen, and everything tasted sour, indicating it was definitely not fresh at the time of purchase. Unfortunately, I had to throw it out, which felt like wasting $10 straight into the garbage.

Their interact was not working. They asked me to send them a money transfer which I did. I showed them proof that I sent the funds. Small amount $15. For some reason they were not receiving confirmation of payment and I could not leave with the goods. I said forget it after 15 minutes and left the goods there. They lost a customer. And by the way I speak Spanish so no language barrier there. They need to improve their customer service.

For the types of snacks sold this place is super pricey. Prepared chips (with gummies and sauces) are about $18-20. The cups of esquites were quite small (even the large one) and are about $12. The cakes seem to be well priced (slice for about 4 ppl is $10-13). They also seemed to be quite messy administratively. They didn't take any kind of cards. You could only pay cash for some things, others had to be through transfer to a private account. Also note, the staff (or owners?) don't seem to speak or understand English, so without a Spanish speaker you may not be able to purchase.

reviews:
Smashing IT!

Viva la Mexico!

This place has everything you need and ever wanted for a taste of traditional and authentic Mexico.

It's a great convenience store that has so much to offer.

Cookies, chips, candy, chocolate, salads, and so much more.

You can definitely spend a lot of time here as you admire all of the items that this store has to offer.

Great selection of amazing goods from Mexico that you can't find any any traditional grocery store.

Wonderful customer service and very inviting.

So if you want to spice up grocery list then I suggest stopping on by to El Puestesito Hidalgu

The owner is really sweet and always so nice. She’ll make whatever you want! 💫 she even suggests dishes that aren’t on the menu so you can try different options she offers. Without a doubt, this is the best Mexican food in Toronto!

Went in to buy some bagged snacks, they had an insane selection of stuff Ive never seen before. But no prices on anything. We grabbed 4 bags of chips and a bag of candy, and somehow that came out to $60. No receipt either 🫤

What a special place for the best Mexican food and snacks! The owner was so sweet and informative - there was so much to choose from so I needed help! Go and check this snack bar out - candies, salty treats, everything!

The food is delicious, the atmosphere is very friendly, and I understand that the place has been expanding, which makes me happy for them.
Authentic Mexican cravings

reviews: My family and I were craving Ethiopian food and Ethio Eri cafe did not disappoint! From the customer service to the food everything was outstanding. The owners were so nice & accommodating in explaining the menu to us and the different types of dishes. We ended up getting a veggie & meat platter. It tasted AMAZINGGG, it was so flavourful and not too spicy for us! I will definitely be going back there for more of their food, such a wonderful experience!

This is the place to be!! Ethio Eri cafe has the most amazing Ethiopian cuisine! Everything is perfect! The food is immaculate the flavors burst in your mouth, the people are amazing! reviews:
It's hard to ignore all the hype surrounding Fahmee Bakery and the story of what got them to this point, so when I happened to be at Scarborough's Malvern Mall, I had to stop in to try them for myself.

First impressions: the store is bright, spacious, and clean, with well stocked displays, and a friendly young lady providing good service.

I tried the Curry Goat Patty and their Apple Fritter. Both looked good but how did they taste?

The patty had a good looking crust, with squared off corners, rather than the traditional half-moon shape. It had a decent amount of filling. Not bad for $3.25.

With so many competitors in the Jamaican food scene, it's an uphill battle to stand out nowadays - even if you have the rights to a name that is beloved by the local community AND a strong social media presence.

There is potential here, but to me, it's clear they are still working things out: a true "2" at the moment, but I'm rounding up to 4 to support local businesses.

Regular price for a dozen patties is $28 but they had a promo where it's $24. That is still a smidge more pricey than some others but worth a shot, so off we went to try it!

As it currently is, Fahmees is a tale of 5 items.

I recently visited this location and tried their Jamaican Patty and compared to other places where I have tried Jamaican Patty it was quite different here in terms of texture and flavour but sadly I did not like their Jamaican Patty at all and would not recommend it to anybody. They do have a lot of other baked goods which I did not try and my review is solely based on Jamaican Patty.

This was a mistake. Going in for a quick bite to eat, I wanted to stop by for lunch and saw this place.

The location is clean but also was a bit disorganized. The service was also manageable and didn't rush me which I did appreciate. But man the food.

The patty had no seasoning and flavor, no heat, a rubbery bite, a very dry filling. It was like eating a shoe. Even the dough tasted like regret and filled me with the experience of filling out a tax form.

The sandwich was also just a sad excuse of a jerk chicken. It was overly salty and almost sour?! The bun was also a very dry husk and the v

Thank you for supporting our running event!

A huge thank you to Fahmee Bakery for supporting our recent running event. We hosted a 1 love run event in support of those effected by the hurricane in Jamaica.

They prepared fresh, delicious patties for our morning runners, and everyone was hyped. You can tell the flavor, freshness, and quality had extra love.

On top of that, they generously provided additional pastries, which were a hit as well. Their kindness and support truly elevated our event.

Highly recommend this patty shop for great food and even better community spirit. Thank you again

reviews:
What a gem of a place! The food is honestly amazing — and as an Italian, I really appreciated how authentic and well balanced everything was. The dishes stay true to Italian cuisine, with a few thoughtful twists that are genuinely a pleasant surprise.

Great selection of well-curated wines you do not see everywhere, and the cocktails are creative and well balanced too. The team is fantastic — friendly, knowledgeable and they really know how to make you feel comfortable. The atmosphere is warm, welcoming and almost feels like home. Highly recommended🍝

Amazing experience at Fangio Trattoria.

Beautiful atmosphere, excellent service, and incredible food. The osso buco with risotto was absolutely delicious and the dessert was the perfect finish. Every dish was thoughtfully prepared and full of flavour.

Highly recommend this place if you enjoy great Italian food.

Our favorite date night spot in Leslieville.

Food is very tasty - they finally added the carbonara to their menu and I think about their focaccia very often. We always get exceptional service (would recommend bar seating). Just to note, the restaurant can get loud, but overall has good vibes!

We had an incredible dinner at Fangio Trattoria! We ordered the Carne Cruda, Veal Chop, and Vongole, and every dish was beautifully executed with rich flavour and top-quality ingredients. The veal chop was perfectly cooked, the vongole was fresh and aromatic, and the carne cruda was one of the best we’ve had in the city.

Their wine list is outstanding — clearly curated with passion and knowledge. We enjoyed a fantastic bottle that paired perfectly with our meal.

A huge thank you to Mathew and the entire team for the warm, attentive, and professional service. They made the whole experience fe

This spot is officially going into the regular rotation! We visited this past weekend without a reservation and were seated at the bar right away—which ended up being perfect because we love seeing an open kitchen in action. Every staff we interacted with was friendly, attentive, and genuinely welcoming, and the service was quick without ever feeling rushed.

Every dish we ordered was delicious, and the dessert was to die for. The cocktails were also beautifully crafted. Loved the espresso martini and the Toronto!

Really appreciated the delicious meal, great vibes, and warm service.

We went there yesterday for the first day of their soft opening and we went back today to try different flavours. All pancakes are freshly made, so be prepared to wait ~15min.

Soft opening special: 15% off everything, and there are some select items that are 20% off.

I feel they are comparable to other fluffy pancakes shops, at a lower cost too! Will definitely be coming back regularly!

The soufflés were airy, fluffy, and nicely balanced in sweetness. The texture was soft and cloud-like, which made them really enjoyable. The drinks complemented the pancakes well and weren’t overly sweet.

Cute place for a sweet treat!
So fluffy and airy, Love that. 🥞💛

Hands down one of the best soufflés in the area. I don’t mind the wait at all because everything tastes so fresh. I especially loved the mango soufflé.

I’ll definitely be back to try the other flavours. The customer service was also super nice and friendly!
Best fluffy souffle ever served with tons of fresh fruit. Very cozy little shop. Excellent service too.

reviews:
For some reason, I thought this place was called "A La" when it was located across First Markham Place, but now realized it's called "Fung's Kitchen".

They closed the Markham location and moved to this new Scarborough Plaza and recently opened for 2 weeks.

Since I had never dined at the old A La before, so I can't compare which makes my feedback even more authentic coz I am basing my dining experience without prior bias.

Friendly staff provided great service. They served Shanghainese cuisine. Seems like they have some kisoks for ordering food at the front for take out.

Prices on the food m

The food here is tasty, and the staff are both friendly and attentive.  For the small dishes, the ingredient freshness didn't quite meet expectations, especially given the smaller portion sizes relative to the price.  It can also get quite noisy when the restaurant is at capacity.  I’d likely return for a casual lunch of dumplings or Shanghainese noodles rather than a full dinner.

We were interested to try this new restaurant as they reuse the same Chinese name as 阿拉廚房.  We visited at noon on a Saturday.  We waited about 5 minutes for our table.  They have a printed menu but it doesn't have everything in the online menu.  We ordered our food from their website. The food was not bad but just a bit below the taste of the original 阿拉. The steam buns and dumplings were good.  The sour and spicy soup was pretty good.  The sweet and sour pork ribs were just okay. Service was pretty good and the servers were polite.  There were plenty of parking.

Great place for some yummy Chinese food. The dumplings are fresh and delicious. We love the rice cake. The portions are medium. New restaurant, good for groups of 4 to 5 only two larger tables. Plenty of parking spaces in a new mall. they have tanghulu , my kids really like the fresh fruit it was made with.

The dim sum is excellent but other like noodle and soup is average soup dumplings and pan fried dumplings are excellent the dessert is outstanding (fried egg white is so good but the red bean filling a little bit disappointed) is not a cheap restaurant I paid 100 for the above food

This was the plate option.. an additional 5$ from the bowl. The extra charge is for the larger container with the same portion of food. Incredibly dissatisfied.
Great portions. Great price. Great food. Great staff. Nothing else to say. Highly recommend for all who are in the area. I come here once a week and it’s consistently a good experience.

reviews:
Best vegan ice cream I’ve had in Toronto outside of Honey’s. I eat dairy and usually choose that as vegan ice creams are often icy, just not as creamy, and sometimes even have a weird aftertaste. Not this one…. The pistachio was delectable, so creamy with a nice pistachio paste swirled in too. I seriously couldn’t tell it was vegan, it rivals some of my favorite pistachio gelatos in the city (Nani’s and Mizzica… and not Nani’s vegan which is one of the icy ones).

I did get a bit of sticker shock at $22 for a pint, but I think it’s worth it. They generously gave cones with the pint too.

They

I ordered three flavours — pistachio, chocolate fondant, and mango — and they were all absolutely delicious! I’d definitely recommend this place to any gelato lover.

The only small thing I’d point out is the sample spoon. When I asked to try a flavour, it was served with a metal spoon, which didn’t feel super hygienic. Maybe switching to disposable wooden or plastic ones would be better.

Other than that, everything was great and I’ll happily come back again!

Best gelato store in the city 👌
Great service and the flavors omg!! You can tell they are made with lots of love

Pistachio gelato was absolutely one of the best I’ve ever had—rich, creamy, and packed with authentic pistachio flavor. You can really taste the quality ingredients, and the texture was perfectly smooth. The service was also outstanding—super friendly and welcoming from the moment we walked in. The owner took their time to explain the different flavors which made the experience feel really personal and enjoyable. Highly recommend this place if you're looking for great gelato and warm, genuine service. I’ll definitely be back to get more pistachios!
Gelato On The Danny & Espresso Bar — fresh, house-made gelato crafted by the father himself! Amazing flavours, rich taste, and super fresh. Can’t wait to come back soon!

reviews:
On one of the coldest days in Toronto, I went to pick up food and was told that the chicken souvlaki is grilled fresh and would take 30 minutes. I told them I would call ahead next time since I couldn’t wait that long. The next day, I called ahead and said I would be there in 20–30 minutes. When I arrived, the restaurant was empty (off hours), with only one customer in front of me and no other pick-ups yet. I still had to wait 15 more minutes for my food, and it seemed like they only started making it when I got there. That was a bit of a waste of my limited lunch time.

Aside from that, here’
Absolutely loved this place! Fresh, flavourful Greek food and amazing service. Everything tasted homemade and authentic. Definitely my new go to spot on Gerrard

Loved the sandwiches! I got the pork and my friend got the chicken sandwich. Chicken was better - so flavourful - but both were good. Pork was nice and tender. Pita was SO pillowy and the veggies were super fresh, the sauce was tasty too. Fries on the side made the meal super filling and they were regular cavendish fries but very yummy. Great for the price. We also had amazing service to top it off. Will be going back here :)

A new and very nice place on Gerrard street and Jones.
Finally some greek in the area. The food is excellent and service is nice and fast.

I’m giving this spot a full 5 stars for exactly what it is…and what it does exceptionally well. It’s a family-owned Greek restaurant, freshly opened just three weeks ago, and already you can feel the heart in the cooking. Portions are generous, the fries arrived perfectly crisp, the souvlaki was tender, the roasted potatoes were sublime, and the tzatziki? Absolutely outstanding.

The prices are more than reasonable for the quality and amount of food you get. No, it’s not trying to be a fine-dining destination…and it doesn’t need to be. This place is about honest, authentic Greek comfort food,

Guwoo Grains Noodle is such a nice find if you’re looking for something comforting but a little healthier. Their five-grains noodles are made with rice, millet, brown rice, corn, and oats, and you can really taste the difference. The texture is smooth and light, and it doesn’t feel heavy after eating.

Prices start at $13.99, which is very reasonable for the quality and portion size. They offer different toppings like fish, beef, and even pork intestine if you prefer something more traditional.

Rice was alright, 3/5

reviews:
I tried GAIMA Rice Bowl today and it was surprisingly good.
The Chili Fried Pork rice bowl had strong wok flavor and the meat was tender and well-seasoned. The portion was generous too.
The Winter Melon Tea was refreshing and not too sweet, which matched the meal well.
I also ordered a Tea Egg, and it was flavorful with the soy and spice marinade.

Overall, great value for the price and I’d definitely come back.
The rice with spicy pork slices was really tasty. It was really flavourful and filing, just kind of oily. I also enjoyed the tea egg. The space is neat and clean.

This place just opened and already feels like a hidden gem. I always go for the Signature Chili Pepper Fried Pork paired with a Brazilian Lemonade—such a great combo. The portions are generous, the service is fast, and the quality is consistently excellent. Went camping today and got a few bowls and it was absolutely delicious! Definitely recommending this place to my friends, and we’ll absolutely keep coming back!

Had the garlic scapes cumin beef and the wood ear mushroom chicken bowls. Taste was partway between restaurant and home cooking. Portions were good for around $13/bowl. Solid lunch option! It's located in the Upper East mini food court group of food stalls with communal seating.

Excellent service at lunch time. Had the spicy pork and green peppers on a bed of rice bowl. The food was good packed a nice spice kick tolerable for me but unsure for others. I paired it with the winter melon tea which was good. I would def come back its in a nice little shop with other stores. Good seating area. Will def come back and order again. A+++++

reviews:
I got the chicken banh mi. Pros: really nice host. Service was fast. You get your moneys worth in terms of the meat, it's pretty stuffed. Bread was crisp and hot. Chicken was tasty. Fair price

Cons: I actually think the meat to veg ratio is off. Wish there was more fresh and pickly ingredients.

Had the vermicelli grilled chicken and it was surprisingly good. It’s sorta a cold noodle salad dish. The noodle was really chewy, the sauce was light and refreshing, and more importantly the chicken thighs were juicy and sooo yummy. The staff was also really friendly and welcoming. Will definitely come back to try their other offerings!

came for a quick lunch bite, service was alright and atmosphere of waterworks was nice. food could use improvement in freshness.

the meat was scrap meat, small leftover cuts.

cilantro had to be taken off due to wilting, and discolouration.

The restaurant looks pretty good from the outside, but the experience was truly disappointing.

The food was served slowly, wasn't hot when it arrived, and the seasoning was quite bland and lacked flavor. Some dishes were beautifully presented, but tasted like they were made just for the price.

The service was rather indifferent; ordering required multiple reminders, and further questions weren't answered clearly. and at this price point, I expected much better quality and service.

In summary: this place is more suitable for taking photos than for eating. Hopefully, the restaurant will impro

The service and atmosphere is fine but the actual food itself isn’t the greatest.

Ordered the half and half banh minh. Good flavour, great bread but the chicken had such fatty skin on it and there was also a piece of bone in my chicken. Obviously isn’t authentic banh minh but it could do with some improvements on this fusion recipe.

Not sure I would come back, a bit overpriced for what you’re getting.

The staff was friendly though!

A Must-Visit: Authentic, Flavorful, and Incredibly Welcoming!
I had a wonderful dinner at Hayal Kurdish Restaurant on Wilson Avenue last night, and I'm already planning my next visit!

The atmosphere was so warm and inviting. It feels less like a restaurant and more like you're a welcome guest in someone's home.

But the food... wow! We started with a selection of mezzes, and that were bursting with fresh, bright flavours. The bread served alongside it was warm, pillowy, and great for dipping.

For the main course, I went with the grilled kebab platters, and it was cooked quite well. The meat

This is such a nice restaurant. Wherever I go, I visit Kurdish restaurants for my work as a food writer. The food here was very good. What surprised me is that it was authentic and tasted like a Kurdish mum prepared it. Which in fact is true knowing the owner is a Kurdish mum. :) my parents and I really enjoyed our visit and would recommend everyone to eat here. Only minus point is that it is not very centrally located. Still, if you want to try real Kurdish food, this is the place.

Small place (7 tables) not loud, amazing food and friendly staff. Portions are large but if you can't finish it it's worth taking home.

For the platter most places dry out the chicken but this was delicious moist on the inside and crunch, smokey flavour on the outside.

Their house made baklava is crunchy and not too sweet.

The plaza has limited parking but you can park around the corner. Definitely with visiting with friends and family.

reviews:
We were lucky to have Himagas Toronto for the Filipino dessert and drinks at our wedding, and it was a truly spectacular experience. ✨
Everything was absolutely delicious, authentic, and prepared with such great attention to detail. The presentation was beautifully done and so elegant—our guests were amazed, and we loved it even more.

You could truly taste the love and dedication in every dessert and drink; they went above and beyond our expectations. 💕
We 100% recommend them! Without a doubt, we would choose them again for any special event.

ONE OF THE BEST ENSAYMADA I EVER TASTED IN RECENT MEMORY - very soft and tasty! Love the vibe of the place and the customer service provided by the staff. For sure, we’ll be back for more and try their other products.

What an amazing spot if you want to satisfy your sweet tooth! They have so many great Filipino desserts i’ve never tried, after the first bite you want more!! Service is amazing and the owners are super at heart family run😍 Definitely the go to new dessert spot!!!

The milky Bread was so good and not so sweet. Highly addictive and a really must try specially the cheese flavour! FYI they have dulce de leche and ube
Will definitely come back for more 😀

I love the cassava! It has a golden, chewy, and perfectly sweet. The cassava cake had that sticky, melt-in- your- mouth goodness I could eat everyday.
The creamy topping over the chewy cassava base? Pure Filipino dessert heaven.

“The siopao offered a delicate, airy dough that contrasted beautifully with its savory, well-seasoned filling. A balanced representation of both texture and flavour.”
“Steamed to perfection, the bun retained its softness while encasing a tender, flavourful pork asado, and the bola bola that highlighted the dish’s comforting essence.”

reviews: The food was absolutely delicious — Chilli chicken, chicken lollipop and every dish was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. From starters to dessert, everything meet our expectations. Idly and vada, chutnies need to be improvised to meet excellence.  On top of that, Sushmita gave us excellent service. She was attentive, friendly, and made sure we had everything we needed without ever feeling rushed. The combination of amazing food and such thoughtful service made the whole experience wonderful. Highly recommend!

Tried their breakfast and it was pretty decent! The dosa, poori, and vada were all tasty and fresh. The flavors reminded me of good homestyle South Indian breakfast — nothing overly fancy, just solid comfort food done right.

Service was quick and portions were satisfying for the price. The place has a nice vibe for a relaxed morning meal.

There’s definitely room to add a few more chutney varieties or improve consistency to make it even better, but overall a very good breakfast spot. I’d definitely go back to try more!

Absolutely loved our experience at House of Nizams! We tried the Tandoori Fish Tikka and Chicken Korma, and both were fantastic. The garlic naan was out of this world. So soft, flavorful, and a perfect pairing with everything. Honestly, every dish we ordered was spot on, including the Ghee Mutton Biryani and the Mutton House Special.

Despite a little dinner rush, the service was incredibly warm and attentive. Just keep in mind that the food does take a bit of time, but it’s totally worth the wait. Highly recommend this place!

The Hyderabadi mutton biryani was absolutely amazing! The spices were perfectly on point - not overpowering -and the balance of sweetness and spice was just right. Every bite was flavorful and satisfying.
The gulab jamun was also very delicious, a perfect way to end the meal.
The service deserves special mention- the lady who served us was very polite, friendly, and attentive. Service was fast and efficient as well.
Overall, an excellent experience. I will definitely recommend this place. One of the best! 👍

Had dinner at House of Nizams and everything was just amazing. The fish curry was so flavorful and went perfectly with rice. Bonda’s were crispy, soft inside, and the chutneys were spot on. Loved the chicken starter.. spicy and tasty, and the prawn dish was full of flavor with fresh veggies. The hot and sour soup was a warm, comforting start.

Portions were generous, everything tasted fresh, and the service was super friendly. Definitely coming back again!

reviews:
Reliable Thai Spot on Jane Street
I recently tried Hua Hin Thai Food for a casual meal. Overall, it was a positive experience, though it didn't quite blow me away.
The Highlights:
• Consistent Taste: The flavors were good and exactly what you’d expect from classic Thai dishes. Everything was fresh and well-prepared.
• Convenient Location: It's a great local option if you're in the Jane Street area and craving a quick, hot meal.
• Friendly Service: The staff were pleasant and the food came out in a timely manner.
The Verdict:
While the food was tasty, it felt a bit standard. It’s a very solid c

It’s not often that you get flavours this exciting! I’ve had pad Thai many many many times before, but this spot just in my area showed what high quality ingredients do for pad Thai. Since they opened we’ve been three times to try different dishes and each time has been absolutely spectacular! The pad see ew and pad Thai are our absolute favourites.

My only feedback is that the wonton soup was a bit pricey for its size. Even so, it tasted really good so we weren’t too disappointed!

We decided to try **Hua Hin** after reading through previous Google reviews, and it turned out to be a fantastic find. This unassuming little spot delivers bold, authentic Thai flavours that more than justify the visit.

We ordered four mains to get a proper sampling of the menu. The **Chicken Wings Zapp** arrived with a light, crispy coating and were packed with flavour. Paired with the sharpness of the pickled onions, each bite had a perfect balance of crunch, savoury depth, and brightness.

The **Kor Moo Yang (grilled pork jowl)** showcased a pronounced grilled aroma and rich pork flavour.

Came here with my friend for lunch as we were in the area. The Thai green curry was out of this world with fragrant coconut aroma, and I really appreciated that they could adjust the spicyness level of the Pad Hoi Lai because that dish had me scraping the plate to put the delicious sauce on my rice. Everything was so good, the waitress was so kind to answer our questions, beautiful and comfy interior, we can't wait to come back!
Small place, big flavor. Great to have an authentic Thai food near my workplace. Definitely recommended and will go back again for sure!

You were able to count the jalapeños, onions, bell pepper pieces and so on. What was impossible to count was the cheese that was supposed to be in t

I needed a  quick dine in, and since the restaurant that brought me to this plaza didn't have seats (I don't know how i missed that in the review), i decided to dine in here here because they have chairs. The experience was ok.

It was quiet when I went it, so I was able to dine peacefully. The service was quick and pleasant,  the restaurant was clean but the ambience was kindaf smokey (you need to check your heat extractor).

The food itself was properly cooked and tasted good. It is also quite affordable.

“RJ and Nav provide the best customer service, and the food is amazing! We always order their nachos and quesadillas—they never disappoint. This place is truly a hidden gem in the area. Highly recommend stopping by their shop!”

Dont know why they compromise on quality if  it is a uber order, its been long time I am having burritos from different places here. This is the worst till date. The amount veggies they have put it in is terrible. Absolute waste of money and time.

I tried signature chicken, jerk chicken and shrimp tacos.

I liked the signature chicken the most and then shrimp but not the jerk one as it was salty and tangy and doesn't taste like good jerk chicken flavour.

This food place has only 3 seats and a table so be prepared for that..

Service can be slightly better ..

reviews: On our monthly ritual of finding a new restaurant for lunch while our pooch gets groomed - lucky to come across Insieme . It is truly a hidden gem in Liberty Village, cozy and welcoming, great patio with the whole restaurant giving European bistro vibes. Staff are pleasant, engaging and friendly. Madeline provided an excellent experience and great service while the food was delicious and prepared well. The martini was potent & tasty . The Insieme pizza and Cesar salad were both excellent.

Amazing Italian nook. It’s a must try if you are living close by or visiting Liberty Village. I came here for my birthday dinner and we got Spaghetti carbonara, Marinara Pizza, Orecchiette Salsiccia and Tiramisu. Each and every dish was SPECTACULAR!
They got me a cake and then when I ordered Tiramisu- they put it on the house…so thoughtful and generous. We were hosted by Eva- she was so kind and warm. We’ll definitely be making this place our stomping ground.

First visited this restaurant a year ago while in town and it was so great that we went out of our way to come back here while we were in town again.

We loved it so much we went two nights in a row.

Their flatbread is some of the best I’ve ever had! The pasta is fresh! The service is excellent.

Also, if you get a chance to dine outside, it’s such a great vibe!

This place is such a little gem!

Made an impromptu plan for dinner here on a weekday and turned out it was happy hour. Great prices for cocktails and beer. The server recommended a drink off the menu and it was great. Food was great too, we had a ravioli and a pasta. Tiramisu was okay. Overall had a nice time and would definitely recommend.

I had a great experience at Insieme today. I accidentally ordered the wrong pizza, and after it was served we realized the mistake. When we mentioned it to the server, he kindly confirmed what we originally wanted and generously brought us the correct pizza at no extra charge. This thoughtful gesture made the whole meal so enjoyable. Excellent service and delicious food—I’ll definitely come back again!

reviews:
I recently visited Iryewon, a Korean-style Chinese restaurant, and had such a great experience that I wanted to share. We ordered the jjajangmyeon and the sweet & sour pork (the glutinous rice batter style), and both dishes were absolutely delicious.

The jjajangmyeon had that rich, deep black bean flavor that's savory and slightly sweet, with perfectly cooked noodles that had a nice chewy texture. It really hit the spot. The sweet & sour pork was especially memorable -- the batter was crispy yet pleasantly chewy thanks to the glutinous rice coating, and the sauce was well-balanced, not overly

Really enjoyed the jjajangmyeon here. The noodles had a great texture and the black bean sauce was rich and flavorful without being too heavy. Portion size was also really good.

Service was friendly and the food came out pretty quickly. Overall just a solid spot if you’re craving jjajangmyeon. I’d definitely come back again.

Wow.. I am surprised at this restaurant. All ingredients are fresh and first gave us hot tea and napkin. So kind. Many side dish was very excellent. It makes me feel my father’s food. Soup base and mixed noodle was so good. Noodle was chewy, sweet and soft. Soup was very tick. I didn’t hungry. Mixed source was oily and delicious. I appreciated it. If I go nearby there want to be there again.

Tried this place with my Korean boyfriend and overall, it was a good experience. The staff were friendly and the atmosphere was cozy and welcoming. The food looked great and was nicely prepared. Personally, the flavors weren’t quite to my taste but that’s just me. My boyfriend said it’s very close to the authentic Korean flavors he grew up with so if you’re looking for a real Korean dining experience, this spot is definitely worth checking out.

The Korean food is fantastic. Delicious. And apparently very authentic. The staff for patient with me, help me navigate the menu, explained to me what to do with scissors they gave me for my noodles. All the other customers were Korean families, which tells you that you found a really good place.

Istanbul Fine Foods is a great supermarket in North York, and it honestly feels like stepping into a local market back in Turkey. What really stands out is their in-house bakery. The bakers make fresh lahmacun and somun ekmek that taste just like the ones you’d find at a neighborhood fırın in Turkey. Beyond the bakery, the store has a wide selection of Turkish products on the shelves. From dry goods and snack

I had a great experience at Istanbul Fine Foods. The store has a nice variety of products and everything looked fresh and well organized. Buse at the cashier was amazing. She is very friendly, patient, and welcoming. She made the whole checkout experience really pleasant. Great customer service! I’ll definitely come back.

I visited Istanbul Fine Foods today and was really impressed! The store has a great selection of fresh vegetables and groceries. I tried their lahmacun — it was delicious and very reasonably priced. They also bake fresh Turkish bread and even Ramazan pide, which tastes amazing. Everything here is fresh and high quality. I definitely recommend this place to everyone!

As someone from Azerbaijan, I’ve been missing the tastes of home for a long time — and I finally found them here! Istanbul Fine Foods has such a wonderful selection of Turkish products, and many of them reminded me of the flavors I grew up with. Really nice grocery store with a great selection. The staff were friendly and the store was well organized. Special thanks to Buse at the cashier, she was very sweet and helpful!

reviews:
18 combo plates ordered at 1:30 in the morning... a bit of a shock for a small place right...?
I called ahead and checked if they could do it.
They were a little hesitant that they had enough ingredients to make an order that large... in the end, they said yes and I placed the order.
It took a while (it's a small place remember...?) but the food was delivered in three large well-packed boxes.
It was piping hot and absolutely delicious !!
Not sure where to get halal schwarma...?
Look no further, this is it !!!

My friend and I went for dinner tonight. We decided to try shawarma for the first time. The place was very clean, and the staff was very attentive. The shawarma was delicious, and they even offered us some fries to try. I was really surprised by the great service! I’m happy to explore new places to eat in Canada. I highly recommend it; it’s a very clean place!

if istanbul shawarma was the only shawarma i could eat for the rest of my life, i would be a very happy person!

10/10 recommend the chicken shawarma on half fries half rice. amazing portions, crispy fries, and the most sauce used ever!

i have visited the past two days, and huge shoutout for staying open yesterday during the snowiest day of the year!!!

i will be back soon!

Update: I came back here and I changed my mind from 4 to 5 this time. They now accept credit card. The food is as good as my previous experience.
The food deserves 5*. Few concerns: first, a dirty washroom with no towels; second, not accepting credit card. Baklava was good.  Turkish was authentic. Shawerma Pide was something different than what I tried in Istanbul, but still it was good enough, especially the bread. The price is also affordable. Main food is on average less than 10$ and Tea is 2.5, Baklava the same. I come back here again if I revisit the district.

I had a plate with a mix of chicken and beef with salad. Both meats juicy and flavourful. Veggies were fresh. Baklava almost melted in my mouth. Outstanding food. Service was friendly and accommodating. Definitely recommended.

reviews:
I was so impressed with Jiang Nan Yi Mian! They make authentic Hangzhou cuisine that truly captures the flavors of home. The tofu skin with vegetables may look like a simple dish, but it’s actually a real test of skill—and they nailed it! One bite immediately brought me back to Hangzhou.

Their noodles are also outstanding. The Pian’er Chuan tasted exactly like the ones I used to have in Hangzhou. Even more amazing, the noodles are handmade—such a rare find abroad! It’s really heartwarming to be able to taste hometown flavors so far away.

On top of the amazing food, the service is excellent—f

As someone from Hangzhou, I was so excited to find a restaurant here that serves real Hangzhou-style dishes. I came in with the mindset of “let’s just try it,” and I didn’t expect it to be this authentic. Now I come here every week. I’ve been here so often that the servers already recognize me, haha.

All noodles are worth trying. My favourite is the Pian Er Chuan noodles, and it tastes exactly the same as what I get back home in Hangzhou. One bite and I feel like I’m instantly back in Hangzhou. And the Osmanthus Peach Gum tastes awesome! Not too sweet. Absolutely amazing. Highly recommend!

Clean and nice set up.
Not busy when we went in, no waiting time
Service is good, polite, alert, let us know where we can get free sidedishes, soup and extra condiments
Dongpo braised pork is good, soft fat layer, just the sauce is a bit mild in flavor; noodle is good with the chewy and elastic texture. But I did have reaction to msg afterward.

For such a big restaurant, the place was pretty empty when we entered. It felt a bit eery but it was nice having a lot of space on the table as well. The waitress was not friendly nor welcoming but she was patient and respectful. The food itself was pretty good. The flavours were decent but I feel like there was nothing special about the food as well. It was just good. I did quite enjoy the softness of the meat ball, the elasticity of the noodles and the flavours of the shrimps.

Really comforting and hearty meal — flavorful dishes, generous portions, and a reasonable price for what you get. Everything tasted fresh and homestyle, and it’s the kind of place that’s perfect for a warm, satisfying dinner. Great value overall and definitely worth coming back!

Especially love their steamed and jhol momo. Surprisingly chowmein was good too (similar to hakka noodles). Everything they serve is good and it’s a must try place for good Nepali food.

tried the veg jhol momo last night and unfortunately it wasn’t to my test. the keema fillings had saag mixed in it which i was obviously not expecting and it felt like the saag dominated and it really threw off the flavor for me.the momo wrap was lowkey thick but the jhol itself was really really good.would love to see other alternatives to saag in the VEG MOMO KEEMA in the future.
Something different here- they serve menu with half cold and half hot …! Spice level is high so if you not used to it be careful… good place if you want to have spicy and testy Nepalese/Tibetan food.

I ordered the Thakali set and momos multiple times— both were really good! The flavors were authentic, well-balanced, and satisfying. The Thakali set had a great variety, and the momos were juicy and flavorful. Definitely worth trying. However, the seating area was quite limited, which made it a bit difficult to get a table.

I’ve always enjoyed the food at your restaurant, but I’m really disappointed with my recent experiences. This is now the third time there has been an issue with my order.
A few months ago, my selroti was missing from the order, and when I called, I was told nothing could be done. Another time, I ordered jhol momo but received regular momo, which I let go. Unfortunately, this has happened again. I ordered jhol momo and received steamed momo instead.
The food itself is great, and I genuinely enjoy it. However, REPEATED MISTAKES like this are frustrating, and attention to detail while packing ord

JOLLOF KING||444 YONGE ST, F17 M5B 2H4.matchedAddress: 444 Yonge St, Toronto, ON M5G 2B3, Canada
reviews:
It was actually a very pleasant surprise in terms of taste.
I chose the red rice, and the rice itself was beautifully prepared with a wonderful aroma. Not to mention the air-dried beef — rich and well-marbled, incredibly flavorful. Paired with a bit of dried sweet potato, the combination was absolutely delicious. The staff were also very warm and welcoming, which made the whole experience even better.

I have West African co-workers and friends who always bring Jollof Rice/Chicken whenever we have potlucks and I have come to love this dish so much.

So when I saw Jollof King in the College Park food court, I knew I have to try their food.

Big mistake coming here!

First red flag - they have these big menu with photos on the wall but doesn't show the prices. When I asked for the price, the staff showed me a small menu with prices on it but it's hidden beside the cash register. Kinda frustrating when places like this are not upfront with their pricing.

I then ordered the Jollof Rice with Chi
The jollof is definitely nice and tasty. I’m a chef and I can confirm it’s great. The lunch special combo is great for its price. The rice was more, I already dug in.

I think this is the most overpriced food court food I’ve ever had in Toronto. They recently opened in college park, and I wanted to try something new. I ordered the rice and stew with beef. I paid $19.89. And they just gave one piece of the steak and lots of rice. I would not recommend this place.

Jollof rice is super tasty and it is a good portion of food. I partly agree with some 1 star comments where the chicken is dry. It would be better to serve with chicken thigh (please consider this 🙏）. The rice is cooked with flavourful sauce although I prefer to be more cooked. Love the rice anyway!!!

reviews:
As a Korean who has tried many Japanese BBQ AYCE spots around the GTA over the years, this place feels refreshingly different.

The modern Korean-style AYCE concept that has become popular in Korea hasn’t really been seen much in Toronto until recently, and this restaurant seems to bring that style here. You can choose between the regular buffet bar or upgrade to the buffet + grilled BBQ option — I would definitely recommend the upgrade.

The meat is prepared with authentic Korean-style seasoning, with good cuts and thickness, and it tastes great. Compared to many AYCE BBQ places in the GTA, t
As a Korean, I can confirm the food in buffet was actually authentic korean food. Overall, the food was great & the service was great I would recommend to anyone who wants try Korean AYCE BBQ!
The restaurant is very clean, the food is so good and the staff is super nice !
Big spacious restaurant with great choices of food! Really good bang for your buck.
Good food for the price!! Really worth it! 🫶🏼🫶🏼

reviews:
We bought the puris from  here yesterday, and they were authentic, fresh, and delicious! The service was also excellent, friendly, and quick, and the prices were very decent.

Just one minor suggestion for the chef: while they were crispy, if they could be made even lighter and crispier (as opposed to harder), they would be absolutely perfect. We will definitely be back for more and highly recommend this spot!

JP Panipuri is a must-visit spot for anyone who loves authentic street food. We tried the panipuri and churmu, and both were absolutely delicious. The panipuri was perfectly crispy, filled with flavorful stuffing, and the pani had the right balance of spice and tanginess. The churmu was equally amazing—fresh, crunchy, and packed with bold flavors that kept us wanting more. Everything tasted fresh and hygienic, and the quality was impressive. The service was quick and friendly, making the experience even better. JP Panipuri truly delivers great taste at a great value. Highly recommended! 🌶️😋
I love the place and people. You can even get real indian puries. Staff is really frendly and was easygoing.

We really enjoyed our visit to JP Pani Puri! The food was fresh, flavorful, and absolutely delicious. The pani puri was perfectly prepared and tasted amazing. The staff were very friendly and welcoming, which made our experience even better. It was definitely worth the visit, and we will be coming back again! 😊

Absolutely loved it!
We tried the pani puri here and it was honestly just like the India-wali redi wali pani puri 🤍
The pani had the perfect balance of tangy, spicy, and fresh flavors, and the puris were crisp and fresh. Every bite brought back memories of street food from India.
If you’re craving authentic Indian pani puri taste, this place is a must-try. Highly recommended! 🌶️😋

​Kacchi restaurant is a dependable choice for authentic Bangladeshi cuisine. We tried a few of their key offerings and found them to be solid representations of traditional flavors.
​The Kacchi Biryani is a highlight, featuring well-seasoned rice and tender meat, making it a good, reliable choice.
​The combination of the Biye Bari Roast with Pulao works very well. The Pulao is aromatic and fluffy, providing a nice contrast to the savory, slow-cooked flavors of the Roast.
​To cut through the richness, the Borhani is highly recommended.
​Overall, Kacchi offers satisfying, authentic food that mak

Kacchi biryani was absolutely one of the best I’ve had in Toronto. The food was exceptional from start to finish, with every dish prepared to perfection. Everything exceeded expectations, and the warm, attentive service from Mosh truly made the experience even better. A great meal all around.

After a long time had some good mutton bhuna I must say. Polau and bhuna khichudi could have been a bit better at taste. But overall experience was good. Little light and not much use of scent as other restaurants use. Will order again and try more dishes from this place. But mutton cooked well and tender.

It’s the best mutton kacchi based on the price they charge $24. The kacchi is not oily. Meat is tender. Generous portion size. Almost good for two adults.

They use basmati rice for their kacchi (not kalijera rice), which is a bit on the drier side. I liked their borhani (on the milder side).

They need to improve their seating arrangements. Also instead of machine powder tea, I would recommend some proper store made tea.

They need to improve their seating arrangements. Also instead of machine powder tea, I would recommend some proper store made tea.

reviews:
Stopped by Kanafani recently and really enjoyed the vibe. The ambience is cozy and inviting .such a nice place to sit and unwind.

The tiramisu iced latte was absolutely delicious — creamy, flavorful, and perfectly balanced. Definitely the standout drink for me! ☕🤎

The desserts tasted really good as well. I’m not a big fan of the cappuccino there compared to other cafés, but overall it was still a pleasant experience.

From the moment I walked into Kanafani Sweets & Coffee, I knew I’d found something special. The atmosphere is stylish yet cozy, with inviting decor and a welcoming vibe that instantly makes you feel at ease.

But what truly stole the show for me was their kunafa. They don’t simply keep it sitting around—it’s made fresh, on the spot, the moment you order. You can taste the difference: crisp, hot, perfectly balanced sweetness, and that unforgettable Middle Eastern texture and flavor. If you love authentic desserts, this alone is worth the visit.

Newest addition to the cafe scene in Scarborough, located in the Lawrence and Warden plaza.

They're open late, which is a plus since most cafes in the area close by 5. The ambiance is decent with plenty of seating, and the place is almost always busy!

When I say they have the city's best tiramisu latte, I'm not kidding. Their iced tiramisu latte is honestly one of the best in town. I'd highly recommend trying it.

The strawberry cups are also well done, with a generous pistachio crunch and fresh strawberries dipped in chocolate and marshmallow.

Need to try their matcha next time I’m there.

Food - amazing Palestinian themed desserts, prepared fresh and in house. Heavenly choices for those with a sweet tooth.

Atmosphere- exceptionally well done, very well balanced and plain and elegant. Music volume is appropriate, seating is plentiful and the walls are beautifully decorated with images of Palestine and its people.
Definitely recommended for a cost effective and smoke-free hangout spot, and it’s worth commuting for

I have tried all the middle eastern coffee cafes in the GTA and this one is hands down my favorite and nothing can beat it. Literally hubs and I favorite place to go for any occasion, thank god they opened in Scarborough because we used go endlessly to the Mississauga location! Go to favs are tiramisu lattes & cake and chocolate berry cups!

reviews:
Tucked inside Wellington Market at The Well, Kao Kang is often described as the more affordable sibling of Koh Lipe Thai. As someone who’s long enjoyed the latter, we decided to try this spot for a quick weekday lunch.

From 11 a.m. to 3 p.m., five dishes are offered at $14.99, including green curry and chicken Pad Thai, available even on weekends. I went with the Pad Thai, and we also ordered a beef Pad See Ew, which leans closer to a soy-sauce-style stir-fried noodle reminiscent of Chinese chow mein. For an additional $5.99, you can add a small side and a drink.

The flavors are impressively

I visited Kao Kang by Koh Lipe at The Well and had the Green Curry with Chicken and Jasmine Rice. The curry was absolutely delicious, creamy, fragrant, and full of authentic Thai flavours. It had that special blend of herbs and spices that makes Thai food so unique.

The jasmine rice was perfectly cooked and paired so well with the curry. Overall, it tasted very fresh and had that distinct Thai character that you can’t find everywhere in Toronto. I really enjoyed it and would definitely come back to try more dishes.

Came back Feb 13, a chubby girl with two
Pony tails on the sides of her face was very rude! I simply asked her not to staple the paper bag, she acted impatient, without answering, she threw all the food out of
The paper bag, got another tapper bag, then threw all food back into the paper bag. The rolled her eyes sneered at me. It’s a pretty absurd experience. Won’t go back for such bad attitudes! There are so many much better choices out there!

Some food is good not all of them. Service isn’t bad but only two girls were friendly.

I had the Ma Sa Man Beef curry lunch special for $15 + $4 rice side and it was out of this world. Haven't had this taste at any other thai place. Maybe this is their specialty but I will have to try more dishes. They also gave me an extra rice serving as an apology for an issue they were having upon opening, super friendly!
Just so yummy!!! I have never eaten at koh lipe- so this is an excellent to get a taste. Flavors and portions are great.

reviews: Ordered the beef doner and it was quite tasty. The beef was nicely seasoned and the wrap was crispy on the outside and soft and chewy once you bite into the wrap. The service was very friendly and the restaurant was bright and very clean. The bonus was the wet nap that they give, best wet nap I’ve ever used! I will definitely be back to try the other menu item.

Amazing experience! It was our first time trying this place and we absolutely loved it. The staff were incredibly friendly and welcoming, and the service was excellent. The doner was unbelievably delicious. We were very impressed and honestly don’t understand the negative reviews. This place definitely deserves 5 stars. We will absolutely come back

10/10 spot! MUST TRY!

We had the Adana Doner Wrap, chicken wings and beef kofta rice plate. Everything was made to perfection.

Definitely going back for more.

Mustafa and the team are extremely friendly and love doing what they are doing. Only smiles :)

Please visit and let me know what you think.

If you’re in Toronto and love döner/shawarma, Kasap Doner is an absolute must-visit! Coming from a background where this cuisine is a staple, I can confidently say it’s the best I’ve had in the city. The food is a perfect 10/10, the portion sizes are generous, and it offers great value for the pricing. The service is top-notch, and the atmosphere is just as fantastic. Plus, it’s family-owned and operated, which really adds that extra personal touch. You can tell they’ve put a lot of thought into the decor as well. I highly recommend making it a regular spot!

Keep up the great work, keep the c

Really amazing food! I've been coming back for Adana Wrap! It's so juicy, cooked to perfection and the bread is out of this world! They give you a cup of lentil soup while you wait. Three brothers are running it so it's definitely a great family business. Yes, there are some kinks that need to be ironed out but the guys are very receptive! Give them a try, I highly recommend if you want quality Turkish shawarma doner or Turkish food in general! Prices are great too, just right!

reviews: With taint tables, smell of cooked barbecue chicken, and very friendly servers, this restaurant blew my expectations away. The food was delicious and had a unique after taste that I never tasted before with their spicy sauce being the cherry on top to add that extra kick I was looking for in a dish. If you go here, I would recommend getting either their signature adana wrap or chicken plate which were fresh off the charcoal grill when it arrived. We only waited for 4 minutes for all our food to arrive and we ordered 2 adana kebab wrap, 1 chicken wrap, and liver/chicken mix plate. Overall we on

I really enjoyed the food at Kebapci. The skewers were flavorful and perfectly grilled. Pairing them with the fresh flatbread and charred peppers made for a great, authentic meal. It’s a solid spot for quality street food—I’ll definitely be back!

I recently visited Kebapci Serdar & Naci Street Food and was blown away! They make fresh, authentic kebabs right in front of you — just like in Turkey. I lived in the UK for more than ten years and could never find a place like this, but now in Canada I finally did. The taste truly reminds me of Turkey, especially the flavors from the southeast regions like Batman and Cizre. Even the seating style has a traditional Kurdish touch, which makes it feel like home. Their desserts are also amazing.

Absolutely outstanding experience from start to finish at Kebapci Serdar & Naci Street Food! I tried the Adana kebab wrap and the lamb kebab — the meat was perfectly seasoned, juicy and grilled to perfection. The liver wrap is also a standout: bold flavour, lovely texture.

The vibe is authentic Turkish street-food: you can watch the grill in action, the staff are friendly and welcoming.

Portions are generous and pricing feels very fair for the quality you get. The new location on Finch Ave W is clean, casual and comfortable.

If you’re craving real kebab culture in Toronto — this is it. High

Small menu, you can see the kebabs that are made and then cooked, and the experience is of that of street food.

I've personally enjoyed it, especially the salad with the bread, but it's not for everyone I think.

There are daily specials which are a solid hit.  Especially with the adjacent food court out front.

I tried the tomato sauce pork chop over rice.  The portions are huge!  Easily 1.5 times of any other shop.  There is complimentary soup, tea and dinner roll (raisin bread today)

The flavours are rich and the meat is plentiful and well cooked.  The wa

Super cheap set meals on Tuesday and Thursdays, 9.99 for a main, soup, bakery bun, HK milk tea. Food is cheap and portions huge!!! Took some home in take out containers for dinner. It was about a 35 minute wait after getting our waiting ticket to be seated during lunch time.

None of the mains are really what I would normally order... I think the stir fried rice noodle with chicken (干炒雞河) is the best thing to get here... This used to be a beef dish, now it's chicken...Not exactly what I was expecting. The shredded pork fried noodles was super crispy and saucy... I didn't really like this one..

Fantastic Hong Kong–style restaurant with really delicious food! The dishes were flavorful, comforting, and tasted just like classic Hong Kong cuisine. Portions were generous and everything felt freshly made. The atmosphere was casual and welcoming, perfect for a satisfying meal. Definitely a spot I’d come back to again!

Surprisingly good food here! Without any renovation from previous restaurant, so the inside is dated and can’t be too comfortable. The prices are extremely good, everything is freshly made, service is adequate. You need to give it a try!

reviews:
I usually dont like the taste of tuna sashimi as it can taste "fishy" but this one was great.
Can never go wrong with salmon sushi. Didnt expect for the sashimi to be thick but I can't complain because it was great.
The takoyaki tasted like any other takoyaki, nothing special to it.
The udon soup tasted a little bland to me but the tempura was good.

The restaurant itself was small but cozy. Had about 18 seating. Went there around 4:30pm on a saturday and we were seated right away.

The lady who served us was nice and attentive. Good customer service 👍

I can see why my co-worker recommended this place when I mentioned I wanted some Japanese food after work once. Was covering in the area, and what I love about that part of the job is finding places like this. Good food, fair prices, fast and attentive service.

Also, like that the mug was chilled when it came to me. Nice small detail. As someone who makes cocktails at home and always chills their glasses before pouring the drink in, I really appreciate it.

Good food, great people, cozy place. Very tasty sushi with some unique twists. Definitely fresh ingredients and real salmon eggs which were a great surprise for me! Bento was reasonable and the amount of food in it was great. Family fun, lovely waitress and prompt service. We'll done Maki, not too much rice and very filling! Would definitely recommend if you're in the area, special rolls are big.

A local mom and pop shop which has excellent food. They have lots of order so might have to wait for a bit, but very friendly.
The portions are good and the food’s very tasty. They might have the best agedashi tofu in town.

Will come back!
Ordered a sashimi combo. Best sushi we've had in a long time.

reviews:
Went there and ordered the scampi pasta and jerk chicken.

Had heard it was a great place to go to and was not disappointed had the Medium size Jerk Chicken (lots of chicken) priced at $15.99 with rice and beans and coleslaw all of it fantastic will definitely be returning sometime when back in Toronto. Amazing food and lovely staff. Great price too! Highly recommend the jerk chicken and oxtail curry

I hope the Jerk Lasgna has more chicken. Its priced at 22cad but the serving is small. I think I just found 4-6 chunks of 'jerk chicken' in it. Economy is bad, but I hope restaurant would be fair in what they give to their customers.
my favourite jerk chicken in the city!!! :) so glad rasta pasta will be continued

reviews: Very nice and clean place with good vibes! We got our order not long and was very fresh and lol gone in no time - again if I have to compare with the KFC’s in mississauga orders are messed up and definitely you can make it out that the chicken and fries were not fresh probably mad in Hugh

Absolutely unacceptable.

I ordered KFC through Uber Eats and received sliders that had visible mold on the bread. This is a serious food safety issue and completely inexcusable for a major food chain. It’s clear that there was zero quality control on this order.

Food this unsafe should never leave a kitchen, and it raises serious concerns about how ingredients are stored and handled. I’ve reported the issue to Uber Eats, but honestly, this should be investigated by the local food safety authority immediately.

For your health and safety, I strongly recommend avoiding this KFC location at all

I bought this food in the morning because I was hungry, and what I received was absolutely disgusting. The chicken was old, dry, and clearly stale, and the coleslaw was spoiled. How does this even get served to paying customers? Do you actually believe this is edible?
I wouldn’t feed this to anyone, let alone eat it myself even if I had cooked it. Expecting customers to pay for food in this condition is insulting. This kind of quality explains exactly why this business is going down.
