reviews: Best chicken skewers in the city! Speaking as someone with severe digestive issues, this place is fantastic for good, clean food. Chicken is basically the only meat that I can eat without getting serious stomach upset, but the way that most restaurants prepare usually bothers my guts a bit. All the sauces and spices overwhelm my system, but I've never had any issues with Khayal Shawarma's meat. It's so flavorful despite the fact that it's not covered from end to end in heavy sauces. They have their marinade, but for the most part, the meat speaks for itself, and it's wonderful. The smell of th

This place is big and their menu is a lot bigger

I had the chicken shawarma platter, it comes with rice, salad or fries !!
Side of hummus and tahini

The guys working here were nice to give me all 3.

Their indoor dining was. A problem cuz their door didn’t close and it got very cold.

Coming to the food- the chicken smelled and tasted dry even with a lot of hammus and tahini.

Maybe next time try their shawrma instead !

I went to the grand opening and had mixed feelings. First I loved the chicken shawarma deal which was so delicious! It was bursting with flavours and good size too. The service at counter was friendly too.

My complaint is that I was actually second person at the grand opening but I was pissed off (along with people behind me) because the first person ordered 20 free shawarmas! We didn’t think that was fair to us! The management should have put a cap on limits per person! So we frustratedly waited a long time.

But then to add to my anger they called number 3 to pick up their order and I was p

Overall a average experience. The chicken platter I was served contained a criminal lack of chicken fractions of what you would expect from a chain competitor. My gf got a wrap at a the same time for cheaper with more chicken. Flavor was ok and chef could not understand words like pineapple drink and spicy, two things they serve.

Advice to the restaurant is to give proper or generous servings(maybe I got unlucky).

Great food, great service, the staff is always friendly. Mahmoud was the one who served me - he was friendly and patient and answered any questions I had. The food was and is always amazing, hits the spot every time! Would recommend any of their platters and shawarma!

reviews: This restaurant used to be a 2nd location for Ghoroaa but i heard one of the partners pulled out so they had to change ownership. I had previously visited the restaurant and loved the food and ambiance so I was disappointed when I heard about the management change but after recently visiting the restaurant, I was very pleased. Now the same Khazana from Dhaka has made its debut to Toronto. The quality of the dishes is exceptional, the service is great, the plates are ceramics imported from BD, the fresh sweets are flown in straight from their Dhaka branch. It was a delicious and nice experience

I went to Khazana for dinner with my family and we all loved it! The food was super tasty the kebabs were juicy, the grilled fish was perfectly spiced, and the naan was fresh and soft. The staff were friendly, the service was quick, and the whole atmosphere felt really comfortable. We had such a good time and will definitely be coming back again!

Had a wonderful dinner at Khazana by Khazana Mithai with all my friends. The food was absolutely delicious—especially the kabab platters with naan, full of flavor and perfectly cooked. Great food, great company, and such a memorable evening.

Food is as usual good. We always eat here during weekend. Iftar items taste amazing as usual. But disappointed with the take away service. This is how they packed alur chop; 4 to 5 alu r chop was completely  mashed. Please consider giving them in a box, do not give them in paper packet all jumbled and smashed together.

reviews:
We visited on Friday evening. Around 9:00 PM, there were only a few groups dining, so there were plenty of tables and the space felt quite spacious.

We ordered Kim’s Jeyuk Deop-Bap, a small Tangsuyouk, and Bokkeum Jjamppong. Overall, the portions were great and it was a very satisfying dinner. I loved the spiciness level of the Jjamppong (regular) and the generous amount of shrimp and squid. I'll definitely bring friends back to try more of the menu!

The food is here is absolutely amazing. My second time here because I was craving the jjangmyun and their tangsuyuk. Idk how they make the tangsuyuk so crispy and chewy, but it’s my absolute fave. My cravings always get satisfied when I come here. Before the food even comes I always end up finishing the radish too hahah. This place is awesome.

The menu isn’t huge, which makes picking what to order a lot easier. We got the noodles, and they were perfectly bouncy, while the chicken was crispy but still juicy. Everything was super tasty, and we each got our own bowls to share, which was a nice touch. The prices are really reasonable, and the portions are big! The service was quick too.

The vibe of the place is laid-back and chill, which I liked. It’s not all fancy or anything. They take credit cards but if you bring cash, you get a 10% discount, so that's a win!

Had a late lunch here on Saturday.  It was my first time and I loved it. We arrived around 2pm. Lots of free parking available.  We received a friendly greeting and directed to an open table. Every table had a little tablet to order from. You can also request other items.  Each table has drawers with cutlery and napkins. We ordered Kim's JJamppong and a new item (white JJamppong). The first is spice and had a deepr flavour from the  pork. The second is brimming with smoky flavour. Both are great! And of course the noodles 🍜 are a huge highlight.  We also ordered sweet and sour pork. Very uniqu

We came at 5:30pm on a weekday and ordered jjamppong (regular spicy), jjangmyuen, and yuringi (fried chicken with sweet and spicy sauce). Honestly SO GOOD! Best Kfood I have had in awhile. The tea was nice and strong too. Service was great and the restaurant was clean! So happy!

reviews:
Came here with a few friends and we ordered the mapa tofu with rice, spicy pepper jjamppong, jjajang sauce rice, gochu yuringi, and fried dumplings.

All the food tasted great! My favorite is the mapa tofu with rice. The flavor is different from the traditional Chinese mapa tofu but it tasted amazing! I would definitely come back for that again.

The total bill was close to $100. All the servers are really nice. The place is also really clean.
Decent place. The tangsoyuk was decent and quite crispy. It's a bit different than what I've had before in Korea but still good. I'd definitely come back.

Tried the new Korean-Chinese spot Hongkong Noodle on Eglinton and absolutely loved it! 😍 The flavors are spot on — the Kimchi Mandu was perfectly crispy, the Jangban Jjajang had that deep, rich black bean sauce, and the Kimchi Fried Rice was full of flavor. The Half & Half Shrimp and Kkanpunggi were total show-stoppers — crispy, saucy, and addictive!

The vibe is cozy and clean, and the portions are generous.
Definitely my new go-to spot for Korean-Chinese comfort food in Toronto!

I liked the atmosphere of the restaurant, food definitely filled our craving and staff was kind, attentive, and friendly. Prices were also budget friendly especially if splitting with friends! I would definitely come back again :)

The restaurant is very clean and well maintained, and the staff are incredibly friendly and welcoming.
The food was absolutely delicious everything tasted fresh and full of flavor.
I’m so happy to have a place like this in the neighborhood. Highly recommend 🤍

reviews: Low-key hole in the wall for grab & go delicious patties. The cheese & beef might be my new favorite patty in the city. Flavorful and nice flaky dough. Not much to look at as a restaurant but if you're passing by this is a great snack to go.

I stopped by Kingston 12 Patty Shop on Dundas and tried their beef patty for $4.51 and wow, it was phenomenal. The crust was perfectly flaky, with that golden, buttery crispness you want in a proper Jamaican patty. The beef filling was flavorful and juicy, with bits of fat mixed in.

Now, I’m usually the type to pick out fat, but in this case, it worked. It added richness and depth to the patty that took it to another level. Somehow it just made the whole thing juicier, more satisfying’ it felt like a real, indulgent treat.

So glad this spot is in the neighborhood. Definitely coming back!  Ne

The beef & cheese patty was flavourful although I didn't really get much cheese flavour, visually you can see the cheese but you couldn't taste the cheese. reviews:
If you’re craving bold Japanese comfort food in Midtown, this spot delivers a satisfying mix of rich flavors, generous portions, and quick service.

Pork Spicy Garlic Ramen
The broth is the star — deeply savory with a creamy tonkotsu base and a noticeable garlic punch that builds heat gradually rather than overwhelming the palate. The spice level adds warmth without masking the pork’s natural richness. The noodles are firm and springy, holding up well in the broth, while the chashu pork slices are tender, fatty, and melt-in-your-mouth. Toppings are simple but balanced, letting the broth shine.

We love going to Kinton Ramen all the time, in every season here in Toronto. The ramen is rich and smooth 🥰 especially the original and shoyu flavor. Thank you 😊

I had a great experience at this Korean restaurant. The food was fresh, flavorful, and authentic — especially the bibimbap and Korean fried chicken.

The banchan variety was impressive, and the ambiance felt cozy and modern. Service was friendly and attentive, and prices were reasonable for the quality.

Overall, a solid spot for Korean cuisine that I’d happily recommend.

My boyfriend and I went here for a Sunday dinner. Customer service was great and had no wait time on seating. I give it 3 star due to the fact that both of the ramen we got, the broths were super salty. I had the golden sesame ramen and my boyfriend had the spicy garlic pork ramen. We had Kinton ramen in other locations and the broth weren’t as salty as this location. Maybe someone messed up somewhere on the broths but we couldn’t even finish our ramen due to the saltiness. A little disappointed.

KIYOMI||76 GERRARD ST E M5B 1G6.matchedAddress: 76 Gerrard St E, Toronto, ON M5G 2A7, Canada
reviews:
An amazing omakase experience from start to finish. The ingredients were incredibly fresh, beautifully prepared, and every course was thoughtfully presented.

The atmosphere is intimate and refined, and the chef’s attention to detail really shows. If you’re looking for high-quality omakase in Toronto, this place is absolutely worth it. Highly recommend and would definitely return.

I had the sushi omakase here (there was a special running when I went), and for the price and the amount of food we got, it was totally worth it. Every dish was delicious.

To be fair, there are omakase places in Toronto that might serve higher-grade fish, but you would be paying a much higher price for that. For the value here, the quality is fantastic. I know they also offer a tempura omakase which I haven't tried yet, but I will definitely be back for it.

The chef (who I believe is the owner) is Japanese and incredibly hardworking. He seems to be there day and night preparing and serving.

We recently had the Tempura Omakase with Chef Saito, and it was an incredibly satisfying experience. Every course was thoughtfully prepared, but I especially fell in love with the soup, scallop, eel, shrimp, fish, wagyu, and the blueberry ice cream. The soup and ice cream are both homemade—the soup was light and smooth, while the ice cream offered a refreshing finish to the meal. The seafood and other ingredients are sourced directly from Japan, and you can truly taste the quality. One detail that stood out: they change the frying oil after serving each customer to ensure the tempura remains c

My first tempura omakase experience is great. Cozy, quiet and simple surroundings, friendly chef and staff.

Almost all tempura pieces are great, the coating is not thick so you will not feel so heavy after dozens of pieces, among these 16 courses, my personal favorites are the scallop, which is crunchy outside and tender and juicy inside, no need any extra seasoning, it’s all about the freshness and sweetness of the scallop itself; the little whole fish, it’s so delicious, the meat is juicy and appropriately fatty, very flavorful even without seasoning; the sea urchin, fresh, sweet, reach, cr

Kiyomi’s omakase is a really special experience. The atmosphere feels calm and elegant, which makes the meal even more enjoyable. Each course is beautifully prepared and presented, with fresh ingredients that highlight the quality of the fish. The flavors are clean and delicate, and every bite feels thoughtful and balanced. The chef puts care into explaining the dishes, which makes the whole experience more personal. It’s not just a meal, but more like a food journey that leaves you satisfied without feeling too heavy. It’s a place worth visiting if you want something unique and memorable.

reviews:
The food and service were great!

I highly recommend this place, tried something that was new for me and it was great (pad kra pao holy basil)

The team from Suk Jai Thai Massage had the opportunity to dine at this restaurant, and we were truly impressed. The food was delicious in every dish, with authentic Thai flavors and fresh ingredients. The service was excellent, with attentive and friendly staff, and the atmosphere was warm and welcoming. Highly recommended for anyone looking for great Thai food.

Very generous portions, and flavourful food. Cheap drinks - $5 grey goose shots?! - and reasonable food prices too. Both servers were very kind and attentive, and quick service.

Massaman Curry and Khao Soi were 10/10.

Had a great experience at Koh Rawi Thai Restaurant. The food was fresh, flavorful, and truly authentic Thai taste. Portions were generous and well presented. The staff were friendly, welcoming, and attentive, which made the overall experience even better. The restaurant has a nice, cozy atmosphere and the service was quick. Definitely a great spot for Thai food in Toronto. Highly recommend and will be coming back again!

Ordered vegetarian versions of pad kra pao and red curry for delivery and both dishes were well balanced and delicious! They included some extra chili oil (very tasty!) and the curry included rice, which I wasn't expecting but happy to see. My only critique is that there wasn't enough basil in the pad gra pao. I will definitely try this place again.

reviews:
Was craving sushi at Kensington, my friend and I have big appetites and usually go for all you can eat. We both love inari and have never tried gourmet inari.

The staff is very friendly and kind, and the inside of koi is cute and cozy.

We each had the top 7 and every single inari was amazing. My favorites are the egg + eel and crab + cheese and my friend loves the salmon and bulgogi. The meal was filling! Also, the miso is very fragrant and umami.

The food presentation was beautiful. The restaurant and washrooms are clean and spacious. An overall very pleasant atmosphere.

I will be returni

This hidden gem sushi spot blew my mind! plump spot prawn sushi were divine—creamy, sweet, no fishy taste at all. The chef’s skilled hands crafted perfect bites, and the warm service made the meal even better. Affordable, cozy vibe—10/10, will definitely return!

Didn’t have any reservations anywhere near our concert venue in a very busy night (Valentine’s Day and family day weekend) so looked up sushi near me and thank Google, it led us to Koi - every bite was so delicious and I’ll be back for the torched scallop, torched salmon and spicy beef inari (pocket) sushi. Everything tasted so fresh and delicious and our chef/host/server had the best sweet energy. I rarely like to eat in bright restaurants (lol if you know you know) but as a casual spot, this has such charm! Will be back for more sushi and sake!

Great place for a quick bite or snack, perfect stop if you're a tourist looking to sample lots of different tastes in the Kensington Market area. Had the torched salmon and the dynamite pocket sushi, both excellent, but the salmon was the favorite. Friendly staff, charming space, comfortable, fun sake options.

Experienced this place for the first time today and honestly I'm sad I didn't go here sooner!! The staff was so welcoming and it seemed like such a cozy vibe. I ended up getting the Cheese Crab and Avocado Salmon Pocket Sushi. Both were delicious and I'll definitely be returning 💜

reviews:
I love Thai food! My friends and I went for dinner at Krabi Thai Cuisine near Mt Pleasant and Davisville. It's a cozy spot with good food.

Our evening started with an appetizer platter that included Spring Rolls, Calamari, Shrimp Satay, Samosas, and Mango Salad. We also had some Thai Iced Tea. Everything was good.

Our main courses included the following:
•	Pad See Ew
•	Curry Pad Thai
•	Green Mango Salad
•	Mango Chicken
•	Pineapple Fried Rice
•	Thai Crispy Beef
•	Thai Style Eggplant
•	Malaysian Curry Vegetables

It was all very tasty but the Thai Crispy Beef really stood out for me. It had a

Beautiful decor, busy for takeout, some dishes are tastier than others.

The eggplant dish was beautiful and tasty, I thought the Malaysian Curry was absolutely delicious!

Seemed short staffed the day we went, lots of takeout orders, but between getting the phone, taking orders, serving customers, the lone server was incredible.

I came here with my family and we had such a great experience. The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, and the staff were incredibly patient in walking us through the menu since I’m not very familiar with Thai food. Their recommendations were spot on — everything we tried was delicious. Really appreciate the wonderful service and for making our family dinner so enjoyable. We’ll definitely be coming back!

We had a great experience here! Tried a few dishes and overall really enjoyed the food.

•	Thai Calamari (8.5/10): Crispy, flavorful, and the chips on the side were a nice touch.
•	Pineapple Fried Rice (8.0/10): Tasty and packed with flavor, though a bit on the savory side.
•	General Tao Chicken (8.0/10): Good dish, but maybe not the best pairing with the pineapple fried rice.
•	Khao Soy (9.0/10): Really delicious with rich flavors, though a little on the creamy side.
•	Mango Sticky Rice (10/10): Absolutely perfect—probably the best sticky rice we’ve had anywhere!

Overall, the food was flavor

Pushed myself to try something new and im very grateful it was the Thai spice noodles from this place. Sooo good. Very spicy but in the best way. I was smelling it on my walk home and knew it was going to be amazing just from that.

reviews: We went to a friend's 60th birthday party at this restaurant.   The carpaccio was very fresh tasting.  The fettuccine bolognese was nice.  The rack of lamb was juicy and very tasty.  The tiramisu was a nice way to finish.  Robert.the GM and Stephen gave us the best service.   Min auto-gratuity for groups is 18%, fair enough for their service standard. I highly recommend anyone looking to book a large party to come to Le Fenice Tuscan Grill.

La Fenice is incredible, ate here for the first time on Valentine’s day. Very comfortable setting staff was beyond friendly and food was incredible! Would highly recommend to anyone. If you ask me to find something wrong with this place you’ll be waiting a while because I had no complaints at all. Incredible thanks again to the staff!

This place is truly a hidden gem! From the moment my family and I walked in to celebrate my birthday over dinner, Roberto, who was both the manager and our server, made us feel incredibly welcome. He was attentive, knowledgeable about the menu and offered great recommendations on the best dishes to try. The food was outstanding but the service was just as impressive. I’m so grateful to Roberto for making my birthday dinner such a memorable experience. If you are in downtown Toronto, this restaurant is definitely worth a visit! ✨🍽️

The pasta here was on the saltier side, compared to other places I’ve been food quality was below average especially for the price.

Service was quick but that was also because the place was otherwise empty.

Tiramisu was also below average.

Took my husband for his birthday dinner here.  Our server was wonderful.  The food was exceptional.   The food was authentic, fresh and perfectly prepared.  It was comparable to our experience in Italy. My husband also got a candle on his dessert which was a nice surprise.  The only room for improvement would be to space out diners.  The restaurant was not busy when we went but the had all 5 occupied tables were beside each other and it got quite loud at times.  The diners were a mix of walk ins and reservations.

reviews:
I visited La Golosa Gelateria yesterday and had an absolutely delightful experience. The shop exudes a warm and inviting atmosphere, perfect for enjoying a sweet treat. I tried the Espresso and Bacia flavours, and both were incredible rich, creamy, and full of flavour.

The staff were friendly and attentive, making the visit even more enjoyable. The shop was clean and well-organized, adding to the pleasant vibe. I’ll definitely be back to try more flavours!

I was looking for an americano and walked into this new gelato shop in Toronto. What a great find! There were so many gelato flavours that I’m definitely coming back to try. The americano was delicious, smooth, and very well priced. The staff was very friendly, and they mentioned they plan to expand their beverage offerings, as they don’t currently have a  menu. I really hope they do well - it’s such a charming café and gelato spot that’s perfect for coffee and dessert lovers alike.

I stopped by La Golosa Gelataria and absolutely loved it! I tried the vanilla and strawberry zeppole along with the mango matcha gelato, and everything was so fresh, flavorful, and unique. The zeppole were light yet indulgent, and the mango matcha was such a refreshing twist, perfectly balanced and not too sweet.
The shop itself has a cozy, welcoming vibe, and the staff were friendly and helpful with recommendations. You can really taste the quality and care that goes into their desserts. Definitely a spot I’ll be returning to whenever I’m craving authentic, creative treats!

Have gone to this place at least 10 times since they opened and they are attached to my building and it was always great but this time was pretty bad . Cherry cheesecake which I always get was clearly expired with the dark colors and cocoa powder meant to cover up the taste . Dont even get me started on the smore cookie . Place has been amazing but im assuming they were trying to get rid of inventory before they close for the weekend. Normally is excellent but this time was absolutely brutal .

Came by tonight and was served by Nicole. She was so sweet and patient with myself and my partner as we were very indecisive because the selection of gelato is absolutely beautiful! After we had our samples, Nicole stuffed our cups until it almost popped apart. Great staff, clean environment and AMAZING gelato. 10/10 bonus points for my baby loving the cookie topper🤍

reviews:
We keep going back for the pepper shrimp 🦐. Great food. We've had the jerk chicken and pork. The cuts of meat were well seasoned and generous. Spicy enough to compliment the dish but not overpower the flavor profile. The festival were soft and not too sweet. I should have ordered more. Their house juices are great, a tad bit sweet, but if you know church juice you know the deal.
This is a new establishment so it is polished and well maintained. I appreciate the coco plant and orchid. You can tell the family takes great pride in everything they do...from the food to the dining space Lezma's Kit

Food was good. The oxtail and the jerk pork had a sweet undertone which I don't usually like but my girl likes. But even it having a sweet undertone I still enjoyed it. My jerk pork doesn't really look like some of the other photos I've seen of the jerk pork from this place. I will come back and try their Seafood menu like the curry conch and the pepper shrimp. Also should offer a cash discount to compete with all the other vendors in the area as pretty much everyone doesn't charge tax for cash payment just a suggestion

Oxtail: 8/10
Jerk pork: 8/10

Authentic Caribbean Flavors with a Homestyle Touch

I recently visited Lezma’s Kitchen and was really impressed! The food tastes truly authentic—just like a home-cooked Jamaican meal. The jerk pork and jerk chicken was packed with flavor and cooked perfectly.

Portions are generous, prices are fair, and you can tell everything is made with care.

The staff were friendly, welcoming, helpful, and the overall vibe felt warm and inviting—like eating in a family kitchen.

I’ll definitely be coming back and recommending this spot to friends. If you’re craving authentic Caribbean food in Toronto, thi

The food was great, seasoned perfectly and tasted amazing! The oxtail was fall off the bone perfect! Even the rice they used was a nice long grain and had a good flavour. I didn’t have the BBQ this time but the smell was to die for! I highly recommend the juice - this time I had the fruit punch and it had a ginger twist!!!
The restaurant was clean - you know your food was made with love and care. I appreciate all the small details they put into everything, down to the uniforms each person working there wore.
Such nice people - very professional and helpful.
The owners are very friendly and they are really welcoming. The food taste great. My favorite meal is the festival and jerk chicken. The festival is always freshly made. Well done.

reviews:
This place is an absolute gem for Turkish cuisine. The shawarma is incredibly flavorful, perfectly seasoned, and cooked to perfection—tender, juicy, and satisfying in every bite. The portions are generous, and the ingredients taste fresh and high quality.

The staff are welcoming, friendly, and clearly care about both the food and the customer experience. Service is fast without feeling rushed, which makes it a great spot whether you’re dining in or grabbing takeout.

If you’re looking for authentic, delicious Turkish food with excellent service and great value, this spot is a must-visit. I wi

My first shawarma!!! Popped in on a whim as I was taking the bus home.
I ordered a chicken wrap. Food was well seasoned, a generous portion, fresh and warm, they even gave me a free piece of baklava which was delicious as well !! Excellent customer service would definitely recommend.
Restaurant was nice and clean. Well lit.
Bathroom was nice and clean as well.

Wonderful restaurant, great staff, affordable food and amazing taste. I recommend everyone to come here and give it a try. Also I strongly recommend their lahmacun+lentil soup, best combo ever. At the end of the food they offer you to drink turkish tea which is free.

Great place, even greater people, and outstanding food. Do not let the low prices fool you—this spot delivers generous portions and genuinely delicious food. If it were up to me, I would have all of Toronto try their food at least once. You will love it. On top of that, they even offered me a free tea on the house, which speaks volumes about their hospitality. Finally, I have found a place that is truly about shawarma—real shawarma—not just drowning everything in garlic sauce. There is a difference, and this place gets it right.

Tried it for the first time.
Salih is the outstanding host, friendly, welcoming, generous, top-notch service.  Affordable prices and luxury look combined, appealing interior design,  royal blue +white furniture🥰, soft new chairs,  spacious washroom with baby change table and cool matching red soap and paper towel dispensers, upbeat modern Turkish music from a speaker with appropriate volume.  Everything is well- thought and done with intent to ensure the best possible customer experience.  I ordered the simpliest takeout chicken doner for 9.99 and was given "to try" a thin crust crunchy saucy

reviews:
Liliana was a solid spot. We usually go to the same Italian restaurant, so it was nice to switch it up and try somewhere new in town.

The beef carpaccio was definitely the highlight. It came with a chili aioli and it was so good, easily the most memorable dish of the night. We also had the octopus, mushroom pappardelle, strip loin, and the millefoglie for dessert. Everything was well done and enjoyable.

I did notice quite a few Asian inspired elements throughout the menu. It was creative, but personally I would have preferred it to lean more into classic Italian flavours. I am definitely not

I don't usually dine out at Italian restaurants but I was very intrigued by the inspired nature of the menu and many rave reviews. It didn't quite live up to these high expectations but was a nice experience still.
- cocktails: Violet $20: alcoholic cucumber water; marigold $22: smokey; creative but wouldn't reorder either of these
- beef carpaccio $26: delicious, I could taste the Asian 🤪
- aglio e olio $30: couldn't taste the chili crisp. I was expecting something like Lonely Diner's stracciatella toast. Great texture on the spaghetti though
- troffie $35: delicious, this had that extra "som

We celebrated a birthday at Liliana for my wife and highly recommend it. Food and service was exceptional. Every bite was incredibly delicious! We loved talking with Chef Marvin and the top notch service from Nick was unforgettable. This is Michelin quality food and service in an unpretentious, welcoming environment. reviews:
I visited LIMAQ and honestly, I was very impressed. I tried the fish ceviche, and it was excellent, very fresh fish, proper cuts, and perfectly prepared.

It came with everything a true Peruvian ceviche should have: canchita serrana, chifles, and sweet potato. Everything was well balanced and full of authentic flavor.

You can really tell there is care and respect for Peruvian cuisine. Great quality and attention to detail. Highly recommended!!!

Excellent Peruvian food.
I had the ceviche with chicharrón, and it was delicious — very fresh fish, well-balanced leche de tigre, and crispy chicharrón that paired perfectly with the ceviche.
Authentic flavors and good quality ingredients.
Definitely a place I’d recommend if you’re craving real Peruvian food.

reviews: 巡南记 Litsea Cuisine absolutely blew me away—so authentic it felt like I’d traveled back to Yunnan in China’s southwest. Bright herbs, tingling peppercorns, and clean, sour-spicy flavors were spot on. The Yunnan-style rice noodles were silky, the mushroom dishes deeply fragrant, and the cold herb salads so fresh and addictive. Portions were generous, beautifully plated, and everything tasted homemade in the best way. The team was warm and attentive, and the cozy decor added to the experience. 如果你想吃到真正的云南味道，强烈推荐！ Highly recommend for anyone craving real Yunnan cuisine.

We had such an amazing dining experience at Litsea in North York! The restaurant specializes in authentic Yunnan cuisine, and every dish we tried was full of unique flavors and beautifully presented.

Highly recommend the Yunnan Rice Noodle Pot, Grilled Pork Neck, Spicy Agaric Salad, and the Wild Mushroom Steam-Pot Chicken Soup, all so delicious. The Hand-Grabbed Rice is a must-try, and don’t miss their signature desserts like Pao Lu Da.

The service was attentive and friendly, and the overall atmosphere was warm and welcoming. Perfect for gatherings since they also offer set menus for 6, 8, o

Amazing, amazing, amazing. So authentic I’m in tears. It’s really hard to find authentic Yunnan cuisine in Toronto, and I really love how this store has the courage to tackle a good assortment of different dishes from Yunnan. We’ve been back twice over the past week. We ordered their hotpot and a couple dessert items the first time, and had fish, beef, and chicken soup the second time. Everything was super authentic and really well presented. The price and portions are good too. The staff is very friendly, and the overall atmosphere is chill. We look forward to coming back here a dozen more ti

Finally got a chance to try this place and we ordered the hot pot with the wild mushroom soup base, as well as the small pot rice noodles and fried rice cakes. I recommend skipping the hot pot — it’s nothing special. The small pot rice noodles weren’t bad, and the sticky stir-fried rice cakes were actually pretty good. I’d come back for their stir-fry dishes. The seating was also comfortable.

My family’s first time trying Yunnan cuisine and we were surprised by the presentation and flavours. We got the dai-style rice platter and hotpot to share. The plating was beautiful and customer service was friendly. My family really enjoyed the hotpot free range chicken broth as it was flavourful.

reviews: On the back of a recent YT food review video, went and visited MT Fishball Noodle shop in the heart of Scarborough. We ordered a variety of items except for the infamous fish-meat "Siu Mai" for which, the owner said they didn't have time to make as the line up was robust throughout the day before. Despite of their beyond moderate prices, quality was surely above average on all fronts. The handmade fish-balls, braised beef, rice rolls all ha

The best Fishball noodles I ever have in Scarborough. Big portions with very reasonable price.
This is my forth time visit and becoming my “canteen “, very HK style noodles and street snacks.
Definitely must try curry fishball and fishball noodles.

The staff here is so friendly and patient when taking order, and even gave us a slice of cake as a treat, which is very surprising.
I will definitely come back again for lunch and dinner.

This is a great no frills place for HK-style fishball noodles, beef noodles, and rice noodle rolls. The set meals are very affordable ($9 to $10 for noodles, including veggies and drink or $6 for rice noodle roll and drink). The portions are generous, and both the fishball and beef noodles had lots of toppings.

Nothing is mind-blowing or gourmet, but that's not the point here; it's solid comfort food! The owners were nice, and service was relatively fast.

The space is not big, with a few seats against the wall, so more of a spot to grab a quick bite or takeout.

MT Fishball Noodle: Solid Set Meal

Overall Rating: This is a fantastic, reliable spot for an affordable and quick meal. The overall experience definitely meets a good standard, especially considering the price.

The fishballs had a nice fish meat flavor, even if they weren't very springy. The Iced Lemon Tea was well-made with a perfectly strong tea flavor.

Environment & Service: The shop is small, but it's ve

Really enjoyed a quiet lunch here.  Place feels authentic and found lots of beef in the braised beef noodles, the fish ball noodles had very soft fish.  Liked the richness of their HK milk tea. Would definitely come back to try the other menu items.  (Wish there was just a little more space for more seating.)

Ordered the Butter Chicken, Garlic Naan, and Mirchi Parantha from Masala Story, and honestly, it felt like I was eating back in Delhi/Punjab. The flavors were truly authentic — something I haven’t experienced often in Toronto.

If you think you’ve had Indian food in Toronto but haven’t tried Masala Story, you need to give it a shot. The flavour bomb will blow your mind and take you straight to the streets of North India — Delhi, or Dilli as we Delhi people call it.

So thrilled to have found this gem in the heart of Toronto.

Finally, a restaurant that doesn’t rely on mass-produced sauces, but delivers true, authentic, OG Indian food. Butter chicken, dal makhni, nihari, fresh tandoori rotis — every bite tastes real.

Masala Story is here to redefine Indian food in Toronto. Enough said.

reviews: Solid take on Detroit style. Crispy crust and dough wasn’t overly dense. Loaded with cheese and toppings. Enjoyed the mushroom pizza the most. Had the mc boy too, but thought it could’ve been better without bell peppers and subbed hot peppers or jalapeños instead. They also have bogo wings on Monday and Tuesdays for $15 which is a solid deal. The wings were a decent size, crispy and seasoned well.

People will naturally want to compare McMan Pizza to Descendents and given they both produce the same product a straight up comparison is perfectly valid.  So how does it compare? IMHO it doesn't surpass Descendants. Does it equal Descendants, probably not. Having said that, a McMan Pizza is approximately $6 less expensive then Descendants; I definitely enjoyed the pizza and would order from here again. However, there where two principal concerns a) it appears the mushrooms on the McBoy pizza are canned and b) the pizza could have stayed in the oven for a few minutes more as there was a subtle

Maaaaaaaaan this place does Detroit style pizza right. Got the McBoy and it was everything you'd want: generous toppings soaked in tasty sauce, bouncy focaccia-like crust that was wonderfully chewy, and edges that were properly crispy. If there's one thing I would have wanted more of, it's that beautiful cheese.

Bonus points for being this good even if I got it via delivery.

Wow is all we can say! The food is absolutely amazing & delicious. We will definitely be ordering again! We had the wings + Spaghetti + red velvet cake & funghi pizza.. We will definitely be ordering again!

The customer service is just as amazing as their food!

Top notch Detroit style pizza. Had the McBoy and the cheese was melted perfectly, with layers that wasn’t over done with toppings and tastefully put together. Crust was crispy, the toppings wasn’t overwhelming the sauce was flavourful.  I run pizza forward events, travel the world trying pizza, and this really gives Detroit pizza its respects. Will be back.

reviews:
Wonderful marriage of Mexican and Pakistani flavours. I have always wanted this fusion because they truly are meant for each other and I am extremely happy to know it has been done.

I was weary at first because it is something that is easy to mess up or not go far enough with, but to my pleasant surprise it was just the right amount of fusion. It blended foundation Pakistani and Mexican flavours with finesse — biryani and cheese as a base foundational and protein to pair — into a taco I would be proud to serve myself. I can’t even imagine the amount of labour that goes into each taco. birria

I happened to discover this place by accident when I casually glanced to my left while walking, and I'm so glad I did! It's everything I love about both cuisines put together. I had the beef kabob taco and it tasted sooo good, it had rice and peas and onion and meat etc all in a crispy-yet-nicely-chewy shell. The food tasted fluffy and home-made, and not overly oily or overly spicy. The chutney/salsa smelled fresh.

The dessert was also great. The Mexican flan was soft and not too sweet, and the kheer tasted like the kind of kheer you get at desi weddings.

Overall I'm still dreaming about tha
I’ve been saying Mexican and Pakistani food would go so well together as a Pakistani myself. And wow was I proven right. What a beautiful blend of cuisines. Thank you so much for the amazing food
We loved it and will be back sooon!! Great prices, amazing food, great service. Love the decor. The Okra tacos and chicken tikka tacos were so yummy.

Delicious homemade torta and tacos!! Wonderful and friendly owners,  you can really tell the food is made with love and passion to bring you the best exceptional dishes. My little pit stop before home now, finally a fusion taco spot in the neighborhood! A must try if your around no doubt, I ate the torta and had a jarrito to wash it down. The price is right as well can’t go wrong

The ONLY downside is the limited hours of operation. Would love to see you open for lunch from like 11-2 then open again at 4 for dinner. I work from home and would LOVE to have such a quick, easy and delicious option!

Great value for the amount of food you get in Every portion!

Welcome to the Neighbourhood!
Amazing family! Can’t wait to go back!! 🙌
Amazing food. Fresh, high-quality ingredients prepared using traditional flavourful recipes. Clean/modern dining room with lots of natural light and cozy Mexican touches. Great, fast service.

So happy to have this family run restaurant in the neighborhood. Authentic Mexican flavours and reasonable prices. Love that you can try different dishes by ordering combos. The beef chimichanga was delicious. Service was fast and friendly.

We had an amazing family dinner with our young kids. They loved the guacamole, tacos and churros. I had the chimichanga and my husband had the burrito meal. The food was honestly so delicious I can't wait to come back. It felt like a home cooked meal and the owners are so kind and make you feel so welcomed. Authentic family owned restaurant can't wait to make this a regular place for us!

reviews:
I came here with a friend and we got the la casa meal and the seco de chivo and churros.

The la casa meal was okay. The grilled steak was more like stew beef and it was overly salty. The sausage pretty good. Veggie rice was okay. The best part was the pantacones for me.

The seco de chivo was okay. The goat stew was pretty good.

The churros were good but way too pricey for the size.

Just look at the horror story they served me!

When I called them about it to explain in a friendly manner about the “seco de pollo nightmare”, they were immediately passive aggressive and rude.

They even made up lies about the whole conversation!

The chicken and plantain could choke you to death.

The rice was 100% mush.

If I were the restaurant owner I’d be very concerned.

Do better, please!!!! 🙏

Got take out from this place tonight I am extremely disappointed. They took the Seco de Pollo literally and gave us the driest, blandest chicken I’ve ever tasted with overcooked rice. My husband can make a better Seco de Pollo and he’s only half ecuadorian. Their ceviche is made mainly of tomato and onion, and they were kind enough to put 3 tiny shrimps to actually get to call it ceviche. Will not be buying from this place again. Do not waste your money.

Started with the empanadas and nachos. Both great but the nachos (although the small size) could’ve had a bit more chips in it.

First time having Guaya fried rice and I was pleasantly surprised.

My wife had the sandwich and enjoyed it.

My mother in law had the Seco de Chivo and mentioned that there could’ve been more meat on the bone.

Overall, we enjoyed our visit.
Location was a bit hard to find and there’s limited street parking. There is a customer only washroom available.  Staff were great and the food was delicious.
Fantastic, authentic tacos. We had the beef, carne asada, chicharron, and fish. Spectacular flavours and great service!

reviews:
Went for the viral chicken curry Udon, and it did not disappoint. The combination of western creamy sauces with chewy Udon is genius. I fully expect this concept to appear at more noodles places across the GTA in the coming year.

I’ve seen some reviews on here complaining about the portion sizes. I would tend to disagree. I can usually eat a lot, 2 foot longs at subway type. The sauce is so creamy and rich that a single portion was perfect to leave me stuffed but not heavy.

I personally preferred the spicy seafood cream udon. More complex flavors and a good amount of seafood for a dollar mor

Me and my friends just came here for the first time. We’re from Mississauga and my other friend came from Hamilton, it was so worth it. The food was amazinggg, we ordered much more than we could eat. The prices are really affordable for the portion sizes. Everything was amazing, fast clean service, the Manager Miyoung was absolutely amazing, welcoming, attentive, and so sweet. We are definitely coming back here!

A charming udon bar with lovely service and very friendly, attentive staff who offer suggestions if you’re unsure what to order.

Food:

- Chicken Curry Udon: Highly recommended in many reviews and it did not disappoint. It’s a little heavy, so if you’re looking for a light meal, consider something else.

- Buta Udon: Delicious, fragrant broth with light and tender pork belly. The noodles were nice and chewy.

If you’re craving comforting Japanese food done right, Mikaku Udon Bar absolutely delivers. The udon was so good perfectly chewy noodles, rich flavorful broth, and everything tasted fresh and thoughtfully prepared. The portion sizes were generous too, which made it feel like great value for the quality you’re getting. You leave feeling full and satisfied, not like you need to grab something else after.

What really stood out was the service. It was incredibly fast and genuinely sweet and attentive without being overbearing. The whole experience felt smooth from start to finish. Definitely a sp

Amazing food, amazing service, amazing decor. Yes, they offer alcohol but their chicken are halal. It's always a treat to find Halal Japanese food. Service was very nice and friendly. Of course most importantly, the food is amazing and reasonably priced.

Pictured is the fried shrimp gyoza(totally recommended menu item) and vegetable soup udon.

reviews:
Been wanting to try this place for a while. Super happy they opened this location in North York.

The food was amazing and it was great that you get so many different refill options (egg noodle, sweet potato noodle, rice noodle & rice). I had the dry noodle with meat sauce & peanuts. It was amazing and the sauce still held up after my 2nd refill.

Service was amazing as well. Jordan was the gentleman helping us and he was great.

Total for my dry noodles + my girlfriend’s bowl was $42 (after tax and service). For that price for the 2 of us and the amount we ate (4 refills for me 0 for her) thi

Absolutely hits the spot it you are craving spicy and savoury chinese snacks, reminds me of street food in China. The desserts are good too! This is a causal spot, prices are very reasonable. We shared a noodles dish, two sides and dessert for around $40! Lots of yummy options to try! Will be back! Service was quick and very friendly.

I went to Modu Three Brothers (North York location) for dinner and it was such a great experience! The food was absolutely delicious — I especially loved the Classic Stir-Fried Beef with Cilantro and Sichuan Peppers (very spicy in my opinion, but so good!) and the Lamb Skewers, which were super flavorful.

Service was quick and efficient, and the restaurant itself was clean, bright, and comfortable. Definitely a place I’ll be coming back to when I’m craving bold, spicy flavors!

Fantastic food and great service. The stir-fried dish was packed with bold flavors, perfectly cooked, and nicely balanced with just the right amount of spice. Fresh ingredients, generous portions, and excellent rice to go with it. You can really taste the care put into the cooking. Highly recommended — will definitely be back!

reviews: More Gelato has quickly become a family favourite. The sweetest couple run this quaint little spot in the junction and you can see how much passion and dedication go into every detail - Not just the product. The staff, the atmosphere and decor, All very intentionally chosen! As someone who has had dietary restrictions for the better part of my children's lives, Having a spot that we can go as a family that offers options that are safe for all of us, makes such a huge difference for us. It's no longer just me sitting there watching my kids enjoy their treats. We can now grab our favourite froze

This place SLAPS.

Clearly a labour of love by the owners, and you can tastes that in their product.

Tried hazelnut, coffee and chocolate cherry chilli. All were amazing!

Hazelnut stood out to me as the creamiest with chunks of crunchy something in it. So good.

Excited to have them in the neighborhood and to eat more of their ice cream.

Will be back often.
Amazing service and excellent gelato! They have the classic flavours, but also interesting creations that are worth trying. I highly recommend it!

Such amazing gelato! Really nice texture and interesting ever changing flavours. Both myself and my wife loved it! Beautifully designed interior. The owners Zaira and AJ are lovely people. This is sure to be a junction staple. Go try their amazing ice cream!

What an incredible little nook, but the real star is how casually incredible the gelato is. I really couldn’t decide but I opted for a mini Chocolate Cherry Chili with a pint of Passionate Coconuts for home - looking forward to trying more!

reviews: We just moved into the area and our neighbours introduced us to Morso Me. So happy to have delicious Italian cuisine just a couple of minutes away. Ordered the BOGO Alfredo and it’s the best Alfredo we’ve ever eaten!  Perfectly al dente fettuccine with a creamy sauce and a hint of honey. And for dessert, we tried the Baci cannoli and the Lemon Coconut Cannoli—both are out of this world incredible!  This restaurant is our forever go to from now on.

Such a lovely experience! Even though it’s mainly a catering and takeout place, they kindly let us sit at one of their two small tables to enjoy our food there. Everything was served in takeout containers, but it was absolutely delicious — the lasagna, pasta with meatballs, calzone, and especially the dessert: cannoli! The lady who seemed to be the owner was very friendly and welcoming. They also sell their special sauce and a DIY cannoli package, which is a fun idea for gatherings. Overall, a warm and tasty experience!
Excellent Italian food.  More of a take out place, but we were able to sit at a table and eat. Had a great chat with the owner Maria.  All food was delicious! Would definitely recommend.

The staff are also so friendly. Highly recommend to everyone!

I would highly recommend everyone to visit.

reviews:
Walked past and decided to check it out on a whim.
What a lovely place to spend a couple hours reading. Had a delicious hojicha latte that was reasonably priced, with free milk options!

Will definitely be back to check out their manga library another day.

This is a hidden café gem spot, The place has a nice slow relaxing music running in the background. The price and the portions of the food is excellent. I would highly recommend everyone to try at least once if you are in this neighbourhood.

Loved this place! I worked from there for a few hours and really loved the calm and peaceful ambience. I had the Ube chai latte and the tofu and mushroom donburi, both were delicious. Especially the plant based rice bowl was very flavourful. The calm no lyric music in the background was heavenly for my 30-something year old ears 😂 I’ll surely be a frequent customer!

Stopped by this newly opened manga cafe and had a really nice experience. The atmosphere is calm and comfortable, a great place to sit and read for a bit. I ordered the beef teriyaki donburi, which was satisfying and flavorful, along with an iced hojicha latte with sweet potato syrup that was surprisingly good and nicely balanced. Everything felt thoughtfully done. Would definitely come back!

Stumbled upon this spot with my friends and I'm really glad we went in! Just opened a few weeks ago. We were pleasantly surprised that it was a manga cafe and the selection was excellent. We ordered the salmon onigiri which was very flavourful, generously sized and made fresh. My friends got the chai latte and hojicha latte. The tables were spacious and the chairs were really comfy. Perfect place to do work and read! If you're thinking about checking this place out, would definitely recommend! Looking forward to the events that will be hosted here in the future ^u^

I was absolutely astonished that my pizza would be delivered in this condition. It’s really sad. Knowing about the roots of this company starting in Birmingham,UK, and making it all the way to Canada, I felt proud of a Sikh owned business and wanted to support it. Tasty vegiterean food, left me with a nice different clean satisfied feeling. Delicious, you won't even realize it's veg! The plant based bites are just like chicken nuggets, and even better. Delicious!

Being a South Asian myself & pizza being one of my all time fave foods, I had never tried Indian style pizza before. I read the reviews for Mr. Singh's & wanted to try them but I was very skeptical. I have lived in Toronto for over 35 yrs. So I've tried pizzas at chains, casual chains, restaurants that have been around for 40+ yrs, pizza restaurants in Little Italy etc. I picked up the tandoori chaap pizza today for lunch & I WAS BLOWN AWAY!! Yes the flavours are non traditional but it was one of the best pizzas I have had anywhere. The crust was soft & delicious. The toppings & cheese with th

Referring to Jim's review, tell me your racist, without telling me your racist. The audacity to write a review when you haven't even tried the pizza, only making reference to how "different" it is from the Italian place before it. A place being empty isnt an indication of it being good or bad, many people order take out. Either try the "product" and write an authentic review or buy the business yourself if you want it to stay the same ... stop negatively affecting small businesses

BTW,  this is good south asian style veggie pizza!

I used to come to this place all the time when it was previously Calabrese Pizza, which was a nice Italian Mom and Pop shop.  Their pizza and other Italian pastas and sandwiches were awesome.

I wish the current ownership would have decided to take over the previous business using the already established name and products, and continued the operation. Rather than establishing something totally brand new. People in the neighborhood and community knew this place as Calabrese Pizza, and there's something to be said about already established clientele being familiar with a business over the years.

reviews: Mr. Singh pizza, humber is one of the best place for vegetarian’s people. All foods are delicious and healthy. They have also started new dishes- gol gappe and chaat papdi with different flavours. I like all flavour water of gol gappe but mongo flavour is new one. So, I recommend to everyone should go and try to this restaurant food. It is really awesome place.

I recently tried this pizza shop and honestly, the pizza was not good. The taste, texture, and overall quality were disappointing. It felt like the basics of making a proper pizza were missing.

The only thing I liked was the garlic bread — that was actually good and had decent flavor.

In my opinion, the shop seems to have opened too quickly without perfecting the core product. Pizza is the main item, and it should be the strongest point. I hope they take feedback seriously and improve their quality.

reviews: We were walking the main street and saw the signage - this is a gem! Very affordable and food is really good. They sell bowls (including rice, protein and plenty of toppings!). They also have variety of sauces. It was really loaded. Whenever I crave for Korean food, I'll come here. Also, their customer service is really good even recommending what would go well with the food and warning if the food is too spicy. Btw, spicy teokbeoki was really goood too. Try their combo $18.99 for food + side dish + drink! Where else can you get this type of deal? With chef's kiss flavor! They even gave us a c

I was walking by on Bloor Street West when I saw an employee putting out a Street sign. I came in and was greeted right away. He explained the menu and specials. I placed my order and he made suggestions and I am glad he did. The food was delicious!! I ordered a large spicy chicken rice bowl with lettuce, mushrooms, kimchi, and corn. It comes with a pop. He was generous with the chicken which I appreciate. I will be back!!

I just wanted to take a moment to express my gratitude for the unforgettable experience every time I visit. From the moment I walk through the door, I know I'm about to enjoy something truly special. The flavors you craft are always fresh, bold, and full of heart – each bite is a reminder of the love and care you put into every dish.

Absolutely delicious! You choose a base bowl, then decide what type of rice, veggies, sauces, and other delights are added in with your protien. Additional cost for special add-ons like lotus root, garlic scapes, shittake, etc. (So worth it!) You have control over how spicy your dish is, so if spice is an issue, you have options.

Staff were very friendly and generous, the space is bright and clean.

Absolutely amazing! The food at Mura Cupbop is super delicious and the staff are incredibly friendly. Every bowl is packed with flavor and feels so fresh. The prices are really reasonable too — such great value for the quality and portion size. Honestly, this place is a hidden gem in Toronto and I can’t recommend it enough. Definitely coming back!

reviews:
absolutely delicious, 10/10.

i ordered by delivery, and i got the crispy spicy salmon.
usually when i get sushi delivered, the rice gets a little gummy, and the crispy / spicy tempura gets a little soggy. totally understandable, it’s being cramped up into a plastic container, sat out for a bit, then followed by a good jostle around in a bag during transport across the city.

not in this case. the crunch was so satisfying, the salmon was INSANELY fresh, and the rice was the perfect consistency.
the way they packed it was so considerate as well. i was very pleasantly surprised.

i also was able

Sorry for the empty trays, but honestly, there’s no better compliment than finishing everything. I always order through Uber Eats and this place never disappoints. The flavors are absolutely incredible, the fish is super fresh, and I can confidently say these are the best takoyaki I’ve ever had. So, so good!

My Sushi has been my favourite restaurant ever since moving to the area. I normally order for pick up, especially for when I get tired after work. Service is great, staff is friendly. I’m unsure why people have complaints over being sick since I order here almost every week. I don’t think people should be complaining over the smell of fish when you literally paid to eat fish.

Thank you My Sushi!

Avoid this place. The restaurant looked dirty and poorly maintained, and the atmosphere felt empty and uncomfortable.

The biggest issue was the service. The owner’s attitude was extremely rude and aggressive. The interaction escalated quickly, and it honestly felt like it could turn into a confrontation. As a customer, I did not feel safe or respected.

On top of that, the food didn’t taste fresh, which was very disappointing. Overall, this was a negative experience and I wouldn’t recommend spending your money here.

reviews:
Completely unsurprised how fantastic this meal was given it’s the same folks behind Dreyfus and Bernhardt’s.

Sat at the bar and got a martini. Bartender graciously walked us through the menu, sharing his favourites. We took some of the recommendations; loved the tuna tartar, olives (so unique!), and the eggplant. We also got the cabbage which was in a light but creamy sauce, and two pastas. Sadly our 2 hour reservation wasn’t quite long enough and we had to rush towards the end, bu

The radicchio salad was tasty. The pasta was okay, not the star of the show for me. The ricotta filling in the ravioli lacked depth of flavour. The almond tart was the best dessert.

I love the interior design of this restaurant and the staff were lovely. We didn’t, however, love any of the dishes we had. The salt cod on toast was the best of the bunch. The beef tartare had mild flavour and is a bit a pain to eat with crumbly chips. The ricotta ravioli with chanterelle mushrooms was also light in flavour. The tagliatelle ragu had nice texture and papery thin pasta, but overall uneventful. I think had we stopped there, we might have thought it was a decent dinner. reviews:
I can see this being a neighbourhood favourite for years to come - a truly special concept that fits in perfectly in the Yonge and Sheppard area. For around $25, you can get a great Korean entree with delicious unlimited sides, Korean coffee, ice cream, soup, and dessert. You will 100% leave stuffed, in my case I was full before my main even arrived.

The highlight of the meal is definitely the extras, as the main dish was tasty but not unlike what you could get at another restaurant in the area. I tried the summer special lime soba, and my partner tried the curry katsu. I think the soba was b

Food was average. Not much crowd when we arrived. We were able to be seated immediately. Seating was available for group or solo. There is a 75-minute dining limit. Everything was unli except for the ice cream which was 1 per person. I enjoyed the Bibimbap and the sidings. The coffee tastes good, just like what you get in a typical Korean vending machine. Overall experience was satisfactory.

Decided to try this place out. Some honorable mentions they do front coat check behind their counter you need to tell that that. The seating area is very tight and cramped. Am told max patrons inside is 160. The area to get food is small and tight so don't go rushing to get food and be careful when you swing around can easily bump into someone. The food at lunch was ample enough. The servers kept refilling and removing plates. Some stand outs to me were the Bulgogi beef, cream soup, that peanut sauce near the katsu, the Stripped eggs, and the fruity popsicle. I only aimed for the beef it was d

Amazing experience! Felt like you were transported back to Korea with the unlimited side dishes. Unlimited soup, rice, yogurt drinks, side dishes (marinated shrimps as well!)and sauces. They had miso and cream soup options. Meals average around $24-28 for lunch and there is a cash discount. I believe dinner prices are a little higher. When you’re finished your meal you can also get a free popsicle and a coffee. Soju flights were $14.99. I got the pork katsu with a side of bbq meat. The bbq meat was super Smokey and delicious. My favourite side dish is the marinated shrimp; wasn’t expecting tha

Someone told me it is an authentic South Korean experience and I really felt it . There was a fair selection for the price and we got a table quickly on a Friday night . The staff were friendly and polite, and the service was quick. Nice place for a casual dine with friends. The hot entrees were perfect and there are lots of meat options. You even get coffee included in the price. Overall satisfied !

reviews: This place is a hidden gem. The Xinjiang style stir fried rice noodles are absolutely amazing. spicy, and full of flavor. The mala skewers are also a must try perfectly seasoned, fragrant, and not overly oily, with that classic numbing and spicy kick. They pair really well with the rice noodles. If you’ve never tried Xinjiang food before, this is the perfect place to start. Highly recommended, and I’ll definitely be coming back!
Authentic, comforting, and full of flavor. The spice level was perfect and the food instantly brought back childhood memories. Super cute restaurant with amazing vibes. A must-try.

This Xinjiang stir-fried rice cake place was a pleasant surprise. The rice cakes were cooked perfectly — slightly crispy on the outside and soft and chewy on the inside, not sticky or mushy at all. The portion was generous, and the meat and vegetables were definitely not skimpy. Definitely worth trying, will come back again.
Such delicious food. The round and flat noodles were both so perfectly chewy and the seasoning was delicious. Highly recommend
Tastes so good. Service is perfect, would definitely come again.

reviews:
This is a really decent and affordable buffet in Roncesvalles, offering great value for the price. You’re not coming here for a premium fine-dining experience, but for cheap eats in Toronto that are filling, flavourful, and satisfying, it absolutely delivers.

There’s a solid variety of dishes to choose from. I’d recommend sticking with the butter chicken, chili chicken, Hakka fried rice, and vegetarian noodles — those were the standouts for me. Some of the dish names aren’t totally accurate (aside from the butter chicken and noodles), but honestly that’s not a big deal. The beauty of a buffet

Pretty good food overall, would come back to try the buffet special which is high value. During buffet hours you can still order off of the menu. We tried the chicken vindaloo, garlic naan, and steamed chicken Momos - naan was especially good. More of a hole in the wall vibe with good seating availability for small to moderately sized groups.

A simple restaurant with absolutely delicious food. I’ve tried many Indian places and can say Nepal India Curry house is by far the best I’ve tasted/had in a long long time!!

The food is flavourful yet not overpowering. We had the evening buffet - the variety (including meat options) for the price was amazing!! Service was great too. I could feel the food and service comes from the hearts of those who work here ❤️

We visited for the dinner buffet and asked about vegan options. While the selection wasn’t extensive, there was more than enough for us to enjoy. The staff were incredibly kind and attentive and even prepared a few extra vegan dishes for us complimentary, which we really appreciated.
The food tasted great and, unlike many Indian or Nepali places that tend to go heavy on unnecessary spices, everything here felt well balanced. We felt great after the meal, which says a lot.
Delicious food, thoughtful service, and we’ll definitely be visiting again.

Best value in town.

Not many places in Toronto where you can get such a high quality selection of Indian/Nepali food for the prices they're offering right now!

14.99 for lunch and 17.99 for dinner with made too order Naan and spectacular Butter Chicken + Goat Curry and many other dishes at a variety of spice levels.

Everything from Pekora starters to Ice Cream and Gulab Jamun to finish.

It brings me all the way back to more than a decade ago when you could find such great value downtown.

If you're in the area and enjoy this type of cuisine at all. You're making a horrible mistake not comi

reviews:
Tried NOPO Korean Bistro recently and really enjoyed it. The pork belly platter $39.95 was generous portion. The pork belly was served on a burner with a grill, so we could keep it warm and grill it while eating, which was a nice touch. The Ebi Mayo was also very tasty and crispy. Absolutely my favourite!

We also had the new kiwi soju highball that was perfectly refreshing and paired really well with the food. Recommended. (half price during Happy Hour 5-8pm)

Fun spot for Korean food and drinks with friends. Would definitely come back!

A newer Korean bistro in Toronto that’s definitely worth checking out. The vibe is casual and fun, exactly the kind of place you’d want for drinks and comfort food. One of my favorite touches was the slightly frozen soju, super refreshing and honestly a great idea.

Service was also a highlight. The waitress was genuinely kind and attentive, and you could tell the team is working hard and really cares about the place. What made it even more impressive was seeing how hands, on they are, looks like they’re even doing their own marketing. I actually stumbled across their promotion and decided to

Tried the Winter Special Combo here and, while it is not somewhere I would normally pick since I do not drink at all, I was pleasantly surprised that there were still things I could genuinely enjoy. The space itself is quite cozy and intentionally dim, which may lean more toward drinkers, but the layout is thoughtful and the restaurant feels clean and well kept.
We shared Jaeyook, Seafood Udon, and the appetizer set which came with Ebi Mayo Fries, Deep Fried Squid, and Deep Fried Seaweed Rolls. The combo also includes a complimentary drink and I opted for the virgin Taegukju. Overall, the food

I finally found a great Korean pocha-style soju spot with amazing food and cozy vibes.
The budae jjigae (army stew) had a rich, spicy, and deep broth, loaded with ramen, tofu, sausage, and vegetables — perfect for sharing with 2–3 people. It gets even better as it boils, which makes it an ideal dish with drinks.
The sizzling stir-fried dishes (makchang/gopchang) had great smoky “wok hei” flavor and well-balanced seasoning. Served on a hot iron plate, everything stayed warm and delicious until the last bite.
The atmosphere feels very authentic and comfortable, great for hanging out with friends

Wow everything was absolutely delicious 🥰 the omelette reminded me of okonomiyaki and I really loved the texture . Spicy pork was delicious - not super spicy but has a nice kick and a great Smokey flavor. Odeng soup definitely hit the spot on a cold winter day and there were two giant dumplings inside 🤤
Will definitely be back to try some of their 🍹

reviews: Came here for lunch on a Thursday afternoon. The person behind the counter was quick to take my order and prepare the food. Waited about 8 mins for them to prepare the bowl. It was really good and the presentation was great. Will definitely come back soon.

At first glance, a very unassuming rice bar. And then an impeccably plated bowl of their miso glazed salmon got in front of me. Beautifully fresh ingredients, distinct flavours coming together in great harmony, not competing against each other. Service was lovely too, the person behind the counter truly cares about assembling each dish. And portion size is perfect! Came in for "a quick dinner before an event" and ended up discovering a gem that I will be definitely returning to. Thank you very much!

decided to stop by this place while i waited for a friend and wow what a good decision it was! i got the korean fried chicken rice bowl and it was soooooo good. perfect amount of sweet, spicy, sour, savory. the chicken had a super nice crunch and the dressing on the salad was addicting. and all for under $20. you can’t go wrong. i’ll definitely be back! and also everyone working there was so nice!

Fine Dining in a Bowl, Fast

So for the same price of Manchu Wok or really any fast food combo, I can get clean, fresh, quality food from classically trained chefs (from their sister restaurant Omai).

Omai Rice Bar nails what so many spots try and fail to do: deliver elevated, restaurant-quality food with the speed and convenience of fast food. It’s the kind of place that makes you pause mid-bite and think, how is this not being served at every fast casual establishment.

TIP: ask for their hot sauce

Such a cute place — menu is simple and delicious. I highly recommend the Crispy Pork Belly bowl, perfect level of spice with the gochujang. Will definitely be coming back! Just to note, there isn’t very much seating… it’s more of a takeout place.

reviews:
Pretty tasty but horrible value and portion size. I got a niku miso onigiri for $5.75 plus tax and it barely had any beef filling. I have no issue with it being minced beef rather than larger pieces, but the filling was pretty much all just sauce. For that price, I'd expect some discernible minced beef pieces in there, like come on.

They made it to order so it was fresh and warm, but the warmth of the rice made the seaweed moist rather than crisp. So it was kind of a trade off.

Service was nice. Variety of flavours was just ok. For a place that focuses on onigiri, I would've expected a few r

This onigiri totally reminded me of those hidden gems you find all over Japan. The flavours are super subtle and not overpowering at all, and the rice tastes like real Japanese rice. Simple, comforting, and really well done.

Long awaited the opening of Onigiri Co., so I was very excited for their soft opening
The staff were so kind and helpful, the food is delicious (better than expected), and I cannot wait to return.
Whether you love onigiri or are looking to try it for the first time, definitely take the opportunity to swing by and try the these.

I got the Niku Miso and the Spicy Tunamayo, both were absolutely delicious, I can’t decide which was better!

The rice made with Japanese grains was perfectly cooked and really delicious. I love Japanese nori, and theirs was crispy and full of flavor. I think I’ll definitely come back again when I’m in the area!🇯🇵
The onigiri here are high quality, and the staff are welcoming and professional. You can really tell care goes into each one. Highly recommended for everyone!

reviews:
I had such a fantastic experience at Oodles Wok! As soon as I entered, the aromas of the food were absolutely amazing.

The food itself was incredibly flavourful and so yummy. Every bite was packed with taste, and everything was cooked perfectly.

The customer service was also outstanding. The staff were friendly, welcoming, and made the whole experience even better.

Highly recommend this place if you’re craving delicious Chinese food with great service. I’ll definitely be coming back!

Their food was good but not such that you can eat quite often.   Almost all of their items are a little sweet and a lot spicy, so if someone is diabetic, this is not good for the person.
Customer service was great.   They listed you and try best to serve your the food according to their standards.
They have a limited sitting arrangement at the upper floor which is just an average sitting arrangement.

Zero value for money as portions are very small….and every single gravy teates the same. We were the only people in the restaurant, it was a week day, no rush time at all, still took them 35 minutes to make the food. Noodle to gravy/seasoning ratio was very out, and altogether doesnt taste good. This place is only good to try once.

I got the Regular with Spicy Fries, Vegetable Rice, Chilli Chicken and Salt and Pepper Chicken. So good! I would definitely recommend the chili fries. The vegetables dumplings were decent too! The lady at the counter was super helpful and gave good advice.

Ordered two “large” items through Uber Eats using a BOGO promo. I honestly can’t believe these would have cost $45 for just two dishes without the promotion. The portion sizes were shockingly small for a “large.”

If this is what Oodles considers large, Thai Express portions are far more generous by comparison.

As for the food itself, it was overly salty and drenched in sauce, which overwhelmed the flavors. Nothing really stood out or felt memorable.

We were curious to try it, and now we know, unfortunately, not something we’d order again.

Service was good, inside resto was modern and nice.

Give a try! I ll come soon again!

This is a great addition to the area. The owner is polite and friendly, great service. Lots of tea options, tried masala chai, vadapav, tea cake and everything was worth trying. A must visit, right outside loblaws

The ginger lemon tea and chai tea here are sooo good!
I also tried the brownie, but next time I’m gonna try something else.
Just waiting for them to open right now!

Ginger chai is my fav so far. Delicious, warm, and lovely pick-me-up with non-dairy options

reviews: This has always been one of my go to spots whenever I’m sick, so it felt great to finally come here and enjoy the food when I’m not! My sister and I ordered congee, pan-fried noodles, dumplings, and rice noodles with cabbage. The portion sizes were generous enough to have leftovers to take home. The dumplings were perfectly crispy, packed with filling, and the meat was flavorful. Overall, everything was seasoned just right. The tables are also nicely spaced out, which makes dining more comfortable. Definitely coming back again!

Hands down best deal in the city for congee and rice roll and you have to get their fried dumplings. Not only is it an amazing deal it’s also full of filling, juicy, and savoury. If I lived nearby I would come every weekend just to have a plate of it, just that good. The lady behind the desk is super helpful and attentive and the place just reminds me of a classic Hong Kong style cafe. 10000000/10
Service is fine. Food is quite a nice size with respect to the price. Dumpling and rice noodle roll with dough stick are really good, both in taste and portioning. A good place for casual meal.

reviews:
Osteria Alba on College Street absolutely exceeded expectations. From the moment you walk in, the ambiance feels warm, intimate, and effortlessly chic. It’s the kind of place that makes you want to linger a little longer over good food and conversation.
The Gnudi ai Funghi was out of this world amazing. Soft, pillowy, and perfectly balanced with the earthy richness of the mushrooms. Every bite melted and felt thoughtfully crafted.
The Insalata Burrata was fresh and beautifully paired with figs and roasted tomatoes. The sweetness of the figs against the creamy burrata was such a perfect contras

Had a delicious Italian meal here. Would say they struck a good balance between being
upscale without being pretentious and still offering good portion sizes. Everything was very flavourful. Probably some of the best arancini I’ve ever had. The Gnudi was also amazing.
Great menu, while I only tried about four items I’d easily go back and try four completely different things, everything I saw looked good.
Service was great and I like what they’ve done with the interior. Excited to see it in the summer when the patio and rooftop is active.

We had extremely happy diner for my Aunti. All the food including dessert is in the house made by the chef. Fungus pizza and truffle GNUDI were the highlight. My Aunti was surprised by the French lamb chop, tender and flavorful. Bryce was  thoughtful and humorous with 5 star service. Best Italian restaurant in Town. If you are foodie, this is the new pearl.

We visited with friends this week after seeing it had opened and it was a 10/10 experience! The food is amazing, shout out to the Gnudi in particular. The cocktails were perfect and the servers were so funny and friendly! The restaurant itself is really pretty and the open kitchen is a great touch. We will for sure be back!

I know it’s opening week so it was quiet but I expect this place will be packed soon!

Just visited Alba and enjoyed a most scrumptious meal. Starting with the salads that were piled high along with their homemade bread served like pizza style. The pastas were so flavorful and made in house. The Branzino was extremely fresh and delicious. Try their tiramisu worth the extra calories. The service was very attentive and beautiful presentation of the food.
