The Gnudi ai Funghi was out of this world amazing. Soft, pillowy, and perfectly balanced with the earthy richness of the mushrooms. Every bite melted and felt thoughtfully crafted.
The Insalata Burrata was fresh and beautifully paired with figs and roasted tomatoes. The sweetness of the figs against the creamy burrata was such a perfect contras

Had a delicious Italian meal here. Would say they struck a good balance between being
upscale without being pretentious and still offering good portion sizes. Everything was very flavourful. Probably some of the best arancini I’ve ever had. The Gnudi was also amazing.
Great menu, while I only tried about four items I’d easily go back and try four completely different things, everything I saw looked good.
Service was great and I like what they’ve done with the interior. Excited to see it in the summer when the patio and rooftop is active.

We had extremely happy diner for my Aunti. All the food including dessert is in the house made by the chef. Fungus pizza and truffle GNUDI were the highlight. My Aunti was surprised by the French lamb chop, tender and flavorful. Bryce was  thoughtful and humorous with 5 star service. Best Italian restaurant in Town. If you are foodie, this is the new pearl.

We visited with friends this week after seeing it had opened and it was a 10/10 experience! The food is amazing, shout out to the Gnudi in particular. The cocktails were perfect and the servers were so funny and friendly! The restaurant itself is really pretty and the open kitchen is a great touch. We will for sure be back!

I know it’s opening week so it was quiet but I expect this place will be packed soon!

Just visited Alba and enjoyed a most scrumptious meal. Starting with the salads that were piled high along with their homemade bread served like pizza style. The pastas were so flavorful and made in house. The Branzino was extremely fresh and delicious. Try their tiramisu worth the extra calories. The service was very attentive and beautiful presentation of the food.

reviews:
I recently visited Pakwan Express Hyderabadi Restaurant and the food was really good. The haleem was rich, flavorful, and tasted authentic.
The Hyderabadi mutton biryani was the highlight — fragrant rice, tender mutton, and proper spice balance. Easily one of the better Hyderabadi-style restaurant biryanis around.
The desserts were fresh and nicely balanced, not overly sweet, and a great way to finish the meal.
Good portions and authentic taste overall. Definitely recommended if you’re craving Hyderabadi food. I’ll be coming back again.
Amazing...authentic Hyderabadi for sure
“Waiting for the hotel branch to open like my life depends on it 😭🔥”

Pakwan Express is amazing! 🌟 Authentic Hyderabadi flavors, a huge Ramadan buffet for just $24.99, and the desserts are next level. The people there are so sweet and welcoming, and the owner is super nice — personally takes care of everything. Great dine-in and takeaway! 🌙✨

reviews:
I had a great experience at Pampangueña on Wilson Street! The food tasted authentically Filipino, especially the classics—rich flavors, generous portions, and that comforting home-style taste. The staff were warm and welcoming, and the service felt very personal.

The place can get a bit busy at times, but the overall atmosphere is cozy and inviting. Definitely a go-to spot if you’re craving real Filipino dishes in Toronto. I’ll happily come back to try more from their menu!

One of the best filipino restaurants hands down. Usually my go to. The place is clean, the atmosphere is calming, service is real good. The served portions are not stingy and the prices are well thought. Definitely should try checking out if you're craving filipino meals.

It is very suitable for the taste of East Asians, the taste is rich and nutritious, the staff has a good attitude, I don't know how to choose dishes for the first time, and I am very serious to help me introduce!

I tried Halo-Halo for the first time at Pampangueña Restaurant, and it was such a delightful experience! The combination of flavors, textures, and colors was absolutely perfect, sweet, creamy, and super refreshing.

Ordered catering from Pampangueña Bakery for my daughter's baptism and it was such a hit! The food portions were amazing, they were very tasty and not oily at all! I had alot of guests who were fairly new to filipino cuisine who enjoyed the dishes and complimented how flavourful they were! I will definitely get catering from them for all our family parties and events!

We ordered: pork lumpia, lechon kawali, beef steak/bistek, chicken pansit canton/bihon mix, chicken wings, pork giniling with quail eggs, garlic fried rice!

The service was outstanding. Our server was attentive, checked on me several times, and paid close attention to every detail and request, which really made the experience enjoyable.

As always, I ordered my favorite dish, Koobideh, and it did not disappoint at all. The price was very reasonable at around $20, and the portion size was generous, I honestl

What i have experienced today, it is something that I have never tried before in Iran or Ukraine. reviews: Best fresh, flaky croissants 🥐 you can find in Toronto west area, last time I had similar croissants in Paris France 🇫🇷 finally found this French bakery blessing here in Toronto. We are regular to Patisserie 27 and every weekend we get croissants and bakery goods in the morning. Highly recommend if someone is looking for legit French croissants, try it and you will get hock

Consistently excellent pastries/viennoiserie made fresh with classic French techniques and precision. This is a well-loved spot for us locals, so on weekends you may need to go early to ensure they're not sold out of your favourites...but even if they are, everything is delicious here! The fougasse bread is so good that it rarely  lasts me more than a day. The macarons are spot-on for texture, taste, and flavour. Their delicious, buttery, flaky layers of pastry with a good coffee is a combination that is pretty hard to beat. Enjoy!
LOVE everything every single time that I have been there. Real crunchy french croissants. I got so excited about it that I never have a chance to think about taking pictures before I them all

Popped in on a Sunday morning. A small storefront with a decent selection of pastries, a smaller selection of fancy cake slices, and a fuller menu of beverages (coffees, tea, hot cider, hot chocolate, juice, etc.). Disappointing that there is nowhere to sit.

Finally got to try this place after a friends recommendation and wow! The pastries are so fresh and the scent of fresh baked goods is mouth watering. Their chocolate croissant made me feel like I was back in Paris!

PATOGH IROONI||335 YONGE ST M5B 1R7.matchedAddress: 335 Yonge St, Toronto, ON M5B 1R7, Canada
reviews:
Absolutely the best quality by far!
I’ve tried so many places, but this one is truly different.
Tonight I decided to try their chicken sausage sandwich for the first time and it was amazing , super fresh, full of flavour, and perfectly made.
Totally recommend it!

Most of the time we come here for Hospitality first then for service and Food! Nice people and Fantastic food! Whenever I come it takes a long time to choose what I have to eat! Royal plate, Zaban, Ash reshteh, Ghormeh Sabzi, Halim, Rostam Sausage! All are my fav👌🏼😍Ash and Ghormeh sabzi taste like Grandma house:))))

One of the best food experiences I’ve had recently! The grilled wrap was incredibly flavorful, juicy, and made with fresh ingredients. The warm bread and herbs made it even better.
And the Persian saffron dessert… absolutely amazing. The rich saffron taste, almonds, and rose petals made it so authentic and delicious.
Definitely recommend coming here and trying it. The quality is fantastic and totally worth it!

You can truly experience the authentic taste and atmosphere of Iran here. The food is absolutely delicious, the staff are friendly and welcoming, and the service is exceptional — they even offer soup before the main course, which is such a thoughtful touch. Highly recommended!

Whenever I visit Toronto from Montreal, I always make a point of coming to this lovely family-run place. The warmth of the staff and the truly home-style, delicious food make it feel like a second home.

The co-owner is super nice, he even gave me an amazing hot soup while I was waiting for my order. I took my food to the Eaton Centre food court to eat, and honestly, it was worth it because this place is simply the best.

If you’re looking for authentic, flavourful Persian food, don’t look any further. I’ve tried several dishes so far and every single one has been amazing. Highly recommend!

reviews: Another new fave! The food here is delicious and the hospitality is just as great. Every bite of my Thièp Bu Dieun was full of flavour and the Bouye drink was satisfying prepared as well. I’m a pepper sauce aficionado and their piment is so nice. I’ll happily be back to try more of their menu. Senegal Rekk!

I highly recommend Pendafrica! The food is amazing. We had the thiep bu guinar, grilled fish with attiéké and plantain. Also the bissap (twice because it was sooo good) and thiakry. Every single thing was delicious and filling. The staff is very attentive, their energy makes you feel welcome right away. I will definitely be back!

It was a pleasant surprise to find this halal gem in Toronto. This was our first time experiencing Senegalese food and we'll definitely be visiting again soon.

The customer service was top notch, as the gentleman walked us through the menu and gave strong recommendations. They also have a prayer area, which is another massive plus!

We ordered the Fataya (patties), Yassa Fish, and Attieke Chicken (jerk chicken). Would recommend all to try!
First time having Senegalese food. I've been told they are the originators of jollof rice. Amazing flavours. My favourites were their rice, chicken, and the pastels.

DISAPPOINTMENT. Not worth the price at all. Too expensive for the quantity and quality.

I ordered twice. The first time I ordered Tiep with beef. The quantity of beef was a JOKE. Only 4 tiny pieces of beef with more bones than meat. The rice was good though.
I gave it a second chance and ordered today Dibi Goat and plantains.
The side of plantains cost $5… look at the picture to see what a joke it is…. The Dibi was uncooked inside.

I am really disappointed. Will never order again.

C’est une déception totale. Des amis ont fait de la pub pour ce restaurant mais franchement c’est pas bien. La

reviews:
I had a wonderful dining experience at Petite Lune Toronto 👍

The food is absolutely delicious — fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented.
My most favourite dish is the fresh roll,  chicken noodle soup.  Every dish we ordered was well-balanced and authentic, with great attention to detail.

The atmosphere is beautiful, cozy, and elegant and very clean — perfect for a relaxing dinner or special occasion. The space feels warm and inviting, yet refined.

They also have a lovely bar with a great liquor selection, and I truly appreciate that they can keep our wine for our next visit — such a tho

Got the chance to eat here yesterday and everything was so good. The fresh rolls were my favourite, super fresh and really authentic. We also ordered the shaken beef, tartare, and pho, and each dish truly felt like a taste of Vietnam.

The vibe is giving cool French brasserie, such a beautiful nod to the Viet-French influence, with a romantic, cozy feel. The cocktails were on point too. Such a great new addition to Baldwin!

An evening at Petite Lune Saigon feels like stepping into a refined journey where Vietnamese heritage meets modern elegance.

From the moment you walk in, the atmosphere is intimate and thoughtfully curated — warm lighting, sophisticated design, and details that evoke both nostalgia and contemporary luxury. The experience flows effortlessly from beautifully plated dishes to carefully crafted cocktails, each element reflecting intention and craftsmanship.

The menu reimagines Vietnamese flavours through a refined lens, balancing tradition with creativity. Every plate feels purposeful, highlight
Super chic and vibey spot with great cocktails and tapas to enjoy

Really good Vietnamese food you won’t find elsewhere.

But the staff/service is even better. Like 10/10.

The atmosphere is really nice too. Very romantic. Very Paris Vietnamese.

reviews:
They've relocated from their old location which was slightly north. This new location is a lot brighter.

I really liked their croissants for their taste and value. Their almond croissant was flakely and generously filled with almond paste. I also tried their cookie, but thought it was okay.

Would recommend and come back.

My favorite croissant in the city. Marc is a genius and I'm very happy to have him in our neighborhood. The eclair is the best I've had in my life. His chou à la crème also, amazing. The breads,  outstanding.  Merci!

Heard that this coffee spot moved from down the street. Very beautiful interior with some seating and also sale of dried goodies such as pasta sauces and noodles.

They have some amazing croissants that are perfectly crispy and soft and buttery on the inside. The cookie was a tad too sweet but was baked very well.

Great music. Food was awesome. The chicken and Brie was a great option. We ate in and had a nice time. Highly recommend that you buy a sourdough loaf. Wow. That bread was so good for dinner and breakfast the next day. Perfection. Next time, I am definitely eating some croissant or donuts!!!!!

Walking by and caught this little gem that just opened in hood. Outstanding breakfast sammie on a croissant. The atmosphere is spot on. I wanted to hang out all morning but I had to get to work... Shoulda taken a moment to enjoy the sandwich in the cafe.

reviews: I'm here often with friends. The service is always great and so is the food. Whenever I'm trying to do a get together this is usually my go to spot. The recently added Wednesday night karaoke but I could never get to go to it. I'm sure it's fun though.
I just came here to celebrate an anniversary, too much noise, but still i was able to fine the seat same spot as last year!

We were looking for a casual pub, with no frills to watch the game.
We went to the firkin and that is exactly what we got. The service and staff was actually so much nicer than some of the high end restaurants I’ve been to and they were so attentive.
We had chicken wings, nachos, fish and chips and the bacon and tomato grilled cheese and sweet potato fries.
All in all, no complaints, the food was exactly what we wanted. Came out fresh and quick.

Ordered the Chicken Balti Pie described as "Rich & spicy chicken curry, chick peas, onions, mashed potato, smashed peas, gravy." The picture on their website shows mashed peas on top, curry checken & chickpeas. My pie was just a typical chicken pie. When I asked the waiter, he just said, "No curry" and walked away. For $24, I did not get what I want. No compensation. I did not expect full refund but some discount would have been appreciated.
It's a great neighbourhood hangout, and you can see they have a group of regulars

PHIN & GO CAFE||3325 DUNDAS ST W, #1A M6.matchedAddress: 3325 Dundas St W, Toronto, ON M6P 2A6, Canada
reviews:
Amazing addition to the Junction neighbourhood! The owners are extremely nice and they provide amazing Vietnamese drinks, food (Bahn Mi & Sticky Rice) and desserts!

So far I’ve tried a few of their Bahn Mi sandwiches (chicken & pork) and the pork sticky rice, everything has been amazing so far. You can tell they use fresh quality ingredients and really put lots of love towards what they do.

I highly recommend this spot and it has become one of my go to places, especially cause they I’m so close to the shop.

Noticed this cute little Vietnamese coffee shop on my way to the gym a few days ago, so I had to go in and try it! We had the peach lemongrass iced tea, and a lemongrass chicken and ribeye steak banh mi and honestly it was delicious 😋
The tea had real fruit in it that gave it the loveliest flavour. Also the banh mi’s has such a yummy pate. The restaurant staff were also incredibly kind and welcoming! Would definitely recommend giving them a try if you’re in the Junction!

We saw this joyful, brightly coloured restaurant opened in the junction as we drove by one day so made a point of getting takeout. The owners are very friendly and kind and the food was great. The flavours were yummy and the dishes were filling. The bubble tea was excellent quality and was filled with real fruits like lychee and watermelon which was appreciated. Will happily be back again soon- such a great addition to the neighbourhood

I got the banana cream coffee and the traditional cold cut bahn mi and it exceeded my expectations! It was so delicious, one of the best Vietnamese coffees I’ve ever tried. The bahn mi was also sooo yummy, the bread and veggies were so fresh. Definitely will be coming back again!

Great new spot! We got the brûlée iced coffee (Vietnamese egg coffee with a sort of torched top), and it was delicious! It was high quality and the perfect amount of sweetness. The owners are very friendly and really care about the quality of what they create. Looking forward to trying the food next time :-)

The tea had real fruit in it that gave it the loveliest flavour. Also the banh mi’s has such a yummy pate. The restaurant staff were also incredibly kind and welcoming! Would definitely recommend giving them a try if you’re in the Junction!

We saw this joyful, brightly coloured restaurant opened in the junction as we drove by one day so made a point of getting takeout. The owners are very friendly and kind and the food was great. The flavours were yummy and the dishes were filling. The bubble tea was excellent quality and was filled with real fruits like lychee and watermelon which was appreciated. Will happily be back again soon- such a great addition to the neighbourhood

I got the banana cream coffee and the traditional cold cut bahn mi and it exceeded my expectations! It was so delicious, one of the best Vietnamese coffees I’ve ever tried. The bahn mi was also sooo yummy, the bread and veggies were so fresh. Definitely will be coming back again!

Great new spot! We got the brûlée iced coffee (Vietnamese egg coffee with a sort of torched top), and it was delicious! It was high quality and the perfect amount of sweetness. The owners are very friendly and really care about the quality of what they create. Looking forward to trying the food next time :-)

reviews:
Great food and great service. I ordered the satay beef, but since I don’t eat red meat, I asked if they could change it to chicken. Not only did they switch the meat, they also made it with a chicken-based satay soup — which was really nice and delicious. No extra charge either.

Friendly service and such a comforting meal after a long day of digging out from what felt like the biggest snowstorm of the century. That kind of care really matters.

Saw this pho place on our way from home and decided to try it out. The food itself tastes great - got a beef ball pho and a chicken vermicelli, as well as the fresh roll and mango smoothie.

The portion size is small given the price. I ordered a large pho and the amount of noodles would be compared to a small at any other pho place. I ordered a large to share with my toddler and was a bit disappointed with the portion given the price. The vermicelli was also pretty small for the price and my husband was still hungry after he ate it. He did appreciate the grilled meat and it was very tasty. The

Excellent pho! We went for lunch today and we were very happy. The broth was delicious and we really like the balanced flavours.

The restaurant is clean, the owners are friendly, and the service was great. Looking forward to going back to try more of the menu.

Had dinner there a few weeks ago with two young kids. Food was very tasty and the kids enjoyed their meals. As an Asian family, we have had a lot of pho and Asian food. Food was tasty but the portions are not as large as I was expecting. We tried the spring rolls, special noodle soup, lemongrass beef rice and chicken vermicelli.

I have since ordered take out and the take out was disappointing as it was missing things that you would receive in the restaurant - for example, the herbs to go with the noodle soup. I likely wouldn't do take out again, I would prefer to eat at the restaurant.

The r

I visited Pho Hieu for lunch, excited and optimistic for a delicious Vietnamese meal. This place is a bright star on a dark street. We were greeted warmly by a friendly staff (Rachel) and seated promptly.  We ordered a rare beef pho, vermicelli with spring rolls, and a side of sugar cane shrimp. The pho was fantastic, though I’d suggest a slightly thinner cut on the beef. The vermicelli was good, and the sugar cane shrimp was okay, but I wouldn’t order it again. Having this place in the neighbourhood is welcomed, and we’ll definitely be back soon.

reviews: Just ordered and did pick up. Basic Principle and Dante’s. Excellent pizza, the sauce is fresh and tangy, crust is crispy on the outside and soft inside, meat on the Dante’s was excellent. Garlic dipping sauce is super garlicky and good. Highly recommend! The pick up is a bit tricky, in the delivery lane for the Sweet Potato. Overall friendly and eager to please.
This pizza has the most insane crispy and chewy crust. It’s the best! The garlic dip is also to die for. This is Toronto’s best Detroit-style pizza.

Really disappointed. Was looking forward to this, but it didn’t deliver. The pizzas came in 10” boxes, yet the actual size was much smaller (cheese ~6.5” x 8.5”, pepperoni ~7” x 9.5”) with way too much crust.   The pepperoni was the better of the two.  The cheese one was sad looking.

Honestly, it felt more like focaccia than pizza—very thick and mostly bread. On top of that, both were quite greasy.

At $39 for two small pizzas, the value just isn’t there. Wouldn’t go back.

Delicious pizza!!! The sourdough crust was my favourite part - so delicious and the perfect texture, with crispy bottom and sides. Pickup was fast and easy. Best deep dish I’ve tried in Toronto! Will definitely be back.

Pizza was really good, same quality as slow hands in Toronto East.  Glad their is a Sardough detroit pizza in the west end now.
Pizza box needs a little work as it didn't close properly but I am sure they are working on it.   Definitely recommend.

Cute little hidden gem on Bay st 🥰👌🏼Delicious cappuccino and breakfast sandwiches ☕️🥐 Oh and the choc chip cookie is scrumptious as well 🍪 I came here for breakfast and then went back for a grilled veggie sandwich for lunch. Update: Tried the $5 pasta Tues special and it was great! Had the tomato marinara and next week will try the basil pesto 😜
This location is convenient and I think that’s the only reason why it runs. Otherwise, the food or drink are not that great. The prices are mad high. The staff is lovely.

Visited Pronto with my partner and mom. We asked for a couple of sandwiches and custom drinks (we asked for an Iced Hot Chocolate) and they made them perfectly! Happy to have finally tried this shop. I’d recommend a visit.

I visited Pura Vida on St. Clair and had an amazing experience! The place has a really cool and cozy décor. The food was delicious, the drinks are highly recommended, and the prices are very reasonable. I went with my friends, and everyone really enjoyed the atmosphere. Milena’s service was absolutely outstanding – incredibly friendly, attentive, and made the whole experience even more memorable. I’ll definitely be back!

Pura Vida is my husband and I go-to place. We were already seduced by the food and service at their previous location.

Now that they moved in a bigger space and decorated the place, it’s even better!

The food is tasty and the team is super friendly. The place is super versatile: if you’re looking for a meal to celebrate, have a date night or family-friendly, this is the place to go!

QINGZHEN'S BAO||384 YONGE ST, #56 M5B 1S.matchedAddress: 384 Yonge St, Toronto, ON M5G 2K2, Canada
reviews:
The best Chengdu-style noodles in Toronto!
As someone from Chengdu, this place gives me such an authentic experience — it truly feels like home.
And the owner (the 小姐姐) is incredibly kind and gentle to me I can’t not express enough how much I appreciate it😭😭😭Such a wonderful vibe!

This is the most delicious restaurant I've ever eaten at. Their Chengdu specialties are very distinct, especially the Shao Mai paired with their unique chili sauce. I also tried their jasmine soy milk, which was refreshing and delicious. Their beef noodles are different from others, using thin noodles that don't easily get mushy, and the beef pieces are very large. I suggest everyone try everything! It's definitely my hidden gem of a restaurant!

The beef noodles are amazing — rich broth, tender beef, and perfectly chewy handmade noodles. The tossed dumplings are also a must-try! The skin has that extra bounce and chew because it’s made with alkaline water and egg white. You can really taste the difference. Easily one of the best authentic spots in downtown Toronto!

Every single dish here is absolutely delicious! The flavors are so authentic that it instantly reminded me of real Chengdu street food. The noodles are chewy and perfectly seasoned, the spicy sauce is rich and fragrant, and the flaky buns are soft, layered, and full of flavor. Everything tastes freshly made and well-balanced.
Delicious, generous portions! The taste is very clean and fresh. The noodles were so perfect and chewy. Lots of meat and tasty toppings. Lovely snack from the panda’s hometown!

reviews: The food was so good! The bún đậu mắm tôm was flavorful and authentic with rich shrimp paste sauce. The bún thịt nướng had juicy, perfectly grilled pork, and the fried nem chua was crispy and addictive. The peach tea was refreshing and tasted just like the one in Vietnam. Definitely coming back!

We were in the area searching for some Vietnamese food. This hidden gem will bring you right back to a corner of Hai Phong, northern cuisine style where the beef pho is simple flavour of onions and ginger yet delicious, Bun cha is full of flavour in the broth, garlic, ginger and not as sweet as southern style. Its rare to find a true Viet northern cuisine style in Toronto, I trult apprised this experience and will definitely come back

reviews:
We stopped by this Mexican spot around lunchtime and tried the birria tacos with guacamole and chips — absolutely delicious! The portions were very generous and the flavors were spot on.

The customer service really stood out. The girl at the counter was fantastic, super friendly, and welcoming, which made the experience even better. The owner was in the kitchen and was also very kind and attentive.

The only downside is that there’s no seating available, which is a bit of a shame because we would have loved to stay longer and enjoy the food there. That said, it’s perfect for takeout.

Prices

5 stars is not enough for this place. Firstly, the people were extremely kind and charming. I ordered the quesabirria tacos and when I tell you that they were/are soooo delicious! So authentic and filled with so much flavour and deliciousness. Will definitely be coming back!
😍🤤🌮❤️

ESPECTACULAR!!!

My tacos were so good, but the torta left me speechless!! It was great! The bun was so soft (which is really hard to find in this city), the beef was very tasty, and the combination of guacamole and cheese with everything else was amazing.

Totally recommend it, and I’ll definitely be going back.
OMG the flavours in this place are absolute amazing! You definitely get that true Mexican flavour and love on the tacos! They are also super friendly staff ! Will be coming back soon !
Birria tacos 10/10 ! Top notch service, now one of my go to spots for these delicious and flavourful dishes!

reviews: We go to Ramona’s on Bayview semi regularly so we’re happy to see another location open in our neighborhood. The menu has a great variety and we are always happy with our order. Today we had the deluxe burger and the turkey blt. Everything tasted so fresh and was made with great high quality ingredients, and the fries were perfectly crispy. It’s a really generous serving as well. The server was very lovely and friendly - it seemed like she was the only one working the front but she did not miss a beat. We will definitely be back

A great place in a great location. We even got to meet the actual Ramona! She is an exceptional human being and was able to accommodate our party of 6 with two little kids as part of this.

The food is incredibly fresh. They also use real butter on the toast. Our wait person Diana, was attentive without being intrusive - a rare quality.

The ambiance is warm and inviting, like being at a friend’s place for lunch.

Highly recommend.

What a wonderful experience as you can  see even her baby was happy 😊..
We had such amazing service from Naz.... she explained the menu and asked if we had any questions she would be more then happy to help.  She recommended dishes and dessert which were all delicious
And the kitchen staff were so sweet and made sure we were happy with our lunch.
Liz and John are wonderful
I had the veggie burger. It was so good I ate it without a pic 🤣  my beautiful pregnant friend had the salmon with mashed and gravy. It was so yummy
We then shared the raspberry cheese cake and chocolate chip cookie ...mouth

Had 7:00pm dinner here on a Wednesday. We were the second couple dining in so the restaurant was quiet and cozy. She ordered a burger with gluten free buns that came with fries. The portions were generous, and the taste was amazing. For me, I had their turkey burger served with a side of sweet potato fries. It was equally delicious and filling. The coffee was good, and I was happy they had oat milk available. The staff was friendly and courteous. This won’t be the last time we’re having dinner here!

It was a sunny morning in the line up for the grand opening at Ramona’s Kitchen and I really enjoyed the free breakfast bagel sandwich and the crispy fish sandwich!

The breakfast bagel was so beautiful to look at and it tasted so fantastic! And since the egg yolk was runny it was tricky to eat the middle part without getting messy.

The crispy fish sandwich was so crispy! I loved all the flavours. Only minor criticism is I found there was more bun than fish so the bread overpowered the yummy battered fish taste.

Also got a free chocolate chip cookie for posting and tagging the restaurant on

REN SUSHI (THE WELL)||486 FRONT ST W, WM.query: REN SUSHI (THE WELL) 486 FRONT ST W, W Toronto
reviews: Holy smokes! This sushi was absolutely delicious, beyond reasonably priced, and so fat and glorious I was flabbergasted. Getting sushi for $7 a roll is surprising enough, but getting it at this price stuffed with yummy (less rice more filling) is astonishing. I’m vegetarian and the yam rolls had a ton of delicious sweet potato. The veggie roll was tofu, giant avocado pieces, and cream cheese—though I added cucumber. YUM! My partner got the special platter, it was super fresh and I’ve never seen fish cut so thick! We both stuffed our faces in awe of the abundance! The miso soup was hot and deli

It’s great value for money! The prices are so affordable and the quantity you get is great. They are making sushi right there and you can choose to get prepackaged one or wait 10 mins to get fresh! Absolutely worth the wait. We tried the torched salmon and it was decent.

Tried out Ren's Sushi at The Well and had a pretty solid experience overall. I went with the Salmon Avocado Roll, which was fresh and well-balanced and definitely a good, reliable option if you're sticking to the basics. As for the miso soup, I found it quite bland and underwhelming probably not something I'd order again.
Nice spot for a quick sushi bite, but I’d recommend skipping the soup and focusing on the rolls or other sushi options.

If you dont tip on the sushi you carried over from the shelf yourself, dont expect any smiles, and be prepared for a deep negotiation on why you deserve more than a single pack of soy sauce for an 8 piece sushi.

Also, I hope you are not a wasabi enthusiast, because the dollop is no bigger than a nickel.

The sushi is ok.

I come down here all the time to grab a quick bite and the sushi is always unreal. Quality ingredients for a solid price too. Staff are always super nice, my girlfriend loves this spot! Cheers! Durable chopsticks too

reviews:
Zia’s Place was delightful. The interior was absolutely beautiful. Warm, welcoming, and cozy, yet elevated, complimented by wood accents, warm, unique pendant lighting, luscious greenery and stylish sicilian props.

The zucchini antipasti was rich and creamy yet light. We followed this up with the fusilli a fetetton con calabrain pork & nduja ragu with parmiggiano. The house-made/hand rolled fusilli was perfectly textured and the pork shoulder was rich and flavourful. My friend and I both ordered this, and we cleaned our plates.

The service was friendly, warm and attentive, but not too attent

This new restaurant is still finding its rhythm, but it’s already clear they have a strong foundation to build on. From the same owner behind Pasta Forever, the space is a good balance between stylish and polished while still being warm and inviting.

The cocktails were excellent. We started with the fried zucchini and tuna crudo. I am still having dreams about the zucchini. The combination of flavours worked so well together. The focaccia was also great! I just really wished they served it warm. We also had the featured pasta with clams - it was excellent!

The restaurant was buzzing on a Fri

My family is Southern Italian and this restaurant's food made me emotional. It is the one place in the city that has offered dishes that reminded me of my Nonna and my mother's cooking. The ragu is perfect. The gnocchi was to die for. The fritta mista was like Christmas Eve. Simple radicchio and fennel make the perfect Calabrian table salad. The torte melts in your mouth. Outstanding dinner.

Stumbled upon this lovely little spot on the street — can’t believe it’s only been open for a month! Such a great find. I absolutely loved the decor and the service was super friendly. We sat at the bar, which gave the whole experience a fun and unique vibe. The cocktail had a really distinct flavour — the strawberry aroma was strong and so nice. The shrimp appetizer was amazing — highly recommend it! The main dish was decent, a tiny bit salty for my taste, but overall still really solid. Definitely worth checking out!

Cute little spot for dinner with nice vibes and cute decor. If you come early enough they have happy hour until 6:30pm and it is so worth it for the cocktails and for the ragu pasta. The appetizer was delicious - we got the tuna crudo and the crispy capers were such chefs kiss. All the pastas were so tasty as they are handmade and cooked al dente but just too salty and a bit too acidic. We had the ragu and the seafood pasta with mussels. I would recommend to the chef on reducing the salt to balance out the dishes better. But the overall concept is there. We also ordered the larger tiramisu - d

Best octopus I've had since being in Portugal.
We went for a family member's birthday and everything was of top quality. The shrimp, the chorizo, the bacalhau, the seafood rice.. all amazing! The value is here.
Doesn't this pic speak for itself?
Very warm atmosphere and amazing, high end cuisine! It was a little bit of a wait to get in but the owner treated us to this amazing charcuterie board!

The best food and the best service, the server with glasses is always very attentive and does her best to accommodate our needs! The service in general is very portuguese/european style if youve experienced it before you should know what to expect

I recently had the pleasure of dining at an amazing restaurant, and it was an absolute delight from start to finish.

The warm ambiance and welcoming staff set a tone for an exceptional evening!

The service was as impeccable as it could be, and staff were very knowledgeable about the menu.

I strongly recommend Requinte for a joyously and satisfying night!!

reviews: The one star is way too much for these pupusas! They’re horrible. Expensive, Thick, edge is just empty dough, dry, cheapest mozzarella cheese used ( which is not the adequate cheese anyway!) they charge you item by item after the first 3 pupusas for $18 combo. Don’t take my word for it, if you wanna go waste $20 go ahead and try them!

Had the cheese pupusas and chicharron not sure what type of cheese is used, but did not taste like mozzarella, was not able to acquire a taste for them. This is a one time order for me, service & atmosphere is great.

Bad customer service by the people that work at the cashier, I don’t know if he is the owner but he needs to learn how to deal with customers, he over charged me and then he got piss because I ask for my receipts and notice I got over charge, order 4 pupusas, they have a promotion of 4 pupusas but he charge me for 4 separated instead arguing that if you don’t ask for the promotion he will not give it to you, then got the pupusas into 3 and 1 separate, he charge for 2 jicamas that I didn’t order that were $2 more each
The pupusas are not good, no salt and a lot of masa, really little filling

The most disgusting and overpriced pupusas I have ever tried!! I ordered cheese and beans pupusas, they were grossly thick and dry and even there wasn’t enough beans. My daughter order the mango slushy and we where hoping it would be fresh mango slush it was actually fake mango juice prefrozen and just some bits of mango on top and the mango bits were sour!!! DO NOT BUY FROM THIS PlACE!! I wish so much I had read the previous reviews before literally throwing almost $60 on garbage pupusas!!
Good Pupusas here but it’s a “to go” situation. There is a park nearby where you can sit and eat if you aren’t ordering for at home.

reviews:
If you come here make sure you book a reservation because it can get very busy and when you do arrive make sure the host knows which time slot you're at or you will get bumped behind many people. We came here for the senior discount and for the price you can not go wrong.

The food selection was pretty good, lots of missing items and you need to remind them.  The staff seemed a bit overwhelmed as well.  It would be nice to have free softdrinks as well like some AYCE sushi places.   Softdrinks is cheap and it will fill up your guests quicker.

Came here to try an All-You-Can-Eat with our friend visiting from Montreal, and since my family and our friend all like sushi, decided to give it a chance. Did like all the robots zooming around the building, quite interesting concept. The server was a great guy. So these were the reasons why two additional stars. Tables very uncomfortable, you definetely do not want to stay too long as you feel squeezed between chair and table, absolutely did not like this. Quite disappointed with food quality, as the assortment wasn’t the greatest (I don’t know if it’s related to a Monday visit). Some of the

Second time visited to Robo Sushi for lunch, and overall it is a good experience.

The tablet for ordering has many variety of Japanese AYCE buffet with everything from soups, salads, sushi rolls, handrolls, pizzas, grilled skewers, fried items, noodles, udons, with extras like Chinese dimsums. Overall the portions are good with some limitations.
There is limited choices of self-serving dessert station.

The restaurant is clean, and the seating are well-spaced. Lunch is very busy, food serving considerably quick and the staff are attentive and friendly to customers.

It’s very reasonably price

I gave 10/10 because ratio of salmon and rice is perfect without being overloaded. Exactly how it should be compare to other AYCE place.
Everything here so fresh and price is generous. The Lunch has a good deal, will try Dinner menu next time.

Not to missed the point, from the Service here all friendly and attentive. Thanks to An, Linh, Phu, Uyen and Tao. The best team ever.

reviews: My favourite cafe in the area! Like a cozy living room filled with warmth, art, board games and delicious food and drinks. Hamoon, the owner, is super kind and welcoming and so is everyone else I've encountered - whether it's people working at the cafe or other guests. I've been to one of their workshops (crochet) recently and it was such a unique experience being in the cafe after hours with a group of 10/12 people and just doing crafts in such a cozy environment. I love the Persian tea with rose and the spinach feta bakery item! They have free wifi as well. I've been when they play live musi

Roozamoom is a true gem in the city! The vibe is the perfect mix of eclectic hippy-chic and old-school Persian soul. Between the live music pop-ups, DJ sets, and the resident cat Juliet—she’s the absolute best! , the atmosphere is incredibly homey and community-oriented. The owner is always around making sure everyone feels welcome. My personal favorite is the Persian Tea, which is delicious and, best of all, refillable. 10/10 recommend!

cozy, nice and warm cafe with a cute cat in the house! the barista was really nice and welcoming had a good chat! the drinks were sooooo good that i need to go every week for real! i wish it was near me aha!
saffron blossom iced tea and the saffron pistachio latte were amazing!! i’m still thinking about those haha😭vibes are chill with good music and good atmosphere.

This café has a very unique and cozy atmosphere. The moment you walk in, you notice the carpets on the floor and the old chairs and tables, which give the place a warm, nostalgic character. It doesn’t feel like a typical coffee shop at all — it feels more like someone’s living room, in a good way.

The lighting is very low and intimate, with candles lit everywhere, creating a calm and relaxing vibe. It’s a great place to sit down, slow things down, and actually enjoy your coffee. The coffee itself was also quite good and well prepared.

A nice touch was the complimentary gulab jamun with rabri they offered us to try. It was delicious and a perfect way to end the meal. Overall, good food, thoughtful service, and a place we’d happily visit again. Spl thanks to Chef Gunjandeep and best of luck.

I just had the most amazing Indian meal in ages at this spot today. Seriously, it’s been way too long since I’ve had food this good! I went for the curry and biryani, and both were absolute winners: rich, flavorful, perfectly spiced, and just hit the spot.

The portions were generous too. On top of that, the service was fantastic. Super friendly and attentive without being over the top.

If you’re craving authentic Indian food, you have to check this place out. Highly recommend!

Saffron Mahal Indian Cuisine came up while browsing for some of the better Indian restaurants in the GTA, and booking a table here turned out to be a solid decision. Despite the crowd and a packed waiting area, we were seated right on time at 8 PM.

The interior stands out — Mughal-inspired décor with portraits, paintings, and traditional-style doors adds a classy touch and sets the mood well.

We visited this restaurant for the first time with our family while casually looking for a place to eat in Scarborough. It popped up with great Google ratings, and since it was New Year’s Day and a working day, we assumed it wouldn’t be too busy. Turns out we were wrong—we had to wait about 30 minutes. That said, the small and cozy waiting area made the wait comfortable, and since we were dining with a kid, the staff kindly offered us a corner table, which we really appreciated.

We visited Saffron Mahal on Saturday night and had a wonderful experience. The food was absolutely delicious, with great quality and authentic flavors. On top of that, the service was excellent—friendly, attentive, and prompt. My wife and I truly enjoyed our evening here and would definitely recommend Saffron Mahal to anyone looking for great food and a pleasant dining experience.

reviews:
For those in the Eaton Centre looking for something quick and good for a snack, Saint Germain is definitely a great option.

The store is located at one of the exits of the TMU station, with easy access to the metro and the street exit via escalators.

The bakery's service is very fast; they are constantly restocking products, which are always fresh and hot, and they always have fresh drinks on display.

The prices are attractive, averaging $2.50 and up, making it a quick option for those who don't want anything elaborate but want to eat something well-made.

♿️For customers with disabilities

Well it is quick bite stop in busy eaton centre. If you don’t have time you can just grab a snack and eat while shopping.

They multiple savoury options but we went with bun with curry inside. It was dry and that was unexpected but still it was flavourful. Would definitely come back to try their extensive menu.

Fresh hongkong styled buns with very insane turnover rates. The buns are guaranteed to be fresh. You are paying slightly premium for freshness and sourced ingredients though. Asides from that, it's very convenient in the Eaton Center right off the subway. They serve more traditional seasonal desserts and pastries as well. The atmosphere... I mean it's crowded for sure. That's a good sign for freshness at least.

The lobster fest looks kinda goooood (they said they can heat the bisque but not the sandwich I asked lol). I got the butter pineapple bun and the mango gogo, the butter pineapple bun is simply HEAVENNNNNN, tho the mango gogo half the cup was ice 🥀 since they already put the drinks there, you can’t customize ice and sugar levels, imo it was lil too sweet, but rlly liked the butter pineapple bun is super good and a great price also

Edit: also got the rose cheese bread and the molten cheese tart I think it’s called, the rose cheese bread is great, it has lots of cheese in it very generous lol,

SANGEETHAVEG||3601 LAWRENCE AVE E, #1 M1.matchedAddress: 3601 Lawrence Ave E, Scarborough, ON M1G 1P5, Canada
reviews:
A hidden gem everyone should know about!
I must say this place is a hidden spot that more people need to discover. The food was absolutely amazing. I tried the paper dosa and the ghee dosa — both were outstanding, crispy, flavorful, and perfectly made. Highly recommended!

The restaurant has a large dining space, including a comfortable family dining area. Everything was clean, and the service was excellent — friendly, attentive, and quick. Overall, a wonderful dining experience and definitely worth visiting again.

Ate dinner here with a friend. Ordered the Mini Idly, Spinach Masala Dosa, and Paneer Dosa. Everything tasted great! And the sambar, chutney, and all the other dips were top notch. I do prefer the Paneer Dosa, but spinach is good too!

This is the 3rd time I've been to this restaurant and they do not disappoint.

For the items ordered with tax and tip come to just under $50. So, $25 per person.

We ordered Mysore Masala Dosa , Podi Idli and Medu Vada

Dosa had so much garlic , I couldn’t taste other flavours

Podi Idli was delicious but then the powder had some hard ingredients it was so tiny that was getting stuck and making it uncomfortable to eat. So it was spoiling the mood.

Vada was sad !! Not at all crispy or hot .. disappointed

They served so little chutney and they charge extra for chutney. There are so many South Indian restaurants in Scarborough that serves good food and don’t charge for Chutney absolutely. How will one not take extra chutney with huge dosa or such dry Vad

Waitress was super diligent, kind  and informative. She was amazing and made us feel welcomed. Probably the best service we have received in years.  Food unfortunately was bland, but presentation was beautiful.

reviews: Great addition to the neighbourhood! I’ve been here a couple of times since it opened and have been very impressed with the food. Great new place! Tried the falafel plate and was very happy with that choice, will be coming back to try the schnitzel sandwich!

Sooo happy this new place replaced Freshii.

The space itself is very clean and bright.  All the food on display looked really appetizing, and the owner is very kind and passionate about the food.

Go check this p

reviews: We went this restaurant to eat unlimited pani puri. I never had this kind of awful pani puri in my life ever. All different pani and Ragda was looking like it made before a week and they are keep using it. Their spicy pani was too salty and there was no other taste than that. No mint pani at all. Tamarind Pani was too smelly and pretty old. I never had this kind of bad experience before for food, but it wasn’t worth to spend money at all. Not hygienic at all too.

Tried out this new place for the first time and I must say I was not dissappointed, they have live pani puri station , and opening special offer $1 for Dabeli and Vadapav each both of them were freshly prepared on order unlike other places.( hence a little of wait time)
I also tried their Dahi puri which was more on savoury side but still good , it’s just my preference that I like my Dahi puris sweet and tangy overall great experience , will visit them again for their pizza and wings

Ordered 3 things. The Fanky was burnt and tooo salty. It was soo overcooked that it couldn’t even roll up! Asked to not add capsicum in sandwich. But was ignored. My sis is allergic so that was wasted. The sandwich had vadapav vada and some(literally some as all I could see was potato) diced veggies in it which was wayyy different than what mentioned and shown. Also ordered a milkshake which tasted like plain milk!

We had an amazing experience trying the samosa chaat, vegetable sandwich, and pani puri — each item was fresh, flavorful, and worth every bite!
The person was friendly and quick, and everything tasted homemade. If you’re craving authentic Indian street food, this spot is a must-try. Highly recommend!

Might not be the best food in Scarborough. However ur treated well and the guy behind the counter is accommodating. We ordered dabeli, vada pav and pizza. Pizza were both good. Vada pav was spicy as asked for.. dabeli can be better (adding some peanuts, green chutney will make it much better than it's current taste).

Overall good experience.

reviews: Great spot to pick up dinner for the family. The variety is incredible, so many dishes ready to eat and more behind. Also many Indian sweets and desserts wow, curry chicken, chicken karahi, too many to list, we will be back for sure.

Come try some amazing flavourful Indian food at Spicy Indian Flavour inside Ample Food Mart at 605 Rogers road. Great selections  of vegetable and non vegetable dishes. We tried the veggie pakora, palak paneer, chana masala and daal makhani. All the dishes are delicious, flavorful and just the right spices. Not much left after a hearty lunch.

Don’t let the grocery store location fool you—this spot delivers some seriously great Indian food and is absolutely worth seeking out.

reviews: One of the best places around for some authentic Lanzhou noodles. I personally love a hot bowl of soup noodles during cold season. The part I love the most about this place is that I don’t feel overly thirsty after having lunch here.

Glad that they opened their 2nd store in this area.  I used to go to their Mississauga location.  Loved their beef broth and hand pulled noodles.  I would say it’s best Lanzhou noodle soup I have had so far.

Chocolates and treats from a far away land. The brands may be familiar, and yes you pay up. But the chocolate flavours are more unique and the quality is far richer.

I ordered through Uber Eats and found the menu very misleading. The description says the dish includes rice and tahdig, but selecting “with bread” actually means they replace rice with bread.

This is not explained anywhere in the menu. If I wanted to replace rice with bread, I would have written it in the special instructions.

The restaurant should clearly state “replace rice with bread” to avoid confusing customers.

Food was fine, but the menu clarity needs improvement.

reviews:
This restaurant was incredible.

I got a fried Camaron Frito (shrimp) taco and an Adobada (pork & pineapple) taco. Both were great. I really like the corn wrap but also tried the floor version.

Worth a trip across the city. I'm still sweating a little from the hottest hot sauce they offer.

I spoke to the cashier again and complimented the how nice everything was, and found out he's the owner, na

First time finding this gem tonight on a whim, my family and I just came back from visiting Mexico and are planning on heading back soon. This place is as authentic as it gets. Everything is just perfect, the food, the staff and service are incredible and the vibe is relaxed and welcoming. As soon as you walk in, everything makes you feel like you just been transported to Mexico. We love it so much.
Mucho gracias y hasta luego!

Great salsa bar ranging from Pico de Gallo (zero spice) up to habanero and even a fried arbol pepper salsa similar to a Macha. It's got a kick! They even have a Cali burrito (with fries in it - yes that's a thing in SoCal). Tasty guac too!! Highly recommend the food and the service is top notch!!

Walking into Tacos Moras, I was struck by the atmosphere before I even tasted the food. There is a specific kind of beauty in a kitchen filled with laughter; hearing the staff playing and joking behind the counter felt like a soundtrack to a well lived life. Even sitting there alone, the great music and the vibrant energy of the space made it feel like a sanctuary.

I usually have a tendency to push through hunger, but stopping here was an act of self-alignment.

I went with my friend he’s Mexican ahaha he said it’s good ! I’ve been here 3 times and the food still taste the same ! Portion size are really good and you can serve yourself all the hot sauce and toppings you want 😛 the service is really fast and you can dip your tacos into the consume and order a horchata okay don’t buy Coca Cola drink horchata is amazing and you should order 3 tacos 🌮 that should be enough to fill you up check it out

Popped in here for lunch for the first time recently and was very pleased. There are plenty of great options for food in this neighbourhood and Tacos Mora's is among the best. I ordered a chorizo burrito. Burrito was huge, filled with plenty of chorizo and not all rice like a lot of places. The chorizo was well seasoned, tasted very authentic. I loved their little condiment bar so I could pick a couple of salsas to accompany my burrito.

Service was great. Workers were friendly, helpful, and made my food quickly.

Had one of my all time worst dining experiences ever at this place. The staff were extremely rude, didn’t say hello or smile when we ordered and seemed annoyed we were there. It felt really hostile.

We ordered steak nachos to stay, a pork taco, and a chicken quesadilla. EVERYTHING BUT THE PORK WAS COLD! The cheese on the nachos? Unmelted string cheese. Not even an attempt to melt it. All the other toppings were also cold. The steak wasn’t seasoned at all and very fatty and chewy. The side of salsa and guacamole it was advertised to come with was just a tiny dollop of each right on top of the

TADKA MARUN||4379 KINGSTON RD, #5 M1E 2M.matchedAddress: 4379 Kingston Rd, Scarborough, ON M1E 2M9, Canada
reviews:
Visited Tadka Matun and had a mixed experience.
Ordered Puran Poli, which was good and comforting. Puri with Aamras was also enjoyable and nicely done.
However, the Pav Bhaji didn’t meet expectations. On a positive note, the staff was responsive and replaced it when we mentioned the issue, which we appreciated.
Overall, it was a decent experience with some good dishes, but there’s definitely room for improvement, especially in consistency. Would consider visiting again to see how things evolve.

A true taste of Maharashtra @tadkamarun
We tried the Misal (perfectly spicy & soulful), Kolhapuri Chicken (bold, fiery, and full of flavor), and the Malvani Pomfret Fry—crispy outside, absolute coastal flavour.
The Vade paired beautifully with the gravies, and we wrapped it all up with Puran Poli that felt like a warm homemade hug.
Authentic flavors, generous portions, and serious comfort-food vibes.
If you love traditional Maharashtrian food done right, this place is a must-visit!

Being a Maharashtrian I decided to visit here. I have been to tadka marun around last month and loved their misal pav. So decided to visit again today but the food was terrible. I ordered vadapav, misal pav and mutton vade.
1. Vadapav was not fresh. Pav was falling in pieces and was hard as if it was kept open for 2 days. Vada had no to little flavour. Their garlic chutney was good tho. (Last month when I visited they gave cold vadapav, which was later changed) but again this time it was warm, not hot.
2. Misal pav was the worst of all, it felt like they gave spicy water with extra oil and som

The food was authentic, meaning they had not diluted the flavours for the North American palate, as you see in many restaurants.  I very much enjoyed the spice levels!
The solkadi had khada masala or chat masala in it, which is really not typical, so 4/5 stars.
The vada pav was excellent - 5/5
Kingfish thhali with shrimp curry - great, 4.5/5 stars.
Bombay chicken biryani - so-so, not as flavourful as in Mumbai - 3.5/5.
I would go back to try some of the other dishes. Overall a nice experience.
Staff was extremely polite, and it was nice talk in Marathi.

A perfect tadka of spice, flavour, and warmth. We tried the Veg Kolhapuri, Vada Pav, Masala Papad, and Puri Bhaji, and every bite was an absolute delight! The dishes had that authentic, bold kick of spice that wakes up your taste buds in the best way possible. The Masala Papad deserves a special mention crisp, beautifully layered and bursting with freshness and zest. It set the tone for what turned out to be a truly satisfying meal. If you love Maharashtriyan Food then Tadka Maroon is the place to be.

reviews: The sushi here was really great, especially the salmon oshi! Everything we ordered was delicious. The restaurant is kind of small, there was only enough seating for around 4 groups, luckily it wasn't very busy when we visited. Overall I would highly recommend!

New Japanese spot on the Danforth. Got a bunch of stuff: fancy chirashi, bc tuna tataki, aburi scallop sushi, shrimp tempura, soft shell crab, and shanghai soup dumpling. Pretty good quality and taste, ok portion size, prices are what prices are these days. Bonus points for the super extensive menu.

I came here again for dinner, and it was as delicious as ever. The salmon slices are my favorite—fresh and tasty. The sushi was also quite good, and I especially loved their edamame 🫛, which was very freshly cooked. Overall, their ingredients are very fresh and delicious, and the price is great.

This place is so good!! The rolls are so delicate and delicious and the packaging is so cute. See our in progress dinner below 😅 it is a little pricy without the 15% discount, quality is definitely worth it but maybe they can tweak their prices a bit.
Everything was really great! If I had to choose one, my favorite item was the salmon oshi sushi.

reviews:
Smashing IT! 😎☕😎

By-far the best croissant and pastries in Toronto!

Stumbled upon this gem while Christmas Shopping and I am so glad that I did!

Tangssant Viennoiserie is a great meeting place and hang out to get some great coffee, matcha and delicious out-of-this-world pastries!

The pastries are filled with delicious fruity cream that is both exquisite and delectable!

I just love their Matcha Lattes! Whether hot or over ice it's all delicious and good.

The customer service is  also amazing!

Nestled in the heart of the Downtown Core not too far from the Eaton Centre and Dundas Station.

This is by far one of the best croissants and pastries I’ve ever had. Everything is made fresh onsite with best ingredients. Even on a snowy day there was a steady stream of customers and the workers were so busy making everything fresh working so hard behind the scenes. Love the open concept kitchen you can see where the magic happens. So not only is the pastries worth it. The service is also amazing.  This is a great place.

Absolutely love this café! Crispy, buttery, and freshly baked croissants!  My daughter loved it so much she even ate every little crumb left on the plate.The environment is cozy, clean, and very family-friendly. Highly recommended!

I walk past this bakery every day and the smell is always amazing, but I never had the chance to try it, until today. Absolutely delicious! Highly recommend the hojicha latte and the butter croissant.
The cinnamon brioche is also perfect for the holiday season.

I've been hearing a lot of great reviews about this spot and went to check them out. Pastries are gorgeous, well-made, and they have so many unique options. I picked up a few items and really enjoyed them! Loved how flaky the croissants were (but wished it was more buttery). I'm curious about some of their other pastries so would definitely go back if I'm in the area. The space is large but they only have a few seating spots and they fill up quick - hopefully they get some more small tables! Bonus points for super friendly and welcoming staff.

reviews: I stumbled upon this place while I was walking by on a cold Feb night and needed something light to eat. Ordered a pastor (pork) taco and steak volcano. I was taken back by the amount of salsas, sauces they provided. Every salsa tasted distinctly different and very tasty...they were all different levels of heat. The food tasted fresh and full of flavor. They also brought a big bowl of sauted onions and jalapenos. I definitely need to visit this place again with my wife. they priced so well...GREAT VALUE FOR MONEY AND GREAT TASTING FOOD!

Winner for best all-around tacos in the hood, with the loveliest, most golden hearted folks who work here. Tacos are a standout and authentic as can be — in a variety of mouthwatering, tenderized meats (still need to get the tripe when it’s not sold out, but the tongue and pastor are excellent!), supported in a sturdy double wrap with a plethora of sauces and salsas for garnish. I am a big sauce person and their sauces are awesome and diverse and an added flavour bomb, I always save them for future meals! Bonus: first ever taco joint I’ve seen in the city that gives you a free side of limes, f

Yesterday was my first time visiting this Mexican restaurant, and I was extremely happy with the experience. I came with three friends, and all of us loved the tacos—they were delicious, full of flavor, and had the perfect amount of spice. The service was wonderful, and the staff made us feel very welcome. Overall, we had a great experience. The environment was amazing, and the location was very clean. We will definitely be coming back and highly recommend this place!

Honestly, this place is good but not the best ever.

Nice double corn tortillas, but really missing the oil and juice that a taco should have.
The meat wasn’t as juicy and tender as I would have wanted.
The 6 variety of sauces was incredible though.
Great service.

Overall, a good Mexican spot but worth trying others around
I always come here for authentic Mexican tacos that are delicious every single time. The customer service is consistently friendly, helpful, and fast. Definitely recommend for tasty, authentic food!

reviews: The tacos here are so good, as a vegan I loved that this place was all vegan and they even have cheesecake! They had a Monday tacos deal for $3 off the tacos trio, highly recommend! There are limited tables to sit at but luckily there was space when we went

As a celiac, I've eaten at the one on DuPont, and now at their second location near Bloor/Ossington. I've never been glutened, and really really enjoy the food! I'm obsessed with the capeado tacos- they are my favourite. The nachos are awesome- I almost never find good dairy-free, gluten-free ones anywhere. These really hit the spot. I really hope this location does well, because it's conveniently a few min walk from where I volunteer.

Came here for the Grand Opening, but personally didn't enjoy the food. This might be due to my dislike for the "fast food" variety of Mexican food, which I find overly greasy and lacking in sources of actual flavor. Yet the prices suggest something comparable to a family-style restaurant, not fast food takeout. While I cannot see myself returning to this restaurant, I make an effort to support vegan businesses and will therefore recommend those who enjoy Mexican fast food to judge for themselves whether they find the offerings here worthwhile.

I went for the opening day celebration this past Saturday and was thoroughly impressed. Both the El Pastor and Carne Asada tacos were full of flavour and the sauces on the side really enhanced the experience. Everything from the tortillas to the proteins were well seasoned and felt extremely authentic. You can tell that lots of effort went into making the food taste great. TENACH MEXICAN RESTAURANT||933 ST CLAIR.matchedAddress: 933 St Clair Ave W, Toronto, ON M6C 1C7, Canada
reviews:
I have been coming to tenoch restaurant since 2022, and they haven't changed the prices on the menu since then.
The food is just amazing.  You can find more than 7 or 8 types of tacos and most of the food that we all crave from our beloved Mexico.
They have proper Mexican cocktails, Mexican Micheladas, margaritas (all types of it), mojitos, sangría, and so much more. Do you want to try those cocktails that you had in your last trip ?
They will make everything you request!!

The specials are just super affordable and yummy.

Mexican vibes in Saint Clair west !
100% recommended.

Tenoch offers an authentic Mexican cuisine. From the decor, the music, to every dish. Your tastebuds, eyes, and ears will be treated to a truly great experience.

The meat is perfectly seasoned and cooked to perfection. Savory,  and juicy I was pleasantly taken aback at the full flavor of every dish I tried.

The staff are super engaging and friendly and make you feel welcome.

TENOCH Restaurant on St. Clair Avenue West in Toronto is a cozy and authentic Mexican spot that perfectly captures the warmth, flavor, and spirit of Mexico. The atmosphere is welcoming, the décor is vibrant, and the food is absolutely delicious. Their chicken tacos, in particular, are a must-try — perfectly seasoned, juicy, and full of authentic Mexican flavor. The cocktails complement the dishes beautifully, making it an ideal place to relax and enjoy a great meal.

However, what truly makes TENOCH stand out is not just the food, but the incredible service. Among the team, Aremy truly shines.

We had a great meal at Tenoch. Restaraunt had a fun atmosphere and all the food was delicious. I'm not usually a big fan of corn tortillas but I really enjoyed how they prepared them here. Everything was really well seasoned and reasonably priced. Will definitely be coming back.

Tenoch (tea-notch) is the coziest Mexicana restaurant I have found in Toronto. I have been here 4 times so far. I'm an Irish Canadian, but love cultural exploration. Tenoch could be translated to Teacher, for friendly introduction and experience in Mexicana comida (food), and in general, beyond cultures and cuisine, perhaps the warmest place on St Clair W.  Tonight I had pozole, whatever you try, with an open mind, you will ❤️  💯

Very nice Italian restaurant, all the food are tasty and the environment is great, very Italian style. Also the service is really excellent , Chris is really nice and professional , we all like it !

Delicious food and a very enjoyable experience. We had calamari, radicchio salad with Gorgonzola and pears, mussels, and pasta - everything was fresh and full of flavor. My friend and I had pasta and it was amazing. I was also treaded with lots of respects and I would 100% recommend this place.

Went here to check out the new location on the Queensway and I will definitely be coming back. reviews:
Curry Kingdom truly exceeded my expectations! The food was well packed, keeping everything fresh and secure. The quantity was more than enough, making it a great value for the price.

Most importantly, the quality was at its peak—every dish was bursting with rich, authentic flavors. The taste was so incredible that my taste buds were dancing in delight with every bite.

If you’re looking for a place that delivers generous portions, excellent packaging, and unforgettable flavor, Curry Kingdom is the spot. Highly recommended!

Had an amazing dining experience by ordering from this restaurant. The food was absolutely delicious, full of rich flavors, and beautifully presented. Every dish tasted fresh and perfectly cooked, showing great attention to detail and quality ingredients. The balance of spices and seasoning was just right, making each bite enjoyable. Overall, it was a satisfying and memorable meal, and I would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for great food.

⭐️ ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

The Curry Kingdom in Etobicoke is my new favourite takeout spot! The food is always fresh, packed with flavour, and still hot by the time I get home. Their butter chicken and naan are amazing, and the portions are super generous. Great value and great taste every time!

Amazing delicious restaurant-like taste food prepared by the chef, Satbir Singh. My wife and I enjoyed the Paneer Butter Masala Curry and Paneer Chilli to the core. I had opted for pick-up and the food was ready for pick-up on the scheduled time, so I would say good service too. Definitely recommend ordering from The Curry Kingdom.

The Curry Kingdom is known for its authentic flavours, beautifully presented dishes, and consistently high-quality food. Their menu offers a great variety of traditional Indian cuisine, prepared with fresh ingredients and aromatic spices. The attention to detail and commitment to excellence truly sets them apart. A great choice for anyone looking to enjoy delicious, home-style Indian meals!

reviews: This is probably the ONLY place in Toronto that stands true to its claim “Authentic Donne Biriyani”!! I got a take away and kid me not, the cauliflower florets were so crisp and soft!! The donne biriyani rice couldn’t get any more authentic, the softness the flavour. I got that for dinner but couldn’t help devour them at 5 30pm!! Never to miss the pricing for the quantity and the quality of the food!! Hands down the BEST!! 🙌🏻🙌🏻

We recently tried the dum spot in food alley on Queen st in Toronto and we were so happily amazed to find this gem. They are the only restaurant in Toronto serving authentic Donne biryani and Parotta curry combo. Their lamb meat balls and ghee rice were also amazing. They also had few combos on their menu. Totally worth the buck - reasonablly priced and amazing flavours. Straight from Bangalore.

Got the Ambur & Donne Biryani. Both very distinct & very different flavor profiles.

The red one being the Donne Biryani & the Green one being the Ambur Biryani. Not oily. I found them to be a tad bit dry, even though I got them fresh as soon as they opened the store.

The Donne Biryani was flavourful with good heat coming from reg chill & whole spices.

The Ambur Biryani was herby with mint & coriander being flavor profile.

Sweet people running the store.

The Dum Spot really surprised me- in the best way. The rice was super flavorful, spiced just right- not too spicy, but still packed with that rich masala taste.
And the fried chicken kababs? So good! Crispy, juicy, and gave total Bangalore street food vibes. Took me right back.
If you’re missing proper South Indian-style biryani in Toronto, you’ve gotta try this place. Will definitely be going back!

I tried the Bangalore fried chicken (Called Kebab in the streets of Bangalore) for the first time here along with a friend who is a Bangalorian, and we both really enjoyed the fried chicken. It is super juicy, very well seasoned and crispy.

We tried them when we picked them up at the location but one thing to note, by the time it gets delivered it might get soggy so I popped mine in the air fryer for a bit and it was crispy and hot just like at the store location.

They also do not have a dine in option in the winter from what I could tell, but do give it a try if you are considering ordering

reviews: First time trying Ghanaian food in Canada. I enjoyed my trip to Ghana so I was looking for Fufu and peanut chicken soup. I was a bit disappointed here. Chicken was not fresh & the dish itself was not as tasty as I expected.  I was unable to finish. I gave 3 stars for service because the owner was friendly. however he did upmarket the price (don't advertise one price then charge the client another). I will not be recommending this restaurant to anyone and I will not be returning back. The restaurant itself needs a revamp and was not clean.  there were blood droplets on my table. Overall disappo
Excellent food and great portions.  Be prepared to take some home. Spicy so let them know to go easy if you need to.

This restaurant has a variety of delicious African food - mostly Ghanaian. You can choose to eat in or take away. I saw a promotion in the restaurant about how you could end up eating there for a full year if you bought or sold property through the advertising agent.

I liked that there was an option to pay in cash or card. I didn’t like that they wouldn’t take credit cards or a 100 bill.

There is free parking in front of the premise but it is used by customers visiting the adjacent businesses as well.

Limited room in the restaurant, better to take out if you are in a big group.

What a gem of a little place, a little mom and pop restaurant. They have vegetarian options. I had jollaf rice with fufu and peanut soup. I asked for egousi but the young lady recommended the peanut soup and I'm happy I took her advice. It was a tad spicy, so it helps to wait for it to cool. The portions are large so it's a bit much for one person but you can pack it up to go. It would be nice if they had a combo. Nice atmosphere and very polite service. Dine is costs extra but it worth it to relax. I'd recommend you try this place and support local businesses.

THE MIDYE||2862 KEELE ST M3M 2G8.matchedAddress: 2862 Keele St, North York, ON M3M 2G8, Canada
reviews:
A Taste of Istanbul on Keele!

If you're looking for a genuine taste of Turkish street food, you might be pleasantly surprised to discover a hidden gem on Keele Street: The Midye. This spot brings the vibrant flavors of Istanbul right to your doorstep, specializing in classic Turkish dishes, most notably their namesake, Midye Dolma.

The star of the show, as you'd expect, is the Midye Dolma (stuffed mussels). These aren't just any mussels; they are plump, flavorful, and packed with a perfectly seasoned rice and herb mixture. Each bite is a delightful combination of the fresh, briny mussel and

We got the half-loaf beef tantuni and the lavash wrap tantuni. Mussels were also DELICIOUS. It was very filling and the employees were so friendly. For sure we will go back to try their kokorec and kofte.

Amaaaaazing place! First, they are open till late night, considering we were a group of 7 whom all hungry at 11pm it was exactly what the doctor ordered!
Second, everything was tasty, specially midye was the best!! Must try!
Third but I think the most important thing is the staff was very kind, friendly and helpful. They were very accommodating as well which is not always with a big group late at night. We appreciated their smiles and work a lot. Thank you!!
Tried Istanbul style kokorech, and enjoyed. Just like in Turkey. It is great to taste this unique turkish street food it in Toronto.

I had the half bread of kokoreç and half bread köfte (Turkish meatballs) - both incredibly delicious and juicy. They’ve truly captured the taste of Turkish street food at a fair price with friendly service to match. :) Must visit!

reviews:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Exceptional Momos on the Danforth!
I had an incredible experience at Momo Station! We ordered the Chicken Chilli Momo, and I can honestly say they are the absolute best we’ve ever had. 🥟🔥

The balance of flavors was perfect, and you can really tell they prioritize both taste and quality. Every bite was amazing! If you are in the Danforth area and looking for authentic, delicious momos, this is the spot to visit.

Absolutely loved this place! The momos taste incredible — truly authentic and bursting with flavour. The staff, originally from Nepal, were so warm and welcoming, which made the experience even better.

I’m more than happy to make the trip from Mississauga to Scarborough just for their momos. Keep up the amazing quality — you’ve definitely earned a loyal customer!

Ordered chicken thukpa & jhol momo. The momo was okaish, i liked the thukpa more.Light spicy, perfect for Winter weather because it's soup and noodles which makes it filling. Can easily be shared by 2 person. Had karak chai, which was pretty good. The restaurant is clean with 6/10 people sitting space.

I recently visited The Momo Station and ordered Jhol Momo, Chicken Chowmein, Kadak Chai, Chilli Momo, and Mango Lassi. Unfortunately, the momo didn’t taste as good as I expected — it was a bit disappointing. However, everything else was really nice! The Chowmein, Chai, and Mango Lassi were delicious and made the visit worthwhile. 😊

Never knew the hype around Nepalese Momos—until I tried this spot - now I understand! These are some of the best in Toronto. You can truly taste the care in each bite. With a range of unique flavours, it's a local gem. Expect takeout lineups and limited dine-in space, but it’s absolutely worth the wait and experience.
