reviews:
A cosy, intimate, and delicious omakase experience! We managed to sniff out a last-minute cancellation, and it was totally worth it.

The fish was fresh, and every dish had us drooling with delight (though dessert was a bit basic and the least memorable). Watching the chefs work their magic with seasonal ingredients was a real treat.

Service was friendly, though sometimes a little stiff - even the best pups can get awkward. Still, this spot is a fetching addition to the neighbourhood and perfect for a special meal.

5 woofs out of 5.

Food here is good but I feel like the ratings are a little inflated. They've only been open for 3 months and it shows - they have a few kinks to work out in the service and course flow before I'd call it "perfect".

First, the food. This is a kaiseki-style omakase. I like the use of seasonal ingredients like snow crab, firefly squid and monkfish in winter. The dinner course is designed to be a showcase of the season's best ingredients and I think it did it justice. There wasn't anything technically mind-blowing, but overall almost everything was fresh and delightful. The rice with snow crab, m

When I first saw The Onda, the interior immediately caught my eye. It makes you want to pause and take it all in.

The dinner course included a variety of seasonal Japanese dishes, and you could tell the chef put care into every ingredient, big or small. The chef’s experience at traditional omakase restaurants really shows in the skill and precision of each dish.

Each dish tasted amazing, and the presentation and textures were just as enjoyable. I found myself looking forward to the next course the whole time, which made the dinner feel really special.

The servers were kind and attentive, wh

My boyfriend and I had a wonderful lunch omakase at Onda for $135, featuring 14 beautifully crafted courses. It's more than what we expected at this price point and absolutely worth it ✨🤎

From the warm, enthusiastic welcome to the incredibly attentive service, everything felt thoughtful and intentional. The food was outstanding, and you can truly feel the dedication and meticulous craftsmanship in every dish 🍣

An absolute must-try omakase experience! 🙌🏻

The Onda is a remarkable new addition to the culinary scene, offering an experience that goes far beyond the typical sushi bar. From the moment you step inside, it's clear that this restaurant is committed to delivering a truly authentic and high-quality omakase (chef's choice) journey.

The centerpiece of Onda is its unparalleled commitment to freshness and quality. The restaurant proudly sources its fish directly from Japan, flown in via airplane to ensure the highest standard of taste and texture. This dedication is evident in every bite.

reviews: 7 of us cousin crew went to drupatis last night to eat food and shake our butts. The Dj was great, food was amazing. The jerk wings were fantastic. Pulowrie was so good, we liked the crispy one! And everything else we put in our mouths was fantastic. Drinks lovely. Carina our server was so so good to us, so pleasant and attentive. We definitely will be back. Thanks for lovely evening.

Experience was excellent no wait time excellent service
And our server carina very polite my second time there and it was beyond my expectations
Food was excellent

You want authentic good food that feels like your momma cooked it??? You come here portions are amazing service is top notch and the food will give you foodgasims thats how good it is fresh quality mmmm the doubles is loaded with goat the chow mein is out of the world and their chicken Wonton you will not be able to have just 1.
Everything was perfect, such an amazing atmosphere and the food feels like it was cooked with love! You have to come try and feel the vibes!

It was nice to try some 🇹🇹 favourites while visiting Toronto, and Drupatie’s offered a mix of highs and lows.

The dhal puri was okay, though the peas lacked the traditional depth of flavour and the texture leaned doughy on the edges, softish, but not silky. The potato was so overcooked it blended into the curry, and I was surprised there was no chana.

The pholourie was quite heavy, more like dumplings than the light, airy bites I expected, a real letdown.  The tamarind sauce was nice.

The doubles were decent: the bara was thin and nicely done, but the channa was far too salty for my taste.

This location of Tropical Joe's  in Toronto is an absolute gem that deserves all the praise it can get! The vibrant atmosphere sets the perfect backdrop makes me feel like i am in the Caribbean.

While passing through the area i stopped in here and had the jerk chicken sandwich and the chicken poutine, and let me tell you, both dishes were outstanding.

The jerk chicken sandwich and the chicken poutine was delicious, the portions were so good i  had leftovers for later.

Staff at this location of Tropical Joe's were friendly and attentive, making it a better experience.

When ever  I am  in th

I used to eat here often when I worked as a teen in Gerrard Square, so I’m really glad it’s now closer to dt. The service was phenomenal — I called in last minute to see if they could hold a plate for pickup, and they happily did! The food is just as phenomenal as I remember from their original location. The jerk chicken was packed with flavor and served in generous portions. Additionally, hidden within the rice was also curried chickpeas + side slaw. You’ll definitely get your dollars worth here and I’ll definitely be coming back.

I had frequented the roti shop from the previous owner and loved the curry goat. Just dropped by this afternoon and decided to try the new curry goat and oxtail stew. The portions are much more generous and the flavours are delightful. As you can see from my photos the plate was overflowing and I probably used 20 napkins (which always means the food was good). I will definitely be back again! I encourage everyone in the area to drop by.

It was a bit strange that the waitress said the dishes would be too much for two people, but we managed just fine. At the end of the meal, they give you a fortune cookie, which is a nice touch.
As many other reviews mention, dumplings are their signature dish. The only odd thing was that they turned on the air conditioner at the

One of the best food experiences in Toronto! A must-visit place with amazing food and excellent service.
Some of the best Chinese dumplings I’ve ever had!

We’ve been coming here for 5 years consistently. Always DELICIOUS dumplings.

We appreciate the gluten free options!! The gluten free pork dumplings are awesome. The gluten free chicken ones were great.

Kids love coming here. They started by eating 2 dumplings and now finish a whole plate.

Would be cool if they introduced some more gluten free ones (how about shrimp?)

The gluten free soya sauce is delicious!

And the hot oil is so tasty.

Excellent staff and awesome experience.

Wow. Absolutely positively delicious. Top knotch Chinese food and I can't wait to go back for more.

The dumplings are incredible and don't miss out on the braised beef noodle soup.... Again WOW.

Really really great food without treking downtown or north of the city. Lucky to have this amazing Asian cuisine here in the Junction.

If you want "dumpling night", come here. When you come here, order the soup dumplings and the bottom skirt pan-fried dumplings. It is delicious! The dumplings were juicy. You are missing out if you walk by this place.

reviews:
I’ve lived in this neighborhood my entire life and was pleasantly surprised to see a Chinese BBQ spot open up nearby. I stopped by for pickup and ordered two items:
BBQ pork + roasted pork with rice – $10.99
Roasted duck with rice – $11.99

The total should have come to $24.53 after tax. I only realized after I left that I was charged around $27, as I received about $2.50 in change after paying $30. I’m not sure if they counted the cabbage and pickled radish as extra items, but if that’s the case, that's isn't right. Seeing there are some other reviews with pricing confusion, they need to be c

Forgot to take a picture before digging in! But this place is a good mix of nostalgia and modern, I always grew up having canto style bbq meat in Hong Kong and this place makes their bbq meat just the way I remember them. The interior decor is thoughtful and clean. Finally got to try this place after recommended by so many friends

About the food! Even though I eat them often I know so little terminology and specifics about which cut is better. The person helping me patiently explained what each technique and cut were for, we were better educated by the end of the ordering process. Brought hom

A Hidden Gem for Cantonese BBQ Lovers

Had the chance to try out this new Canton BBQ house, and it truly impressed. The BBQ duck stood out with its beautifully charred skin and a well-balanced flavor profile. The accompanying plum sauce added a delightful tang that perfectly complemented the richness of the meat.

The roast pork was a pleasant surprise — simple, traditional flavors done right. The meat was tender with a perfection layering,  and the bones weren’t overly salted, which speaks volumes about the chef’s skill and attention to detail. Definitely deserving of two thumbs up!

Overall,

My family and I all agree that this is the best Chinese BBQ restaurant in town. The food is excellent, and we especially recommend the roasted duck, honey BBQ pork and crispy roasted pork. The restaurant is clean and tidy, and we've been very satisfied with our several visits.

Very high-quality Cantonese BBQ. The roast meats are fresh, juicy, and full of flavor, with crispy skin and well-balanced seasoning. You can really tell they know what they’re doing. Solid choice if you’re craving proper Cantonese BBQ, definitely worth coming back for.

reviews: Definitely the best gelato I’ve ever found. Scoop sizes are great but so are the flavors!! 10/10 recommend.

Passed by this cutie gelato shop after dinner. This is my first time visiting and the gelato is surprisingly delicious. The owner said that they are home made formula. I tried the Cherry taste, fresh, creamy with cherry fruits. May visit again definitely.

Great gelato ice cream !!!! with 5-6 flavor options. Few flavors are seasonal. It is available in both cone and cup. I felt it was a bit overpriced for the quanity they served. It is situated right beside the famous pizzeria badiali. Dont know if they sell a genuine gelato ice cream or not but the taste was really good.

Authentic Italian gelato! The creamy consistency is what makes me come back for more! Also, the staff are very friendly. I always strike up a conversation with them.

My favourite flavour is the pistachio, I love how there are real pistachios in the gelato so I get the crunch with every other bite. It is a hidden gem, the place is fairly small with no seating but if you walk around the hood for a few minutes, you’ll be able to find a park with benches.

Nice service, but $7 for the smallest cup of gelato is a bit ridiculous (it’s $8 for a small waffle cone).

Banana tasted just okay (nothing special), but the gianduia had bits of ice in it, so I’d avoid it.

There’s also only 6 options available. I expected more options and much better quality, for the price.

reviews: Finally tried out this spot after hearing that they were selling a “Fat Panino” in collaboration with Fat Rabbit. We tried out the Fat Panino in addition to the Bollito. Both were generously loaded up with meat and were made from quality, fresh ingredients. Definitely leave some room to try out their desserts as well! I can’t wait to go back to try out some of their other sandwiches.

Was too busy INHALING my Bollito panino to get a picture, so I’ll make up for it with the Tiramisu instead. Been making my way through the menu these last few weeks, and everything I’ve tried so far has been incredible, from panino, to dessert. Fresh, quality ingredients, and a meticulous and attention to authentic flavour that take me back to my summers in Italy. Not to mention the beautiful, sparkly clean atmosphere, the cutest patio on ever, and the incredible, out-of-this-world Michelin quality service from Kaitlyn, Joe, and Elisa. It’s rare to see an establishment so committed to customer

I think the best sandwich I’ve had in the city that isn’t a sub. The tomato Fresca was delicious. You can also add meat to the veggie sandwiches if you want some meat. The tiramisu is also delicious. Would recommend.

They gave me free soup. Auto 10/10 to start. And I tried 2 sandys and they were both 👌. Bread fluffs and crunches, meats and sauces paired perfectly, slaw so interesting and refreshing. And it’s so cute in here too!

*update* (I’ve since been back 2 more times for the tomato sandwich. I plan to go back again this weekend. Cheers to Tutto!)

Very cute shop with handsome decor and an amazing vibe! The employees and owner (?) are all very kind, efficient and welcoming. We tried two sandwiches, the tomato and the bollito. Both amazing. UNAVU - TAMIL STREET FOOD||5745 FINCH AV.matchedAddress: 5745 Finch Ave E, Scarborough, ON M1B 2G5, Canada
reviews:
Very nice place with extremely tasty and fresh food. Today I ordered short eats chicken samosa, butter chicken rolls, and veg rolls. Everything tasted amazing and very fresh. The rolls were perfect, not too thick, and full of flavor.
I have never had a chicken samosa like this anywhere in the GTA  it was truly unique and delicious. Everyone should try their dishes at least once.
I’m very excited to try more items, especially their kothu. I’ll definitely be back soon and will update my review after trying it.
Thank you so much, guys, for the great food and excellent service!

Tried out the recently opened Halaal Tamil Street Food Takeout spot! I ordered Mac n Cheese Roll , Mutton Roll and Chicken and Shrimp Noodles . A bite of Mac n cheese and a bite of spicy Mutton roll together was Chef’s kiss 🧑‍🍳😙🤌. Very crispy rolls,flavorful and good size 🔥. The noodles tasted good too . Overall , good portion size , great quality , tastes authentic and reasonably priced. I have tried their Fried Chicken stringhopper Kothu and their egg appam. They were so yum. My go has to be their appam for a quick dinner .Do check them out , highly recommend. Definitely trying out the rest

I finally checked out @Unavu and it is definitely worth the hype 🔥

From the moment the food came out, you could tell it was made fresh. The Spicy Mutton Dolphin Kothu was packed with flavor, perfectly seasoned, juicy mutton, and that authentic kothu texture with every bite 👌🏽🔥 The spice level was just right, not overpowering but enough to give that proper kick.

The Medium Spice Chicken Fried Rice was so good.

And the Spicy Mutton Kothu Roti? 10/10. Rich, flavorful, and super filling. You can really taste the quality of the ingredients.

The portions are generous, the flavors are authentic,

Unavu is a whole vibe, the bright yellow stood out to us from a mile away. And just like that their food stands out and sets high standards.
We got the Nandu Puttu Kothu and the Unavu Style Pasta. And it was just too good! The flavours were on point and everything tasted fresh.
Definitely my new go to! 👏👏👏

Tried உணவு -  Unavu – Tamil Street Food, the new spot at Finch & Neilson, and honestly the food was so good. I grabbed their crunchy mutton rolls and tried Dolphin Kothu for the first time, no joke, I didn’t even get a chance to take a photo. I inhaled everything in like 10 minutes.

Super happy to see a place like this open up in Scarborough. Highly recommend any version of their Dolphin Kothu, and I’m already excited to use them for catering. Exactly the kind of spot we needed here. ✅🔥

reviews: Fantastic flavours and warm hospitality—every dish felt crafted with care. A place I’d happily return to again and again. We had chicken 65, chilli prawns and mutton biryani a photo reference can help you decide better for yourself 🤩

It was our first time trying their food, and we really liked it! I ordered from their lunch menu and didn’t expect it to be so filling. I have a pretty small appetite, and their portions are definitely more suited for a big eater. Good thing they had a takeout box for my leftovers. The staff are also nice

Food and service is good. We’ve ordered punugulu, mushroom mandi, egg biryani (not on the menu), mirchi bajji, military mutton and tandoori roti. All the dishes taste good. You can specify your spice level and they can make according to that. Overall recommended Indian restaurant near downview👍👍

We ordered the butter chicken and saag paneer. Unfortunately, both curries were very watery, almost liquid in consistency. The chicken pieces in the butter chicken were extremely small, smaller than my fingernails. The saag paneer had an overpowering cumin flavour that threw off the balance of the dish. The naan was very good though.

Food was so good, we had the Karivepaku Chicken , chicken 65 mandi and Dosa. All of them were delicious and Karivepaku Chicken is a must try . It has got all flavours of curry leaves.
The dessert "Double ka meetha" was so yum and a must try too. Highly recommended .

reviews: An absolute gem and wonderful addition to the neighborhood! We have been eating Vietnamese food all over the GTA for years and cannot be more grateful to have a quality Vietnamese restaurant downtown that's delicious, reasonably priced, and comfortable to dine in (these qualities don't typically coexist for downtown Vietnamese restaurants). We had a few classics, Pho Dac Biet, Bun Thit Nuong Cha Gio, and Goi Cuon - they were all excellent. It seems like it is likely a family-run business and there is a lot of pride in the quality of their food and experience. Also, this is just a cherry on top

So happy that this new pho restaurant just opened in this area! Was blown away by how great their broth was, and the freshness of all the ingredients. The service is also fantastic. Will definitely be coming back 🍜

What a wonderful gem of a new restaurant!! We absolutely loved our visit and the food was amazing. Anthony took great care of us and the ambience is so cute, cozy, and welcoming. Definitely recommend the pho, which might now be my new fave in the city! Will be coming back to try more!
The food here is amazing! Ordered the fresh rolls, spring rolls and Pho Tai Bo Vien and it was delicious!!And the ambiance is lovely and cozy

Bún Bó Hue is perfect!
Pho Dac Biet could really use more seasoning and flavoring to the broth, but still very good!

Love the spring rolls as they're just too addicting!!

I tried their brew, and it did not disappoint: the coffee is incredibly smooth and flavourful — rich but clean, with nuanced notes that speak to its high-quality, single-origin roots. I went with lactose-free milk, which was a thoughtful touch for those avoiding dairy.

Vereda Central is committed to direct trade, working closely with farmers and paying fair prices to support susta

I live in Burlington, Vermont,  I recently had the pleasure of finally enjoying an authentic Colombian coffee at Vereda Central while visiting friends. I’m very particular about the quality and taste of my coffee (I'm Colombian), and Vereda truly raised the bar. It was exceptional!

On top of that, the service was outstanding, making the whole experience an absolute joy. I only wish we had a Vereda in my city.

If you love coffee, Vereda is the right place.

Best coffee in the entire city, without question. Their dark roast is 👨🏻‍🍳💋👌🏻 and Edgar is a sweetheart! So friendly and knows exactly how to make a great coffee, as everyone does here. I always stop by on my way to work—I only wish they had a more northern location! 🫶🏻

Get ready to be blown away, downtown is well known for always having a quick not very approachable service. THIS place is the exception to this rule!
Everyone was so welcoming and helpful, we had an amazing time, very convenient VERY nice aesthetics and the coffee was one of the best I have had in a very long time.

Make SURE to check this out!

reviews: Stumbled upon this spot today, while we were looking for dinner late-night… and we haven’t stopped talking about how amazing it was. The service was phenomenal, food was delicious (and plated so eloquently), and the restaurant was so clean - high highly recommend. This is our new ‘go-to’ Vietnamese restaurant!

We had an amazing meal last night when fiest visiting this restaurant. The food was fantastic, reasonably priced and well portioned. They had a great selection, the music was pleasant and not too loud, very clean and well kept. They're only been around 3 months so we were happy to discover they were in the area. Everyone working there was extremely welcoming and friendly, attentive but not overly so and service was very fast. Great classic selections such as pho and rice/vermicelli dishes, as well as lots of appetizers and some nice dessert options (we didn't try this time). Their ginger tea i

Incredible food! If you're looking for proper, authentic, delicious Vietnamese food you should come here. I'd recommend my Vietnamese mom to come here, so that has to tell you something. I'm definitely making my way here anytime I'm in the area... I wish I lived closer.

Visited here a week or two after it first opened. Took a long time for me to be acknowledged when I came in despite a mostly empty restaurant but the server was apologetic. Definitely plan on returning at some point!

We were looking for restaurants that are still open late at night and apparently we found this Vietnamese place which opens until 2am! The food was really good and I love how they served the food like they are just new but they have a good and fast service! I also love how they make sure that we have ana amazing time in the restaurant. Bravo and definitely be back!👏🏼

reviews: I had a great experience at Viet Sandwich. The bánh mì was fresh, flavorful, and generously filled. My first impressions of this place is, amazing!

The Viet coffee and drinks, amazing! It always hits the right spot there is just something about a good quality coffee.

The service! Was so welcoming and homely it really feels like your walking into your neighborhood aunties local shop, the owner, so kind and hilarious felt like home.

Very friendly staff! Great service. Even at the last 5 minutes of closing. The bread for the banh mi is soo good. Baked fresh. Best to get the banh mi toasted. The pate flavour could be stronger but overall a good price for what you get. The cold cut needs more flavour, a bit bland. Still a great new banh mi shop. Will be back to try the drinks since they were sold out at closing.

reviews:
Amazing place for last minute plans, pickup and eat at home or for ordering in for parties.
I have tried their Biriyani and Parotta with chicken curry and they were on point.
Handles last minute party orders for up to 10 people and extremely responsive on phone.
Definitely going back to them for more varieties.

I was really looking forward to a warm, cozy Saturday afternoon meal, but this turned out to be a huge disappointment. I ordered the Fish Biryani and Paneer Biryani from Vijayawada via Uber Eats.

The food was extremely salty—to the point where I genuinely couldn’t eat the fish biryani. It was that overpowering. The rice in the paneer biryani was also overly salty, and the paneer itself was overcooked with an unpleasant, off texture. Almost made me think if they do not taste the food they serve.

They included a complimentary sweet, which I hoped might redeem the meal, but that too was excessi

I usually don’t write reviews, but this one deserves it—mainly because the restaurant uses the name of a city with a strong food identity: Vijayawada.

We ordered Chicken Biryani, Fish Fry, Chicken 65, and Country Chicken Curry. Unfortunately, none of these dishes came anywhere close to the actual taste Vijayawada is known for.
•	The fish fry was partially uncooked, which is unacceptable.
•	The biryani was dry and lacked flavor—not even remotely close to authentic Vijayawada-style biryani.
•	We ordered a regular portion, but what we received was a small. I should have checked before leaving, b
I’m hyderabadi, loved the whole experience from food pickup and consuming. Awesome quality and quantity. I’m hoping kitchens like this sustain. Wishing them good luck 👍

For biryani lovers best place , when you take a spoon of biryani you can feel aroma of spices and chicken jus in rice as well , for me it’s a perfect biryani only I am missing Salna it will enhance the flavour and dryness of biryani. But for me the best biryani I had after long time in Canada .portion size is perfect I will order again for my family get together keep it up.✌️👍👍👍👍

reviews: Wing station is my family’s favourite to-go-place in Scarborough when craving for wings & burger. Wings & fries is always a good combo but for us, their house rice (Pat’s rice) is the best combo for the wings. It is not available all the time. What we do is to call ahead while making our way to the restaurant and order ahead the Pat’s rice. Their service is outstanding. Order normally takes 25-35 mins so plan accordingly. This place is a gem for us with great food, value for money and amazing service!

My second visit here.

FOOD
Food was heavily seasoned which made it 10/10. We got the TWIN SPECIAL = great deal for couples. Came with two flavours, 2 drinks, and chili onion fries. Also, the wings were not tiny as you would typically get at other wing spots. They were medium sized. We had extra to take home.

The mozzarella cheese sticks was definitely not worth $9 though…

PARKING
Located in a plaza = lots of parking space.

STAFF
Friendly. Cant complain.

Super clean place, amazing service and the food is bomb! Highly recommend you try the chili fries but heads up it's spicy. For wings, found level 4 was comfortable spicy, but next time we will try level 5-6 and maybe bring some friends :)

reviews:
What a gem in Downtown Toronto! I never expected to find freshly roasted, crispy Peking duck right in DT — no need to drive up north anymore!

I tried their $19.99 Special Combo, which includes ¼ Peking Duck, 10 pancakes, veggies, sweet sauce, Samyang spicy noodles, and a drink. The duck came out hot with glossy, crispy skin, and wrapping it with spicy noodles and cucumber was absolutely delicious.

Their duck dishes are surprisingly diverse — and all the ones I tried were great:

✅Crispy Duck Strips: crunchy outside, tender inside, addictive bites that you can eat on their own or wrap in panc

Peking Duck is one of my all-time favorite dishes, and I’ve tried many versions across different restaurants while searching for that precise balance of aroma, texture, and flavor. I can confidently say that XiHe Peking Duck delivers one of the best experiences in Toronto. The set options are thoughtfully composed, the duck is beautifully roasted, and the ability to have the bones cooked to your preference for a small additional fee is a great touch. I’m genuinely happy to have this place open—it brings back flavors I truly miss from China. Highly recommended. Don’t hesitate to order; this is

Very mid. Of course you get ok portion for the price, but the flavour is not there. Pancakes - chewy, duck - cold and not salted or seasoned at all. In fact duck bones turned out to be more flavourful than the actual duck meat. Maybe it was worth to try their other dishes, like Quackwhich or noodles. That said if you are in a pinch - this is a very very good place, good compromise and for the price it may be worth for some. Maybe not for me.

Service is ok, but they are very busy.

I would recommend to try once, but I do not think I will be coming back.

Amazing duck! I uber ordered and like their clean packaging a lot. The duck is soft and flavorful as meat is supposed to taste. I love that they put sauce on the side as opposed to an American way of making meat super salty/sugar/heavy on spices.

Cute little space for Peking duck in Toronto.

We ordered the half pecking duck plus 2 noodles.

The duck was delicious and the skin was crispy. You get enough wrap and accompaniments but you can also buy extra if you want.

We would come back here again and try the other ones.

First time we've been to this place, on the recommendation of Mexican friends. Wow!!! we were surprised by the exquisite taste and quality of your food, it is very worth waiting for freshly prepared food.
Ana Maria's excellent attention, kindness and formality is superb. The two meals my wife and we ate (Gordita ahogadas y huarache de costilla) are too good in taste, presentation and quantity.

The food was delicious, with excellent quality and portions. Some of the best Mexican food I had. The place was cute, clean, and had a great vibe with nice music.

reviews:
Found this warm, bright Japanese donburi spot on Queen West🍚
🌟The kind of place that instantly makes you feel cozy. Open kitchen, super clean space, and watching the chefs cook everything fresh is part of the joy.

They specialize in GYUDON, with 7 different topping combos. The beef is freshly sliced in-house, tender and flavorful, soaked in their house-made sweet-savory sauce.
/Add scallions + a runny onsen egg and it’s basically sukiyaki in a bowl 🤍
•
Came back again for the dry udon and loved it just as much.❤️

A lovely japanese udon joint to enjoy some good udon and curry. I was also impressed by their family restroom with an actual solid wooden change table and not one of those plastic fold down ones that you usually see in public restrooms. Their decorations by the restrooms were also pleasant for the eyes. Overall, good food with excellent service and atmosphere.

Came across this place spontaneously as we were walking around deciding where to eat dinner! The exterior caught our eye and it didn’t seem too busy.

We instantly loved it as it reminded us of Japan! The service was quick and very friendly too.

We ordered using the QR code and realized they are giving discounts ⭐️

• The YukiUdon broth was on the savoury side, but the beef was very tender and well-seasoned. I added an onsen egg to mine! The portion was very large as I couldn’t finish the noodles. It’s a solid udon if you’re craving it, but nothing too special :)

• The CurryDon was yummy too

We were craving some Japanese style curry and happy we found this place! It was so nice and clean inside, service was lovely and the food came out quick. reviews: Tried this potato noodle place for lunch. It’s small but cozy, and the waitress was super friendly. The noodle portion was pretty big for me. Just a heads-up—it’s very hot when served! Perfect for cold weather though. I also liked the fried snacks.

Potato noodles come out in piping hot broth, perfect for a cold winter day. We loved their fried enoki mushrooms, lotus, and pork ribs. Staff is also so friendly and attentive. I can’t wait to come back.

We ordered the tomato broth potato noodles, one with beef slices, another with braised pork belly. There wasn’t a lot of meat. I found the potato noodles were slightly undercooked, but because the clay pots are extremely hot, it eventually cooked it thoroughly. The potato noodles have a very bouncy texture, and require a lot of chewing.
You can customise spice level and toppings to your liking. The taste is alright, hot broth is nice on a cold winter day.
Ordered twice. Really good taste, will order again.

reviews: Had such a great experience at Tonton. Loved the pandan matcha! As someone who loves matcha, I could tell right away their quality was top tier. Honestly, best matcha I’ve had downtown. Also had the pleasure speaking with the owners mom, who was so lovely & gave great recommendations for the next time! :) will definitely return.

My fiancé and I got Matchas today from TonTon and we’re both pleasantly surprised!! I’m picky with my Matcha and I was skeptical of the flavours, but the coconut one was such a unique taste!! The girl behind the counter was so cute and friendly!! I think her name was Kim.

100% recommend !!

Came here with my boyfriend and tried their most popular drink, the Iced Coconut Pandan Matcha Latte, while he got the Hot Brown Sugar Hojicha Latte. Both were good, but I have to say I liked the Brown Sugar Hojicha Latte more — the taste reminded me of tapioca in bubble tea.

Hojicha and Matcha is good. But I have to keep going back for the brown sugar pandan matcha and brown sugar Hojicha.

Tip: Order less sugar, you can always add more.

Very much the best matcha I’ve had in so long. I ordered on uber to work and it took a while and I also forgot it outside (whoops) and somehow it STILL tasted delicious. Matcha is strong, fresh and not grassy or fishy like other lower grade matchas. The coconut pandan one changed my life. Highly recommend.

reviews:
We visited South Indian Street Bites for dinner with our family and had a lovely experience. The restaurant is small but has very cute and cozy interiors, with three booths and separate tables. We were seated right away in one of the booths.

It was our first time trying Punnugulu, so we ordered the Chinna Punnugulu along with Karvepaku Gobi as appetizers. For the main course, we chose the Vegetarian Fried Rice and the SSS Special Chicken Fried Rice. The server asked about our spice preference, and we requested spicy. We also ordered Ghee Idly for our little one.

We really enjoyed the Punnugu

Great experience at this restaurant on Saturday evening! We ordered the Mysore Bonda and Veg Manchurian Noodles, and both dishes were absolutely delicious. We loved the food and will definitely be coming back.

The breakfast buffet was quite nice! We walked in on a Saturday morning to the ‘Srinivasa Venkatesa’ music which felt beautiful. The restaurant decor and seating is good too. Specially the uggani with mirchi bajji, poori with besan curry and upma were delicious. The tea is fantastic!

Based On My baised experience on February 14 2026.

Had a great experience at Street Bites! The dosa was absolutely delicious — perfectly crisp on the outside and soft inside, just the way it should be. The flavours were authentic and satisfying. The ambience is really nice as well — clean, welcoming, and comfortable for dining in.

A special mention to Jayshree for the warm and friendly service. She made the experience even better with her attentive and positive attitude.

Definitely coming back again!

reviews: I went here because I purchased a Too Good To Go meal. I received a fresh chicken bowl that was packed with vegetables & rice & a terrific sauce! I was going to keep half but as I was eating it at the nearby park, it tasted so good I just kept eating! Will return to try more on their menu.

First time trying a Poke bowl so I came in with no expectations. The food here is delicious- the quality of the ingredients felt rich enough and the meal presented many different flavours all of which complemented it well. The meal pricing is appropriate given the quantity you receive. The lady in the front was nice and had good customer service. I am looking forward to returning.

TL;DR: Great poke bowls, good service, but a bit pricier than you would think. Still a good place for a quick bite if you’re in the area.

reviews: The katsu was perfectly battered and fried. We ordered the garlic spicy chicken katsu and katsu special set. Both were very tasty although if we had to, we'd give the slight edge to the pork over the chicken. Service was very attentive. Definitely worth a visit if you're in the area!

We came here for lunch on the Boxing Day. It was windy and snowing, so the restaurant is empty. We ordered four different katsu, the original, the curry, the honeycomb, and the silver and gold (two different kinds of cheese. The katsus were amazing and they mixed with the sauce la well. Each dish came with a small bowl of rice, soup, and salad. Each customer can reorder another bowl of rice free of charge. Overall, it was an amazing experience.
One of the best Japanese restaurants that serves decent quality Japanese curry, takoyaki and crispy Katsu also love that salad and soups are unlimited if you order a combo.

The katsu here’s amazing! — not the biggest fan of katsu myself buttt this is an exception. The wait time for food takes a little while longer (20 mins ish) but everything seems to be made fresh in-house.

The Original Pork Loin Katsu was delicious. The pork loin was crispy, tender and good. The original katsu sauce was awesome.

The Cheese Crabmeat Croquette was okay. It was crispy but we could not really taste any crab in the croquette.

reviews:
Had seen the place decided to celebrate a couple of friends birthdays. Before I write about the food, the service is impeccable, both Mouna and Moustafa were very attentive and professional.
The complimentary lentil soup was delicious, we had the mixed started with their tandoori bread everyone loved it. I had the chicken shawarma’s nicely presented and delicious, some had the mixed beef and lamb shawarma and everyone was delighted . The portions were very generous. Moustafa offered an Iraqi desert I believe is called daheen.

Nice and clean ambiance. If you are in the area a must to try.

They were handing out shawarma samples one night and we got hooked on their lamb+beef shawarma on saj bread.

We returned the next day for dine in and were served tandoor bread and lentil soup that had a nice kick of tumeric! The best lentil soup I've had. Shawarma wraps were just as good.

Very nice interior decor, clean, and friendly staff.

The service was amazing, very friendly and attentive staff. A lot of options on the menu that looked appetising, with decent prices and decent portions.

For dining in, they provide complimentary fresh bread and a lentil soup, which tastes really good.

I tried the shawarma wrap, which was honestly amazing, and love the pink sauce that it comes with. The eggplant salad was also good but I wasn’t a fan of the beef shawarma. I would definitely just get chicken next time as I thought the beef had a bit of a strong smell/taste.

Will definitely be coming here again to try the other menu items!

It’s a good place to dine in and enjoy their atmosphere. Their waitress are very friendly and takes care of your older properly. Me and friend of mine had ordered which we made a mistake so their waitress she (Sama) will take care of the order and they waved the money that we shall pay.
Their food price is pretty high compared to other Shawarma restaurants.

They deserve all the stars in the wrold !
First visit , great impression overall.
Very delicious tasty/ clean /well marinated fresh food. Cooked to perfection.
Top notch hospitality and care.
Beautiful staff ( merva the lovely host)
Skilled chef ( Moustafa on the grill ) and Nader as well..great skills.
Excellent management skills ( Mr. Taylor).
I wasn't planning on having my dinner there ..glad i changed my mind.
Nice background music nice vibes overall.
The lamb kebab is cooked to perfection..moist delicious meat & chicken.
The lentil soup is nice and warm.
The bread is Super loved it.
Not t

reviews:
Fun little restaurant where you get to choose your own ingredients and make a mini hot pot (~$20-30 per bowl).

Came in on Saturday at around 4 pm, and there was still a 20-30 min wait. Lots of students and young adults frequenting this restaurant.

You pick your own hot pot ingredients which are nicely laid out on one side of the restaurant. You pay by the weight of your ingredients ($3.99/100 grams). It's fun to strategize what to put in your bowl, but it adds up quick! I'd recommend adding light vegetables, bean curd, meats, and vermicelli while avoiding the heavier noodles and other filler

First time at Hi Bowl Malatang — and honestly, what a pleasant surprise!

I didn’t know what to expect walking in, but I was genuinely impressed. The place offers a wide variety of fresh ingredients, and everything tasted flavorful, rich, and authentic. You can really tell they use fresh produce and quality meats, and the broth had just the right balance of spice and depth. It’s one of those meals that warms you up instantly — hearty, tasty, and satisfying without being too heavy.

The process of choosing your ingredients was fun and easy, and the staff at the counter were polite and helpful i

Essentially, you pick a bowl of ingredients (from about a hundred choices) and then select your broth or have your choices sautéed with a house sauce. We enjoyed my meal, especially with the dessert. Will return!

Service was quick and courteous. Unprompted, a staff member offered us bibs.

There are no reservations. My advice is to join the queue online when you are close so that you can be seated quickly.

Ok, Food first.
1. Tiger Shrimp quality is not good, tastes like tofu, if u know what I mean. It only happens when the shrimps are of poor quality.
2. Beef Tripe was cooked at different qualities for two orders. One bowl is just right, easy to chew; another bowl is overcooked.
3. Mala Dry mix with less spice is not favourable. It could be my own opinion.

As for service, I am very disappointed.
1. No Apron was provided for my table for the white cloth, while all other tables were provided. I waited even till we asked for one more bottle of water, still no one asked.
2. I had to ask for a water

Hands down one of the best hot pot places. What makes it really fun is that you get to choose your own quantity of veggies, proteins, and add-ons, so you’re fully in control of your bowl. It feels interactive and customizable, which makes the whole experience more exciting.

They offer multiple soup base options, so you can switch things up depending on your mood — spicy, mild, or comforting. The service is fast, and once you’re seated, everything moves smoothly and efficiently.

That said, be prepared to wait a bit before getting a table, especially during peak hours. Totally worth it though.

reviews:
We visited on a Sunday morning and ordered Meryem Hanım’s breakfast for two ($99.99), although we were three ladies. First of all, the food was good and flavorful, and honestly, it was more than enough even for the three of us. There were so many nice options to choose from, and everything tasted fresh and well-prepared. We were also welcomed with Turkish tea when we sat down, which was a lovely touch.

However, the service unfortunately did not match the price point. It took quite some time for the server to come and take our order, and it was difficult to locate her as she seemed to be the o

We had the most amazing brunch here! From the moment we walked in, everything felt warm and welcoming.

The food was absolutely incredible fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. Every dish tasted authentic and perfectly balanced. You can really tell they use high-quality ingredients. We tried a mix of traditional Turkish brunch items and everything was spot on. The bread was fresh, the spreads were delicious, and the tea just kept coming exactly how a proper Turkish brunch should be!

Good food. The Menin (very runny scrambled eggs with lots of tomatoes) is a good breakfast choice.  The flat bread is delicious, crispy, and very rich. The staff are helpful explaining what things are and Google helps too if you aren't familiar with Turkish cuisine.  There are some great video of food being prepared but no names, so you don't know what to order. The service is friendly but can slow down when they get busy.  They have to figure out how to deal with the tables near the front door in winter, as it get cold everytime the door opens. A vestibule of screen would help to limit the di

My first time having breakfast here! I went on a weekday around 9:30 a.m., so it was nice and quiet. The atmosphere and service were wonderful. We ordered the  Breakfast for Two( Serpme Kahvaltı $74.99)  — plenty of food, and everything was fresh, warm, and delicious. The only downside was a light oil/fried food smell that stuck to our clothes after we left. Other than that, everything was great! I’ll definitely come again.

Has breakfast here and food quality was great. The place is very clean and neat and the waiter was nice and friendly. They also offer a complementary tea which is great. I do recommend Meryem Hanims food!

CHAIIWALA OF LONDON-MARKHAM RD||2250 MAR.matchedAddress: 2250 Markham Rd Unit 3b, Scarborough, ON M1B 2W4, Canada
reviews:
This is such a beautiful place that needs more customers. Or maybe it's because I sat down here during a slow period, but I loved how chill and cozy this place is.

Had the Cheese and Chutney Toastie and the Karak Chaii 50/50. The toastie was nice and light, and the chaii was just right. I might try it with no sugar next time, but the 50/50 was not crazy sweet, which is my preference.

I hope more people find this place. Their prices are very reasonable. Spent just under $10 for these two items.

I have been here twice so far. It's a cool chill spot 😎 I tried different dishes on each visit. First time I had Aloo sandwiche and 2nd time a breakfast dish. Both dishes were yummy. I had Chai Latte with oat milk as well.

Visited Chaiiwallah of London in Markham and immediately knew something was off when they offer incentives for a review.
The chai, was actually good.
But then came the butter chicken paratha… and a bonus ingredient I definitely didn’t order: a hair. That pretty much sent my appetite packing.
Also, every topping is extra: onion 50 cents, tomato 50 cents, cheese 50 cents. At this rate, I’m glad the paratha itself isn’t sold separately and assembled like IKEA furniture.
Tea: great. Everything else: character-building.

Cozy little cafe! Clean and the staff was so friendly. I got the butter chicken poutine and the soda of the day was flavoured with saffron. Highly recommend for a sit down meal or grabbing some tasty drinks to go and get your day started!

I come here often with my wife and we absolutely love it! The karak chai is amazing — it even reminds my wife of the chai back home in India. The food is always delicious and the customer service is excellent. Highly recommend Chaiiwala to anyone looking for authentic taste and a great experience!

SHIVA'S COFFEE BAR & SNACKS||3867 LAWREN.matchedAddress: 3867 Lawrence Ave E, Scarborough, ON M1G 1R2, Canada
reviews:
I always enjoy coming to Shiva’s Coffee Bar! Their cold coffee is consistently amazing—refreshing, creamy, and just perfect. The paninis are delicious every single time.
A special shoutout to Gopi, who serves me all the time with such kindness and great service. She’s always welcoming, friendly, and makes the experience even better.
This place has become my go-to spot, and I highly recommend it to anyone looking for great coffee, tasty food, and wonderful service! ☕🥪💛

Shiva’s is a must-visit for anyone who loves authentic Indian street food!

The food is absolutely delicious with perfect flavors and freshness in every bite. From the frankies and burgers to pav bhaji and butter maska bun, everything tastes just like India. The quality, portion size, and pricing are all on point.

This is best place which reminds me of actual our night out cafe vibes best food. Cold coco is best i never tried anywhere in Toronto. I loved their sandwich and Manchurian also. I felt satisfied after so long. Their prices are also reasonable as compare to other places. Staff is friendly. Best place to fill tummy and chilling out with friends.

Enjoyed the Chana Kulcha, Shiva's Special Italian Club, and Masala tea. Everything tasted incredible. The Italian club was vegetarian, with what I think is paneer inside. The kulcha was my favourite because it was so pillowy, light, and fluffy. I would order an extra kulcha next time.

For two people, it was around $35. Overall, it was a great spot for a light lunch. Will need to bring more family and friends here!

I’m from the USA and tried Shiva’s Coffee Bar for the first time – it was amazing! The chili garlic bread was the best I’ve ever had, full of flavor and perfectly crispy. The cold coco was super refreshing and tasted just like real Indian cold cocoa. Vadapav is amazing.I also loved the Manchurian – it was spicy, crispy, and really tasty. If you’re looking for pure Indian taste, this place is a must-visit.

reviews:
This café is a great spot for a quick stop, whether for coffee, a light lunch, or a snack. One of the things I really liked was the variety of seating options—comfortable tables, casual seating, and quieter corners, making it suitable for both short visits and longer stays.

They offer a wide selection of pastries, along with pizza and sandwiches, so there are plenty of choices depending on what you feel like. Everything looked fresh and inviting, and it’s an easy place to drop in when you want something quick but still enjoyable.

Overall, a convenient and pleasant café with good variety and

AMICO Bakery is truly one of my favourite bakeries in the GTA! They have the best coffee and pastries — always fresh, always delicious. Their pizzas and sandwiches are made fresh as well, and you can genuinely taste the quality and freshness in every bite.

The staff here are incredibly kind and sweet, which makes every visit feel warm and welcoming. I love coming here with my partner; it’s our perfect spot to grab a coffee and a snack.

They also offer a wide variety of frozen pizza & lasagnas (which honestly taste realllyyyy good). It’s a must-try! And now, during the holiday season, they ha

I walked in here on a cold, snowy and ICEY November Sunday. I was looking for a warm place to chill out.

One young man working the cash register recommended a cappuccino. It’s just what I needed. Taste it for yourself to see if you like it but it was quite nice. Cost $5.00 including tax.

This place kind of reminds me of “Tre Mari” @ St.Clair. Highly recommend if you’re in the area!

I stumbled upon Amico today—completely unplanned. I had arrived early for a medical appointment and decided to pass the time by checking it out. What a jackpot! It turned out to be the best foodie experience I’ve had since moving to Canada.

Every bite, every sip transported me back to Italy and the beautiful memories of my honeymoon. The flavors were nostalgic and comforting in the most unexpected way.

My only regret? I don’t live nearby. But Amico has definitely earned a spot as my go-to place to hang out with friends whenever I’m in the area.
Went in for pizza on a busy Sunday. Good food and good service. Cheers to the young man named Alex for the hard work and good conversation you provided. Definitely will be back!

reviews:
Wasn’t overly impressed with what I ordered. Wish I tried their momo’s but we got the ginger beef and lemon chicken as we were feeling more Szechuan style food.

For $30, the portions for two dishes we got felt pretty small. The flavours didn’t really hit either. Couldn’t taste any ginger in the ginger beef. The lemon chicken sauce was okay. A bit thin, not overly flavourful.

Am open to trying other items though.

Very warm and tiny comfort hakka food restaurant! All of their dishes are packed with flavours. The people working are very generous and the food is very affordable. My personal favorite was the hot and sour soup
Ordered late night takeout from here it was finger licking good they deserve 6 stars. Yuvraj is an excellent person amazing conversation just love this place coming back again. 100% recommended.

Food is very mid and I got the buy one, get one free and this is how it came, with a bone and no meat and a whole bunch of rice. The second box had very tiny meat and a whole ocean of rice. I not sure how you guys got high rating with poor quality in quantity and taste. Very disappointing
Absolutely best one of the best chilli beef and chowmein ever. Hiddem gem in toronto and the customer service was very welcoming and friendly.

Food
- I purchased the steak sandwich. Flavor wise, it was pretty good. Well cooked and the taste was subtle but pleasant. However, a decent portion of the steak was fat, which covered about 10% of it and the meat was a bit chewy
- Bread was fluffy and buttery flavored
- Ingredients are up to your discretion but you will pay a fee for each add on

Service
- Staff was friendly enough, I believe with some training taking place
- They accepted cash, debit and credit, including AMEX

Location
- There was parking but not ample considering they are sharing parking with a dozen other companies in the

The bread was a little tough but ok . Price seemed a little steep for the dish but not too bad , they have other options as well but need to update the price on the screens I guess . might repeat if I’m close by ! Place is hidden away along a strip of other stores but certainly not to be overlooked, old school vibe, food was great, and the service was fast enough, would certainly come back and try out the lunch/dinner options, we had the canosa breakfast and it was a good choice.

reviews:
Pretty good take out spot for fish n chips!

The interior is a little old, but doesn’t matter because it’s a take out spot anyway! Very friendly service/owner and the fish and chips are great!

There are 2 spots inside if you’d like to eat in, but I think it’s meant to be a take out spot.

I got the halibut fish and chips and enjoyed it. Would get it again if in the area again!

They just do a terrific job of Fish And Chips !!!and the

The fish and the batter are second to none as well as the chips ……and I’m from Scotland , so I can be a hard judge so can my mother. We are both very impressed. Also, there’s  sides  of coleslaw which are made in house that I highly recommend.
I bet if they were to do mushy peas on the side, it would be dynamite too

We thought we would try somewhere different and based on reviews it was worth a try. We ordered 3 meals comprising of 5 pieces of fish with 3 chips. The food was absolutely horrible and disgusting. The fish was extremely rubbery and stale, the batter was oil drenched and was completely detached from the fish with huge gaps. The chips tasted as though they were old and reheated. Everyone felt extremely uneasy after eating the food. Extremely disappointed and would not recommend nor have their food again.

The lady working is lively food is okay. Fish is light and crispy fries are meh would be a lot better with a different gravy, kinda tasted like can. Prices are fair though and they have the good tartar sauce in the white and green pack

I often get fish and chips at Malt N Salt and have to say the food has always been consistent. Their halibut is not over battered and fries and great. Sue great at remembering repeat customers and always has a smile to greet you.  My reco would be to call your order in ahead and pick up. They get busy and this is the best way to avoid line ups.

reviews:
I’ve long been a fan of Nord Lyon, especially the Queen West location. I recently tried the newly opened Union Station branch for the first time, and the pastries were as good as always.

Unfortunately, the smoked salmon croissant was disappointing. For $14.99, the portion of smoked salmon was very small compared to other sandwiches such as the tuna or turkey (see photos, others seems normal portion but my salmon looks poor😥). It felt lacking in substance for the price.

Nord Lyon remains one of my favourite pastry spots, but the smoked salmon offering at this location did not meet expectation

Came for a flat white and a pain au chocolat. Employee working was really nice and really quick too. Flat white was served hot and tasted really nice. The pain au chocolat could have more chocolate inside but it was still flaky and had a good taste to it. Able to use AMEX there which is nice, will be back again for a snack

Immaculate decadence, exquisite coffee, absolutely incredible. Must stop at union for this, so much to choose from and everything looks so good. I got a chocolate eclair a pistachio danish and a mixed berry danish to treat the family and a coffee for me. The staff are very friendly and helpful, and patient with me… choices… store is very stunning yet remarkably modern simplicity.

It’s really a great walk-in place at the TORONTO UNION STATION to enjoy the fresh and French bakery items. The quality of their every bakery item is so fresh, smooth and delicious to admire. We ordered pistachio donut and pistachio croissant and both were delicious and beyond our expectations. It was really yummy

Wow, it was really tasty! I got the circular shaped fruit custard pastry.
The only thing I deducted one star was because the prices aren’t displayed clearly and it ended up being a bit more expensive than anticipated (9$ for the pastry)

reviews: Foods are so good and budget friendly. An order of lomi batangas is good for 1-2person, depends on how is your appetite. Lechon kawali is so crunchy on the outside and juicy inside. They also have silog meals, unfortunately I didn’t tried any of it. Highly recommended if you like batangas lomi.

We had a great experience here! The owner is incredibly kind and even gave complimentary fries to our 3-year-old son, which was such a sweet gesture. We also enjoyed chatting with them—it felt warm and personal, especially since they share the same hometown as my husband (Rosario, Batangas). The lomi was absolutely delicious too. We’ll definitely be coming back!

I ordered a variety of dishes to-go to share with my family. It easily fed 7 of us and we even had some leftovers to enjoy later.

The prices are very reasonable. Every bite was worth it. Making these dishes myself and buying all the necessary ingredients would cost more. This is a family business worth supporting. The pictures speak for themselves. Looking forward to tasting the other menu items. Highly recommend!
Heard great things, so we gave it a try—and it didn’t disappoint! Batangas lomi and goto cravings satisfied. Friendly staff and owner. Definitely coming back!

Come here for lunch. Had one dish and parts of others. Was tasty and filling. Some tastes did remind me of the Philippines. The noodles and broth were good! Seating is small for groups larger then 4.
My issue with the place is the noodles parking. Was hard to find a spot. Also I don’t believe there is a washroom.

reviews:
I went to Amor Shawarma with my son and we loved it! The guy who served us was super nice and friendly. We had a beef shawarma bowl with fries and wow…  it was so filling! They put a lot of meat an so deliciousss… we loved. Honestly, the best shawarma we’ve ever tried 🙃
We left so happy, and we loved that the name “Amor” is in Spanish. Muchas gracias your amazing service, many blessings ✨

Ordered a chicken shawarma poutine last night. They allow you to add extra sauces and toppings but I wanted to stick with just the basic one. They did use good ingredients for the basics

Good gravy: it's a dark (possibly beef gravy) but it's got a rich flavour to it

Crispy fries: nothing too crazy but these are tasty and crispy

Chicken was good. Dry in some areas but mostly delicious and well seasoned.

Their shawarma is their specialty and you'll probably have a good time here.

Imagine craving shawarma and getting this crap served to you out of a container, no char, no amor whatsoever. The girl serving was really friendly but had no idea what the sauce had.

Long story short, there are four shawarma spots in walking distance and I'm not giving this one another chance.

Tried this shawarma place and was really let down. The wrap completely fell apart by the time I got home and I only live down the street (5 minute walk) It was soggy, poorly wrapped, and a mess to eat.

The ingredients didn’t make sense together: coleslaw, three different types of tomato-based salads, and a confusing mix of textures and flavours that just didn’t work. It felt like someone emptied the fridge into a pita and hoped for the best.

There’s actually a better shawarma spot just down the street with fresher ingredients and way better value. I’d recommend skipping this one.

10/10 would recommend. Got a chicken shawarma, was super delicious! Big portions, flavourful food, friendly service.
There are a few locations as well, I usually go to the one in the village, and never disappointed ♥️ always come in if I'm close by.

reviews: This restaurant has been my to go spot for Ewa agonyin, Egbo, Akara and Moimoi. On Canada day I decided to try their Smokey jollof rice and oh my, oh my, Smokey it was 😋😋. Right there,and then I knew I’m coming back for another one. And here I am with another banger lol 😋😂

This woman gave me moi moi that has been days in the fridge or freezer. At first when I noticed the color, I thought maybe a different beans was used. Little did I know I will wake up 3 times in the night due to stomach ache and diarrhea. Even after taking a pill to stop the pain, I still feel slight aches and the need to use the bathroom. That tells you how much microbes have developed in it. One thing these restaurateurs don't understand is: refrigerating foods doesn't prevent foods from spoling or eliminating foodborne illnesses. You are  hoping to save money by not throwing the foods even
The ewa agonyin was agonyinnnn lol. It was so tasty and very delicious 😋. Really enjoyed the food,vibe and atmosphere. I will be back for the Egbo and Beans

My First time coming here today during my work break..
Owner was a lovely pleasant woman.
We interacted like we have known each other...
I ordered Ekuru bcos its been a loooooong time i had it and wasn't disappointed.it was sooo good and yummy,d ata dindin was superb.

I am coming back for tuwo.

May your business continue to flourish....Amennn.
WELL DONE!

This restaurant is very consistent, I love all their beans meal, my favourites are the egbo and beans, stews bean and corn and their fried fish. I plan on trying the ewa agoyin but I’m still skeptical. Very delicious meals. Well done

reviews: Amazing time at ibund. They are super affordable as for the price you are paying you are getting a lot of food. They have different combo options that allow you to try a lot from their menu. I tried the signature combo which came with the pork pot stickers, mini pork wontop soup and soy milk. I also got their winter special combo which came with their signature three treasure hot pot, salted pork vegetable clay pot rice and soy milk. Additionally we got the pork stickers which were hands down my favourite. They were super crispy on the outside and packed with a super juicy pork filling. I also

It’s a good size menu, not overwhelming. The food came out hot and fast.  The taste is authentic and true to Shanghainese cuisine.

The potstickers are a good size and juicy with a crispy bottom.  They come in 6s.  The scallion oil noodles were fragrant and a good darkness, but could use a little more scallions.  The fried rice sticks were a little bit gummy, maybe a less batter and cook the rice a little less would improve them.  Same gummy taste for the radish cakes.  However, but they were the closest to traditional street food that I have found in Toronto.  The soya milk was fresh and home

Tried iBund Potstickers Toronto and really enjoyed it. The potstickers were freshly made with a nice crispy bottom and juicy filling. Scallion oil noodles were simple but very comforting. Everything tasted fresh and not heavy. Cozy little spot near Finch Station — I’d definitely come back.

Delicious shanghainese street food, I really felt nostalgic eating here! The fired pork chop and rice cakes were crispy and chewy and the potstickers were full of soup and had great seasoning. The wrapper was just a tad thicker than I expected but maybe that’s more personal preference. I hope this place gets the love it deserves!

I came during their soft opening. Great spot! Super friendly and knowledgeable staff, and tasty food. Everything came piping hot and full of flavour. Nice decor on the walls too with illustrations of the menu items. I hope they do well.

reviews: Friend of mine referred Nisha’s Culinary specially for Butter chicken rolls. I called them for quantity of 50 and within 2 hours, my order was ready to pick up. They added two type of sauces as well. The Butter chicken roll was crispy and packed with tangy butter chicken gravy with generous amount of chicken. It was really worth for $2.00 each.In addition i got crispy calamari as well for $12.99 it was phenomenal. Tbh, i really recommend this place for anyone to wanna try their Butter chicken Rolls. I tried Butter chicken Rolls in many places however, Nisha’s Butter chicken  Rolls are BEST in

I ordered the 30-piece party tray of butter chicken rolls from Nishas Culinary for an event and they were a HUGE hit. Everyone kept talking about how good they were! The rolls were full-sized, super flavourful, and honestly such a great price for the quality and quantity. They even included two different sauces, which was a nice touch. My order was also ready really quickly after placing it. Super worth it! I’m so happy with my order and would definitely order again.

Absolutely fantastic biriyani. 10 out of 10 for taste. My only feedback would be when we came into the store, there wasnt any signage, there wasn't a menu, and there wasnt anything on display in the hot table. So we had no idea what was for sale and what was available.

That being said, some of the best food I've had at very very fair prices.

Had to try local, first visit! Food was fresh and tasty. Service was really good. Would highly recommend this place! Much much better than what’s across and what’s around.

All appetizer are made to order. So there is a 5-6min wait! Order ahead for rush.

All the cake looked really good, falooda and mango shake was off the roof.

Will come again.

The staff here are truly exceptional—welcoming, friendly, and incredibly attentive. From the moment you walk in, they go out of their way to make you feel comfortable and genuinely cared for. The desserts are on another level altogether, both in presentation and taste. Every single dish on the menu is bursting with flavor and made with obvious attention to quality and detail. You can really feel the passion and care that goes into everything they serve. This was an outstanding experience from start to finish and easily one of the best biryani and butter chicken I’ve ever had😋😋

reviews:
Located in the Peanut Plaza at south of Finch and Don Mills.  There is plenty of parking here but just be careful turning in/ out due to the island nature of this plaza.

The shop is newly opened and prices very competitive.

They have the typical spread of BBQ meats but just not out front and for public to see.

There is a prepared food counter with some braised dishes to go or over rice.

The rice boxes are very generously filled with rice, begin and meat(s) of choice.

I chose the Roasted duck and roast pork over rice and the portion sizes are good for 2 meals.  These also come with a compl

New owner. Reopened recently. 20% discount until Valentine’s Day. Cash only.

Got take out with bbq pork and crispy pork as well as sweet and sour pork. Portions are ok for the discounted price.  Quality of meat and flavour is good. Staff are friendly.

There was a bit of a line up but the line moves quickly.

There’s clearly been a change in ownership, and the difference is very noticeable. The new owners seem much more attentive, and the food quality and taste have improved significantly. I really appreciate the extra care they took in selecting better cuts of pork for me.

Even though it was very busy with a long lineup, the service was still efficient and handled well. You can tell they are putting real effort into improving both the food and the overall experience. Definitely worth visiting.

This place offers amazing value. The prices are very good, especially for the amount and quality of food you receive. Everything tastes really flavorful and fresh, with that authentic BBQ taste you look for. The portions are generous, so you definitely leave feeling satisfied. It’s a great spot if you want delicious food at a fair and affordable price the owners are also incredibly friendly

Recently stopped by this Chinese barbecue spot and tried their hot and sweet & sour chicken, and it was honestly really good. The chicken was fresh, flavorful, and cooked just right , not too heavy, and the sauce had a nice balance of sweetness and tanginess.
The place itself felt clean and welcoming, and you can tell there’s been a positive change recently. The atmosphere was nice, and the staff were friendly and attentive. It’s great to see how much effort is being put into making the experience better.

reviews: Tried the breakfast sandwich on a coconut bagel and the brewed coffee and it was excellent. Bagels tasted fresh, chewy, and definitely authentic Montreal style. Also grabbed a chocolate chip walnut cookie, which was warm, fresh, and absolutely delicious.  Clean space, and nice staff. Definitely worth the stop, and will be back for more!

My breakfast bagel was absolutely shocking. I paid extra for a twister bagel so it was around $10 for what is pictured. Half a strip of precooked bacon and a dry egg round. I’m giving two stars because the staff refunded my meal on request and they were welcoming and friendly.

Having this spot so close to my gym is dangerous — in the best way!Tried the Pesto bagel sandwich for the first time and it was sooo good, and the prices are really reasonable for what you get. They even sell day old bagels, which is such a great deal. Honestly, a bit cheaper than the St. Viateur bagels at Metro at 7.85  and these are  fresher.

I’m from Montreal and these are very close, if not the same as the ones I grew up having. Definitely will be back!

The taste of the bagel itself was delicious (but also on the drier side) I got a BLT and majority of my lettuce on the sandwich was the stem, it was falling apart and in general wasn’t the best. Completely candidly speaking, I’ve had better at TimHortons.

Got to the place was very friendly with the staff, ended up realizing I didn't pay for the order and ended up waiting for my bagel. Sorry folks. Got home during the rain to a sandwich that was AMAZING!!!!! The bagels, not to tough but not too light, just right. I know where to go to get my bagels seeing as I'm not finding my regular bakery in the place any more.

reviews:
Han Tai Wan is a family-owned and run cafe and gastro pub that blends classic HK cafe menu with fusion Hong Kong dishes. You can have Michelin-style dishes at budget-friendly prices.

The space is casual and welcoming, making it an easy place to drop in for comfort food during the day or late at night. They also have great selection of beer to pair with your meal.

The menu mixes nostalgic Hong Kong dishes with new, creative plates. We ordered “Smoked Satay Chicken and Beef Skewers” and “Kowloon City Thai-Style Marinated Scallops Sashimi” for appetizer, “Stone Pot BBQ Eel & Assorted Preserved

They recently rebranded, and you can feel the upgrade immediately — from the presentation to the overall vibe. It’s a modern space but still keeps that warm Hong Kong cha chaan teng feeling.
We ordered the $79.99 set for two, and it honestly fed all three of us with leftovers to take home. Incredible value for the quality and portion size.

The risotto with crispy fish skin was creamy with the perfect crunch. The clay pot BBQ rice had amazing wok hei and smoky flavor. The lamb ribs were tender and juicy, and the fried shrimp were crispy outside and succulent inside. The curry beef skewers brou
Came here with a friend and was so impressed! The service was great, everyone was super nice! The food was also amazing, were definitely coming back again!!! thank you so much to the team!! 🙏🙏
The food is excellent! Good quality and very flavourful! Not too salty and lots of variety!

Arrived at the restaurant around 7:30pm on a Saturday night and there was no wait, which was nice. The server greeted us right when we stepped in, and service was friendly overall.

We ordered the S06 with J01 soup, and my husband got the B21. It took about 35 minutes for my food to arrive even though the restaurant wasn’t fully seated, which felt a bit odd.

Food quality was average overall, nothing particularly memorable but not bad either. I’ve always been a bit unsure about the hype around HK food, and this visit didn’t really change my mind, so I’m still on the fence about recommending it

reviews: A true gem located in this food court. Has been my go-to while in the office for the past 2 months. The flavour is excellent, food always hits the right spot. I love when I can get my proteins and veggies in and their chicken platter gives great nutritious value. Have noticed they started decreasing the rice a bit over time. Hopefully they don’t cheap out once their reviews are high. The beet salad is delicious!

We had our staff lunch catered by Sultan’s Mediterranean Grill, and I received so many kudos for my part in placing the order that I almost feel guilty. Colleagues told me it was our best staff lunch ever, and some of the folks with dietary restrictions made a special point of thanking me as they felt so well accommodated. I received a lot of accolades, and all I did was place the order! ;0)

I came here for a quick lunch last week. Its located within TD center food court.

They offer a range of middle eastern style Shawarma and plates. I did a beef shawarma sandwich and I was offered free salad as well.

I really liked the taste and I can say it was really fresh. The beef was cooked properly and seasoned right. The garlic sauce was enough and allowed to taste the beef more than garlic. The bread was also really fresh.

The salad also, was super fresh and tasty and topped properly with olive oil.

I was offered free salad as It was my first time there which I really liked. The gent

They have something called a Chicken Shavarma meal but it's more like rice, veggies, salad and some chicken shavarma topping. Quite ridiculous for the amount that was charged. Call it 'Salad with Shavarma topping' instead!

Would definitely not recommend!!!

Worked with Hanin to help organize a catering order for my team. She was responsive and ensured accommodations were met.

I wish delivery was a little smoother. I got a text saying "I'm here" and I initially thought is it sultan's or is it a scam? The delivery person ended up just leaving the order on the counter of the lunchroom.

Otherwise great food and service.

reviews: We did a salumi/sausage class with Cucina Mauro and it was EXCELLENT! The class was informative and super fun, and we ended the afternoon with a delicious meal cooked by chef Mauro himself. My family and friends in the area often bring us lunch from Cucina Mauro during the week, and it is 10/10 DELICOUS. Highly recommend the Porchetta! Thank you chef Mauro for the wonderful experience and the great food. We will be back for lunch and we will definitely be booking a class again!

I cannot recommend Cucina Mauro highly enough! Mauro did an incredible job putting together a lunch spread for my Nonna's birthday. He was responsive and helped to design a customized menu from her region of Italy complete with her favourite foods to make it special. He cooked onsite and brought everything in to set up a gorgeous antipasto and pizza spread. The food was delicious and and got rave reviews from my discerning Italian foodie family. I would not hesitate to use his catering again - he made the day so easy and the event so much more special than I could have imagined.

We celebrated an 80th birthday here and it was such a great experience. The pasta-making class was fun, interactive, and a perfect way to bring everyone together. It was followed by a delicious rustic Italian meal that felt warm and homey like a family gathering.

A big thank you to Mauro, Cosmo, and Olga for making everything run smoothly and creating such a welcoming atmosphere. Highly recommend for a special celebration.

I can say so many wonderful things about Mauro and his staff but I will just say- simply the best. Thank you Mauro and team for the delicious food, the kindness and excellent communication you offer. We appreciate your service throughout the years. People are still talking about the food at our wedding four years later. Gratitude for you all.

reviews:
We recently visited Pandian Vilas in Brimley, Scarborough, and had a wonderful dining experience. We ordered chilli chicken kothu, paal appam, idli, and small fish curry, and every dish was excellent.
The chilli chicken kothu was outstanding, especially paired with the salna. The salna was perfectly seasoned and complemented the kothu beautifully. The small fish curry tasted truly authentic, with bold pepper notes and a rich tamarind flavor that stood out.
The highlight of the meal was definitely the paal appam—crispy around the edges, soft and fluffy in the center, and served with lightly swe

We stopped by this place recently and were really impressed! So rustic and so authentic. Their parotta was crispy and soft at the same time, and just the way it should be. Kalakki was top notch and their breakfast set was a must try.

I had the idli and dosa combo with mutton curry after my gym workout this morning.

It was absolutely delicious! The texture, flavor, and freshness were excellent, and the tea at the end was the perfect finishing touch.

Special thanks to Ms. Priyanka for her warm service and spot-on menu suggestions.

Her professionalism and attention to customer satisfaction truly stand out. Even the owner, Anna, was very friendly and welcoming.

Highly recommend this place for anyone looking for authentic taste and great hospitality!

Chai and coffee were fantastic. Puri was good but the proportion of masala given was disappointing. Dosa sambar and all is decent. Service is painfully slow. Be prepared to spend over 2 hr for your meal here.

Visited Paandian Vilas and had an amazing experience. The staff member Lakshman was super friendly, very welcoming, and extremely accommodating. He truly went above and beyond to make sure we were comfortable. His customer service was awesome, always with a warm smile
we need more nice people like him.

We had the Unlimited Vazha Ilai Virunthu, and everything was so good and very tasty. A must-visit place for authentic food. Highly recommended!

The owner Tsige spent time telling me how to cook Dora Wat in an authentic way!

This store also serves free Ethiopian coffee (a nice touch!) and what Ethiopians call a “coffee ceremony”. They also sell Ethiopian coffee and coffee ware.

One suggestion I have for Tsige is to ensure the spices have English on them as people who don’t speak th
