It tasted like they were trying to stretch the filling after a long day, instead of the concentrated flavours you get at the bottom of the pot I got...yelp. I will be back at a different time and day hoping for a better outcome.
I did like the clean space and the murals.
I am so piss off after waiting two hours for my orders. My veggie tray was all mix up and food sis not taste good at all after spending $60 dollars. That’s how I got my veggie plater

Ordered fudge through door dash and instead they substituted it for kurma that was way passed the best before date. Not only did they not notify us of the change but sent us 4 packs of stale goods. When called, not even an apology, just blaming us and door dash

I’m quite surprised by this evenings take out order from this place. We order 2 veggie meals that are totally mixed up together and messy. Maybe ordering the appropriate takeout containers that separate the different types of food would be better. We have order from here MANY TIMES before this his the first time this has happened. What really shocked me is the photo I’m about to share with this review. Being West Indian and knowing how dhaal needs to be prepared I’m not happy how this happened. Management definitely needs to be able to have some level of quality control and accountability towa

This place is amazing. The food tastes fantastic! They also have a $11.99 lunch special that blows other places I've been to out of the water. You get your choice of chicken roit or chicken on rice and a double. Let me tell you, these doubles are also on point. Highly recommend this place!

reviews:
I visited M Chá Bar – Bloor & Bathurst and really enjoyed the drinks and the atmosphere.

The Pistachio Blast Italian gelato was rich, smooth and very nutty, made with house-made pistachio paste.

Peachy Dream was fun and refreshing, with three toppings and great texture in every sip.

Mango Pomelo Taro Ball had lots of real fruit and a nice balance between refreshing and filling.

There are new pistachio drinks, Pistachio Cloud Jasmine Green Tea and the Pistachio Coffee Latte look so good

The store is small but very clean and cozy, more like a neighborhood café than a typical bubble tea shop

Tried M Cha Bar and really enjoyed everything here!
We ordered a few drinks, including matcha drinks and they were all fresh, nicely balanced, and not too sweet. The tea flavour was strong and the ingredients tasted high quality.

Their egg waffles were a big surprise, crispy on the outside, soft inside, and so fragrant. Perfect snack to go with the drinks.

The store is clean and bright, and the staff were friendly and helpful when recommending options.
A great spot for drinks and Hong Kong-style snacks. Will definitely come back!

Came here for the grand opening and had a great experience. We got the pistachio frappe, a brown sugar milk tea and pistachio ice cream. The pistachio ice cream was absolutely amazing and highly recommended. I also really enjoyed the milk tea because it wasn’t overly sweet and heavy. I also tried crystal tapioca for the first time and enjoyed the combo.

Because we were one of the first customers, we also got to spin the wheel and won free tote bags which were super cute!

The space is cute, the desserts are great and the ambiance is warm and welcoming. I would highly recommending giving cha b

Amazing Affogato! The coffee was very strong and tick and bold. The espresso icecream was superb! Chic and cozy atmosphere. Friendly staff . I just recommend to serve in glass mug for dine-in customers rather than paper cups. Otherwise everything else was great .
Super friendly staffs, bright vibes, great all-butter croissants, authentic ferrero and white rabbit gelato flavours! Highly recommended!

TASHKENT RESTAURANT||1126 FINCH AVE W, #.matchedAddress: 1126 Finch Ave W #10, North York, ON M3J 3J6, Canada
reviews:
The food was fantastic 😍, and the service was truly top-notch. The staff were incredibly warm-hearted and even surprised us with a few complimentary dishes, which was such a thoughtful gesture. To top it all off, a wonderful dancer performed several beautiful Middle Eastern dances for us, making the evening even more memorable.
This is definitely one of the best restaurants I've visited in Toronto. Highly recommended!

I recently visited Tashkent Restaurant and had a great experience. The atmosphere was cozy and relaxing, the staff was friendly and attentive, and the service was fast. The food was fresh, delicious, and beautifully presented, especially the traditional dishes and grilled meat. The prices were reasonable for the quality offered. It’s a perfect place to spend time with friends or family. I would definitely visit again!

Plov time helped make my mother's birthday especially memorable this year by bringing the Uzbek taste of home to our dining table!

The plov, Manti, somsa, and tandir were delicious and filled the house with their delicious aroma. Absolutely recommend to anyone who is craving something new or feeling nostalgic for the taste of home!

The customer service was 11/10 too! Extremely kind and welcoming!

Ordered manti and samsi! Overall amazing food and service : pleasant and kind, delivered promptly. Doe on manti is nice and thin, lamb is diced and properly cooked (scent wise) samsi were delicious cooked traditionally in a “tandir” oven. Received a complimentary pilov - rice was phenomenal (I come from a different region we don’t add chickpeas or raisins but it was a different flavour with an authentic touch) looking forward to ordering Lagman once available 💕
Absolutely delicious somsas! These are made fresh in a real tandyr, and you can taste the authenticity in every bite. Perfect for catering or outdoor events — highly recommend!

reviews: Not a fried chicken place but I’d say this might have been the highlight. Really well seasoned and the sauce they provide with it is actually reminiscent of Raising Cane’s sauce. No fishy taste, very fresh for the raw marinated crab. As a Korean, this place is authentic and would highly recommend. They also provide complimentary hot tea which is a nice extra touch especially on a cold winter day.

One of the most original Korean restaurants in Toronto. Great quality food with many options that kids love (donkatsoo, Korean fried chicken, bibimpap).
Tried and loved their Gomtang, bibimpap and kimchi stew. Kids loved the tonkatsoo (portion is reasonable and enough for my two boys to share and be full).

Naju Gomtang
Clean and modern interior with friendly service. The gomtang and galbitang were both delicious and comforting. The menu was simple and easy to read, even for non-Korean customers. Prices were reasonable, free parking was convenient, and the soy marinated crab looked amazing — definitely want to try it next time! I do wish I could add my own salt and black pepper since I personally prefer my soup less salty.

New Korean spot at this plaza! Minimalist decor. Nice and bright in the afternoon.

I was not able to try their marinated crabs since it was sold out. But tried the shrimp and galbi tang was delicious. Love their kimchi as well as they were not very tart, just how i like it.

Good spot to find some rarer Korean cuisine.

Gomtang:
- a very nice broth that is slightly sweet compared to the seolleongtang
- beef slices go surprisingly well with the vinegar-based dip that it comes with
- very mushy white rice

Half/Half gejang (marinated crab):
- very hard to get the meat out of the shell, also had very little of it
- crab meat was slightly tacky?, which combined with the sliminess made it taste a little off (I've tried marinated crab in Korea, where it tastes is a lot cleaner)
- good flavours, the spicy one was very messy tho!

I would come only if you really wanted to

reviews:
My friend and I came here to enjoy a traditional Mexican breakfast and of course was really good.

Started with a cafe de Hoya  really good  I was impressed because no many Mexican restaurants offer  homemade coffee .

Both of us  order chilaquiles, which we also like it very much.

At the end they offer also a fruit salad as cortesy which I was also surprised.

We really have a wonderful time here we enjoyed our breakfast and the atmosphere is really pleasant.

You won’t regret it we definitely recommend this hidden gem  you won’t be disappointed.

Came here today for lunch. Everything on the menu sounded delicious, so we asked our server for recommendations. We had the chicken chilaquiles and green shrimp aquachile and drinks. Both dishes were so flavorful, drinks were fun, and prices were reasonable. Will definitely be back to try other dishes!

The menudo is one of my fav very big portions and a delicious cafe de olla  if you have the opportunity to come I recommend it.
The servers were very nice, polite and very quick.
A quiet place to have breakfast. Price fair, good quality and portion.
Best noche de despecho events, this even is once a month.

reviews:
I ordered a vegetable samosa and found meat inside. This is completely unacceptable. For people who are vegetarian, have religious restrictions, or food allergies, this is a serious issue—not a small mistake.

This shows a lack of care in food preparation and labeling. I’ve lost trust in this place and will not be returning unless they take food handling and customer safety seriously.

had to give this restaurant major props for providing meals to those in need, especially considering so many are going without basic needs this winter. every time I walk past this place, the aromas are irresistible and I can't help but pick up a chicken samosa, roll, or patty, which are so delicious, filling, and affordable! the sweets are also v yummy, big fan of the mishti doi :)

Food quality came down. We were regular customers from the beginning. This store name was  originally "adi bikrampur".. today I purchased a total of $50 snacks, including 4 boxes of Biryani. The Biryani portion is a lot less compared to before. I bought them in the afternoon, came home 1 hour later and opened the Biyani boxes to have our family lunch. All the boxes became spoiled.

Biryani became smelly.

These Biryani are from the day before or even earlier. There's no way this Biryani was cooked on the same day. The cashier lied to me that it was cooked in the morning. If it was cooked in th

Great takeout spot with lots of yummy snacks and sweets. Excellent customer service. I ordered the kolija (liver) singara, chicken patty, tea, and gur roshogolla. The tea was good, and the roshogolla was amazing. A must try. I will be going back again and again to try other items. It's a great authentic bangladeshi spot to snack in bangla town.

I have had a lot of samosas in my time but these are the best i have ever had. Nice people running it, incredible food & tea and in a really cool part of town. Make your way here, you will not be disappointed.

reviews:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Had an absolutely incredible dining experience at Mr Biryani!

We started with the Manchow Soup and Mutton Saag — both were incredibly tasty and full of rich, comforting flavors. The soup had the perfect balance of spice, and the mutton saag was flavorful and cooked just right.

For appetizers, we tried the Dream Nut Chicken — it was spicy, bold, and absolutely delicious! If you love heat with amazing flavor, this is a must-try.

For the main course, we went all out and tried a variety of mandi and biryani dishes: Mutton Ghee Roast Mandi, Chicken Ghee Roast Mandi, Lamb Shank Mandi, Frie

I went to Mr. Biryani in Scarborough for dinner the other day. The ambience was nice and comfortable, and one thing I like about this place is that there’s usually no long wait to get seated. The service is also pretty quick, which is always a plus.
We ordered Mutton Marag, Haleem, Karimnagar Chicken, Mutton Dum Biryani, Shahtoot Malai, and Lychee Rabdi. The Mutton Marag honestly tasted more like a thinner, soupier Haleem than what I expected (doesn’t have the authentic Marag taste). The Haleem itself, though, was really good — great texture, rich flavour, and felt pretty authentic.
Karimnagar

I visited this location with a friend. The restaurant is quite large inside with a beautiful interior.

We tried
🌟 Mutton Shorba (Chorba)
🌟 Shahi Chicken
🌟 Chicken Tikka
🌟 Naan
🌟 Malai Chicken
🌟 Hariyali Chicken
🌟 Pulao

🌟 Sunrise Pudding
🌟 Khubani Ka Meetha

🌟 Pista & Badan Milk

The Pulao was delicious. I quite enjoyed the Malai chicken and the sunrise pudding. (This was my first time having this dessert!) . The Pista milk was also tasty as well. Food is good quality and flavorful.

I had no expectations when I came here but it definitely surprised me with the food. I won't say the food is exceptional but it's definitely good and a lot of scope for improvement. The quantity of the food is really amazing. For 4 people we ordered 2 starters and 2 biryanis, and it was pretty satisfying. What's more, there are some left overs, which we packed home.

The service is also exceptional 👏,  calm and friendly. PRANATHI, who took our order and professional. Not only her but the entire staff is very polite.

I definitely recommend anyone to give it a try and decide for yourself.

You won't be disappointed with the food! Haleem and fish pakora were delicious- full of flavor and perfectly prepared.

The only improvement I'd suggest is with the serving order. The food should be brought out in the proper sequence - soup first, followed by starters, and then the main course. If they organize this flow better, the overall dining experience would be even more enjoyable.

Loved it today; would definitely visit once again 💯

reviews:
Toronto’s most unique BBQ experience 🔥 Save this Thai BBQ & hotpot spot for your next food adventure.

This was my first time trying Mookata, and it definitely exceeded my expectations.

For the hotpot, I chose the coconut soup base and honestly, the coconut flavour was so rich and fragrant. It paired perfectly with the vegetables and helped balance out the richness of the BBQ.

For the grill, I ordered the “Meat You Tonight” platter. The beef was fresh, tender, and incredibly flavourful, especially when paired with their spicy dipping sauce.

One of my favourite dishes was the Pork Jowl Salad

This was our first time trying Thai BBQ and hotpot, and it definitely did not disappoint! We got the porkylicious combo, Seafood Glass Noodle, Crispy Chicken Joints, Watermelon Slushy and Pineapple Slushy. There was such a great variety of pork cuts, with each one offering a different texture and flavour. The dipping sauces were easily one of the highlights, packed with bold, tangy, sweet, salty, and spicy flavours that made every bite even better! The chicken joints were fried perfectly with the crispiest coating while the seafood noodles had a surprising tanginess and were loaded with seafoo

Tried Osha Mookata and it was such a fun and unique dining experience!

This is one of the first places in Toronto offering Thai BBQ + hotpot (mookata style), where you grill meats on top while the broth simmers underneath.

The quality of the meat was really good, and as everything cooks, the juices drip into the soup and make it even more flavorful — such a nice touch. I also loved their authentic Thai dipping sauces, they added a lot of depth and made the whole meal even better. The coconut-based broth was my favorite, super rich and comforting without being too heavy.

KHAS PATTI||545 KEELE ST, #19 M6N 3E4.matchedAddress: 545 Keele St, Old Toronto, ON M6N 3E4, Canada
reviews:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
If you are in Toronto and craving authentic Indian flavors with a modern touch, Khas Patti is the place you must try! 😍🍴
From the moment you step in, the service makes you feel so welcomed. A special shoutout to Danny 👨‍🍳🙌 – he is simply the best! Super humble, polite, and always ready to guide you with the right food choices. Whether it’s takeaway or dine-in (currently takeaway is available), you will be impressed with how well they take care of their customers. 💯👏
Now let’s talk about the food 🍛🥡:
🌱 Veg Options (Must Try!)
🫘 Daal Makhani – creamy, rich, and cooked to perfection.
🍜 Veg

What a fantastic first experience😍😍 with Khas Patti Toronto! The food was bursting with flavor…seriously so good. They even surprised me with a handwritten note, extra garlic naan, and a masala soda. Such an awesome and thoughtful touch! It honestly made my day. If you’re looking for delicious food and amazing vibes, definitely give them a try.🍛🥘

Amazing service. Thank you Chef Sanjay and Danny for delicious food. Biryani is must try and yes dont miss the chicken seekh kebabs, chicken tikka, paneer tikka and mamchurian. Thank you again for yummy food!

Do yourself a favor and do not order from Khas Patti. This was only my second order, and they already screwed it up. I paid for four items, and one was skipped entirely, replaced with something random I never ordered. That’s not a small mistake, it’s a deliberate, care-free mindset - It's a delivery order who cares, simply throw an item in the bag and the customer will eat it up. Total failure to deliver what the customer paid for.

This is a ghost kitchen in a black box on Keele Street, which means once the reviews get bad, they’ll just shut down and reappear under a new name, same food, same

We ordered takeout and tried the Manchurian, Chicken Momos, and Tawa Chicken — and honestly, it was a flavour-packed experience!

If you’re on the hunt for good Chicken Momos, look no further — they serve the best!
And chicken lovers, don’t miss out on their Tawa Chicken — it’s bursting with flavour and absolutely delicious.
The Manchurian was equally impressive — perfectly cooked and packed with taste.

Overall, we loved everything — highly recommend!

reviews:
Great sushi at a reasonable price!

Ordered via Uber eats and got some nice deals. I really only ended up trying salmon dishes but everything was well prepared, good quality, and the fish tasted great. Ratios and portions are on point and the rice was cooked to perfection. Salmon lover combo was excellent value for the price.

Their menu has good variety and all the main dishes you'd want from a sushi joint - I'll definitely be ordering again to try more!

5/5 ⭐️

I’ve been coming here quite regularly on my lunch breaks and have consistently been impressed with the quality of the sushi.

It’s a small, family-run sushi spot, and you can tell the staff work incredibly hard. The service is always friendly, and despite how busy they often are, everyone is welcoming and helpful 🩵

I usually order takeout, and every single time the sushi has been fresh, delicious, and beautifully prepared 👌🏽🍣

The only minor hiccup was with my most recent order. I had requested a sparkling water, but when I got back to the office, I realized I had been given a regular

Fuumi Sushi is a no frills sushi spot run by a lovely family. The lady that took my order was soft spoken and kind. The fish is fresh and the ingredients are prepared with care. They had a good amount of customers on a Monday afternoon, as the staff were making sushi non-stop during the lunch rush. I would certainly come back and support this local business!

Wish I could give a 1000 stars to this amazing place ❤️ it's run by this adorable family who are so kind and warm, they've even given us extra sushi sometimes 🥹 We are especially addicted to the torched sushi section of their menu you HAVE to try it it's out of this world 🌎 we also love their hand rolled sushi and everything else really gosh after a long work day we come here just to unwind and have delicious food made by the most amazing people who cook and serve with so much love, today they gave us an entire tray of sushi on the house because of a small error in the order, we are always blo

Deserves more love. Sushi was flavour-packed and the ingredients were fresh. Well-priced. (~5.99 for 5 special rolls, which is ridiculous. In downtown???) Cozy, as in not particularly appealing to have an extended stay in, but definitely no-frills as other people say— the food is really good.

If you're sick of going to chain sushi restaurants, definitely give this a try. I mean it wholeheartedly when I say this place deserves more attention from sushi lovers.
